## Indicators Button Fix (TASK-37-7)

### Feature Description
Fix for the "Indicators" button in the header that was previously a non-functional `<button>` element with no action handler. The fix converts the button to a proper Next.js Link component that navigates users to the dashboard page. Part of the Production Critical Fixes - Auth & Navigation feature (FEAT-037).

### Component Locations
- **Header Component:** `frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx`
- **Homepage Inline Header:** `frontend/app/page.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/layout/Header.navigation.test.tsx`, `frontend/__tests__/components/layout/Header.hover-states.test.tsx`

### Problem Solved

| Issue | Before | After |
|-------|--------|-------|
| Element type | `<button>` | `<a>` (Link component) |
| Has href | No | Yes (`/dashboard`) |
| Is clickable | No (non-functional) | Yes (navigates to dashboard) |
| Pointer cursor | No | Yes (`cursor-pointer` class) |
| Hover state | White background (unreadable) | Dark background (`hover:bg-slate-700`) |

### Implementation Details

**Header.tsx (authenticated users):**
The fix was implemented in the guest navigation items array:
```tsx
const guestNavItems = [
  { label: "Indicators", href: "/dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  // ... other items
];
```

**Homepage Inline Header (page.tsx):**
The homepage has its own inline header that also needed the fix:
```tsx
// Before (broken)
<Button variant="ghost" className="text-slate-300 hover:text-white">
  Indicators
</Button>

// After (fixed)
<Button asChild variant="ghost" className="text-slate-300 hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
  <Link href="/dashboard">Indicators</Link>
</Button>
```

### Technical Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `Header.tsx` | Added guest nav items with Link components |
| `page.tsx` | Updated inline header button to use `asChild` + Link wrapper |

## Token Validation in AuthContext (TASK-37-1)

### Feature Description
Fix for AuthContext to validate tokens with the API before considering a user authenticated. Previously, the presence of any token in localStorage caused the app to treat the user as authenticated, leading to redirect loops and error pages. Part of the Production Critical Fixes - Auth & Navigation feature (FEAT-037).

### Component Locations
- **AuthContext:** `frontend/lib/contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
- **Auth Types:** `frontend/lib/types/auth.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/lib/contexts/AuthContext.token-validation.test.tsx`

### Problem Solved

| Issue | Before | After |
|-------|--------|-------|
| Token validation | Token presence only | API verification required |
| Expired token handling | Redirect to dashboard → error | Clear storage → show login |
| Loading state | No verification loading | `isLoading` during API check |
| `INVALID_TOKEN` error | Not recognized | Added to `shouldClearToken()` |

### Implementation Details

**AuthContext.tsx `initializeAuth` function:**
```typescript
const initializeAuth = async () => {
  const storedToken = getStoredAuthToken();

  if (!storedToken) {
    setUser(null);
    clearAuthStorage();
    return;
  }

  // KEY FIX: Verify token with API before setting user
  const freshUser = await fetchUser();

  if (freshUser) {
    setUser(freshUser);
    storeUserData(freshUser);
  } else {
    setUser(null);
    clearAuthStorage();
  }
};
```

**auth.ts `shouldClearToken` function:**
```typescript
export function shouldClearToken(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!isAuthError(error)) {
    return false; // Network errors don't clear token
  }

  const clearableCodes: AuthErrorCode[] = [
    AuthErrorCode.UNAUTHORIZED,
    AuthErrorCode.TOKEN_EXPIRED,
    AuthErrorCode.INVALID_TOKEN,  // Added in this fix
  ];

  return clearableCodes.includes(error.code);
}
```

### Technical Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `frontend/lib/types/auth.ts` | Added `INVALID_TOKEN` to `AuthErrorCode` enum |
| `frontend/lib/types/auth.ts` | Added `INVALID_TOKEN` to `shouldClearToken()` clearable codes |
| `frontend/lib/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` | Token validation via API on initialization |

### Error Code Handling

| Error Code | Action | Reason |
|------------|--------|--------|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | Clear storage | Token invalid/expired |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | Clear storage | Token expired |
| `INVALID_TOKEN` | Clear storage | Token format invalid |
| `NETWORK_ERROR` | Preserve storage | Temporary connectivity issue |
| `SERVER_ERROR` | Preserve storage | Server-side issue |

### Acceptance Criteria Verification

|----------|--------|
| Token validity verified with API before setting authenticated state | ✅ PASS |
| Expired tokens are cleared from localStorage | ✅ PASS |

| Loading state shown while verifying token | ✅ PASS |
| No redirect to dashboard for invalid tokens | ✅ PASS |
| Unit tests for token validation scenarios | ✅ PASS (42 tests) |

## Dashboard API Endpoint (TASK-1-6)

### Feature Description
Dashboard summary API endpoint that provides an overview of ranking changes and key metrics for the Core Rank Tracking feature (FEAT-001). Delivers aggregated data for the main dashboard view including keyword counts, average position, position changes, top keywords, and alerts for significant ranking movements.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/DashboardController.php`
- **Route:** `backend/routes/api.php` (v1 routes)
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/DashboardControllerTest.php`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/sites/{siteId}/dashboard` | Get dashboard summary for a site |

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `totalKeywords` | integer | Total number of tracked keywords |
| `activeKeywords` | integer | Number of actively tracked keywords |
| `rankedKeywords` | integer | Keywords with a current ranking |
| `notRankedKeywords` | integer | Keywords without a current ranking |
| `averagePosition` | float/null | Average position across all ranked keywords |
| `positionChanges` | object | Position change counts: improved, declined, unchanged, new |
| `topKeywords` | array | Top 5 keywords by position (best rankings) |
| `alerts` | array | Significant drops and new rankings alerts |

### Response Example

```json
{
  "totalKeywords": 150,
  "activeKeywords": 145,
  "rankedKeywords": 120,
  "notRankedKeywords": 30,
  "averagePosition": 15.7,
  "positionChanges": {
    "improved": 12,
    "declined": 8,
    "unchanged": 95,
    "new": 5
  },
  "topKeywords": [
    { "keyword": "seo tools", "position": 3, "url": "https://example.com/seo-tools" },
    { "keyword": "keyword tracker", "position": 5, "url": "https://example.com/tracker" }
  ],
  "alerts": [
    { "type": "drop", "keyword": "rank checker", "oldPosition": 5, "newPosition": 15 },
    { "type": "new", "keyword": "seo analyzer", "position": 8 }
  ]
}
```

### Caching Strategy

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Cache TTL | 5 minutes | Dashboard data doesn't change frequently |
| Cache Key | `dashboard:{siteId}` | Site-specific cache key |
| Invalidation | On new ranking check | Cache cleared when new rankings are fetched |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum token authentication |
| Authorization | Site ownership check (user must own site) |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| XSS Prevention | JSON response encoding |
| Rate Limiting | Standard API rate limits apply |

### Error Responses

| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated (no valid bearer token) |
| 403 | Unauthorized (user does not own site) |
| 404 | Site not found |
| 405 | Method not allowed (non-GET requests) |

## Google Search Console Integration (FEAT-012)

### Feature Description
Complete Google Search Console (GSC) integration that imports click, impression, CTR, and average position data. Enables users to correlate ranking positions with real traffic metrics and identify high-impression/low-CTR keywords as optimization opportunities.

### Component Locations
- **OAuth Service:** `backend/app/Services/GSC/OAuthService.php`
- **Data Sync Service:** `backend/app/Services/GSC/GSCDataSync.php`
- **Query Matcher:** `backend/app/Services/GSC/QueryMatcher.php`
- **Connection Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/GSCConnectionController.php`
- **Data Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/GSCDataController.php`
- **Frontend Components:** `frontend/components/gsc/`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/GSC/`, `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/`

### Core Functionalities

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| OAuth Integration | Connect/disconnect GSC properties via Google OAuth 2.0 |
| Data Sync | Daily import of clicks, impressions, CTR, position |
| Fuzzy Matching | Associate GSC queries with tracked keywords |
| Opportunity Detection | Identify high-impression/low-CTR keywords |

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/gsc/connect` | Initiate OAuth flow |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/gsc/disconnect/{propertyId}` | Remove GSC connection |
| GET | `/api/v1/gsc/properties` | List connected properties |
| GET | `/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/gsc` | Get GSC data with date range |
| GET | `/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/gsc/opportunities` | Get opportunity keywords |

### Database Schema

**gsc_connections:**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT | Primary key |
| `user_id` | BIGINT | Foreign key to users |
| `site_url` | VARCHAR(500) | Site URL |
| `property_url` | VARCHAR(500) | GSC property URL |
| `access_token` | VARCHAR(2000) | OAuth access token |
| `refresh_token` | VARCHAR(2000) | OAuth refresh token |
| `token_expires_at` | TIMESTAMP | Token expiration |

**gsc_data:**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT | Primary key |
| `project_id` | BIGINT | Foreign key to projects |
| `query` | VARCHAR(255) | Search query |
| `clicks` | INT | Click count |
| `impressions` | INT | Impression count |
| `ctr` | FLOAT | Click-through rate |
| `avg_position` | FLOAT | Average position |
| `data_date` | DATE | Data date |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| OAuth Token Encryption | Tokens encrypted at rest |
| Token Refresh | Automatic refresh before expiration |
| Rate Limiting | Respects GSC API quotas |
| User Privacy | Per-property authorization |

## UnifiedPromptService for Prompt Building (TASK-31-4)

### Feature Description
Foundation service for the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031) that builds consolidated prompts containing all 17 SEO indicators for a single AI request. The `UnifiedPromptService` generates structured prompts with analysis requirements, JSON schema specification, and HTML content for the unified AI analysis pipeline.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/UnifiedPromptService.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/ai-prompts.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/UnifiedPromptServiceTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-31-4.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `buildPrompt(string $url, string $html, array $options): string` | Build complete unified prompt |
| `getPromptTemplate(): string` | Return the prompt template from config |
| `getIndicatorDefinitions(): array` | Return all 17 indicator definitions |
| `getJsonSchema(): array` | Return the expected response schema |
| `extractPageInfo(string $html): array` | Extract title and meta description from HTML |

### Prompt Structure

```markdown
# SEO Analysis Request

Analyze the following webpage for SEO quality. Return a JSON response with ALL indicator scores and an overall summary.

## Page Information
- URL: {url}
- Title: {title}
- Meta Description: {meta_description}

## HTML Content
```html
{truncated_html}
```

## Analysis Requirements

Score each indicator from 1-3 stars and provide specific suggestions:

### Indicators to Analyze:
1. **URL Structure** (weight: 0.08)
   - Check: HTTPS, length, keywords, readability
   
2. **Title Tag** (weight: 0.10)
   - Check: Presence, length (50-60 chars), keywords

[... all 17 indicators listed with criteria ...]

### Response Format (STRICT JSON)

```json
{
  "overall_score": 0-100,
  "overall_summary": "2-3 sentence executive summary",
  "category_scores": { "content": 0-100, "technical": 0-100, ... },
  "indicators": [{ "id": "...", "score": 1-3, "passed": bool, ... }],
  "top_priorities": [{ "indicator": "...", "message": "..." }]
}
```
```

### Indicator Definitions (17 Total)

| ID | Name | Weight | Category |
|----|------|--------|----------|
| `url` | URL Structure | 0.08 | Technical |
| `title_tag` | Title Tag | 0.10 | Content |
| `meta_description` | Meta Description | 0.08 | Content |
| `robots_txt` | Robots.txt | 0.05 | Technical |

| `favicon` | Favicon | 0.02 | Technical |
| `canonical` | Canonical URL | 0.05 | Technical |
| `social_meta` | Social Meta Tags | 0.05 | Content |
| `aria` | ARIA Labels | 0.05 | Accessibility |
| `page_speed` | Page Speed | 0.02 | Performance |

**Total Weight:** 1.00

### Config Structure

**config/ai-prompts.php:**
```php
return [
    'indicators' => [
        [
            'id' => 'url',
            'name' => 'URL Structure',
            'weight' => 0.08,

### JSON Schema

### Environment Variables

**Stripe Configuration:**
```
STRIPE_SECRET=sk_live_...
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_...
```

**PayPal Configuration:**
```
PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=<client_id>
PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=<client_secret>
PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID=<webhook_id>
PAYPAL_MODE=sandbox|live
PAYPAL_RETURN_URL=<return_url>
PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL=<cancel_url>
```

**OpenRouter Configuration:**
```
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<api_key>
```

### Transaction Flow

```
User selects package -> Payment Gateway (Stripe/PayPal)
      |
Payment processed -> Webhook received
      |
Credits added -> Transaction recorded
      |
User can use credits for AI analysis
```

### Security Measures

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Server-side validation | All amounts validated on server |
| Balance locking | `lockForUpdate()` during deductions |
| Race condition prevention | Database transactions with row locking |
| Idempotency | Payment webhooks check for duplicate processing |
| Webhook verification | Signature validation for Stripe/PayPal |
| Audit trail | Every balance change logged with metadata |

## Tools Infrastructure (TASK-16-1)

### Feature Description
Foundation infrastructure for the Interactive SEO Tools feature (FEAT-016) that enables server-side analysis of external URLs. Provides CORS proxy API endpoint, HTML parsing via Symfony DomCrawler, base SEO tool class architecture, URL validation with SSRF protection, and rate limiting infrastructure. This is the foundational layer that all interactive SEO tools build upon.

### Component Locations
- **API Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Tools/APIProxyController.php`
- **Base Tool Class:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/SEOTool.php`
- **HTML Parser Service:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/HtmlParserService.php`
- **URL Validation Service:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/URLValidationService.php`
- **Rate Limiting Service:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/ToolsRateLimitService.php`
- **Rate Limit Facade:** `backend/app/Services/RateLimitService.php`
- **Tool Result DTO:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/ToolResult.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Tools/ToolsRateLimitServiceTest.php` (64 tests)
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-16-1.md`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/tools/analyze` | Analyze external URL with specified tool |

**Request:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "tool": "meta-tag-analyzer"
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "url": "https://example.com",
    "analyzedAt": "2026-02-27T12:00:00Z",
    "tool": "meta-tag-analyzer",
    "results": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Base SEOTool Class

```php
abstract class SEOTool
{
    abstract public function name(): string;
    abstract public function analyze(Crawler $crawler, string $url): ToolResult;
    
    protected function fetchUrl(string $url): string;     // Via HtmlParserService
    protected function parseHtml(string $html): Crawler;  // Symfony DomCrawler
    protected function validateUrl(string $url): bool;    // Via URLValidationService
}
```

### URL Validation & SSRF Protection

| Protection | Implementation |
|------------|----------------|
| Localhost block | Blocks localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 |
| Private IP block | Blocks 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x |
| Cloud metadata block | Blocks 169.254.169.254 (AWS/GCP/Azure) |
| Protocol restriction | Only HTTP/HTTPS allowed |
| Port restriction | Standard ports only (80, 443, 8080, 8443) |

### Rate Limiting Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Requests per IP per 24h | 3 | Free tier limit |
| CAPTCHA bypass | Yes | reCAPTCHA verification unlocks additional requests |
| Tracking | Per IP | Stored in cache with 24-hour TTL |
| Response headers | `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Standard rate limit headers |

### Error Handling

| Error Code | HTTP Status | Description |
|------------|-------------|-------------|
| `invalid_url` | 400 | URL format validation failed |
| `blocked_url` | 403 | URL blocked by SSRF protection |
| `fetch_failed` | 502 | Unable to fetch external URL |
| `timeout` | 504 | Request timeout (30s total, 10s connection) |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Rate limit exceeded (includes `retry_after`) |
| `tool_error` | 500 | Tool-specific analysis error |

### Request Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Total timeout | 30 seconds | Maximum request duration |
| Connection timeout | 10 seconds | Connection establishment timeout |
| Max response size | 10 MB | Maximum HTML response size |
| User-Agent | `SEOIndicator-Tools/1.0` | Identifies requests |

### Tool Result DTO

```php
class ToolResult
{
    public bool $success;
    public array $data;
    public ?string $error;
    public int $processingTimeMs;
    
    public static function success(array $data, int $processingTimeMs): self;
    public static function error(string $error, int $processingTimeMs): self;
}
```

- **AnalysisJobResult Model:** `backend/app/Models/AnalysisJobResult.php`

| Casts | `started_at`, `completed_at`, `cancelled_at` → `datetime`; `total_indicators`, `completed_indicators`, `failed_indicators`, `progress_percent` → `integer` |

| Casts | `started_at`, `completed_at` → `datetime`; `score`, `max_score`, `percentage` → `decimal:2`; `processing_time_ms` → `integer`; `data`, `recommendations` → `array` |

| `isFailed()` | `bool` |

### Job Status Workflow

```
pending → running → completed
   │         │
   │         └──→ failed
   │
   └──────→ cancelled
```

### Factory States

**AnalysisJobFactory:**
| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `pending()` | Default state with `pending` status |
| `running()` | Sets status to `running`, sets `started_at` |
| `completed()` | Sets status to `completed`, calculates progress |
| `failed()` | Sets status to `failed`, adds error message |
| `cancelled()` | Sets status to `cancelled`, sets `cancelled_at` |

**AnalysisJobResultFactory:**
| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `pending()` | Default state with `pending` status |
| `running()` | Sets status to `running`, sets `started_at` |
| `completed()` | Sets status to `completed`, adds score/data |
| `failed()` | Sets status to `failed`, adds error message |
| `skipped()` | Sets status to `skipped` |

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `createJob(int $userId, int $siteId, array $indicators): AnalysisJob` | Creates job with pending results for each indicator |
| `getJob(int $jobId, ?int $userId): ?AnalysisJob` | Retrieves job with results loaded, supports user authorization |
| `getJobProgress(int $jobId, ?int $userId): ?array` | Returns progress data for API responses |
| `cancelJob(int $jobId, ?int $userId): bool` | Cancels pending/running jobs, marks incomplete results as skipped |
| `startJob(int $jobId): bool` | Transitions pending job to running, sets started_at |
| `completeJob(int $jobId): bool` | Marks job as completed, sets completed_at |
| `failJob(int $jobId, string $error): bool` | Marks job as failed with error message |
| `updateProgress(int $jobId): void` | Updates job progress based on completed results, auto-completes when done |
| `getPendingJobs(int $limit): Collection` | Gets pending jobs ready for processing |
| `getRunningJobs(): Collection` | Gets running jobs with pending results |
| `canUserAccessJob(int $userId, int $jobId): bool` | Authorization check for job access |
| `getAvailableIndicators(): array` | Returns all available indicator definitions |

### Job Status Workflow

```
pending → running → completed
   │         │
   │         └──→ failed
   │
   └──────→ cancelled
```

### Status Transition Rules

| Current Status | Can Transition To | Methods |
|----------------|-------------------|---------|
| `pending` | `running`, `cancelled` | `startJob()`, `cancelJob()` |
| `running` | `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` | `completeJob()`, `failJob()`, `cancelJob()` |
| `completed` | (terminal) | - |
| `failed` | (terminal) | - |
| `cancelled` | (terminal) | - |

[

    ],
]
```

## Job CRUD API Endpoints (TASK-19-4)

### Feature Description
REST API endpoints for the Progressive Analysis & Job System feature (FEAT-019) that provide job management operations including creation, listing, retrieval, and cancellation. Supports filtering by status with pagination, enforces authentication and authorization, and includes rate limiting for abuse prevention.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AnalysisJobController.php`
- **Resources:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/AnalysisJobResource.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/AnalysisJobResultResource.php`
- **Routes:** `backend/routes/api.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/AnalysisJobControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-19-4.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Rate Limit |
|--------|----------|-------------|------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/sites/{siteId}/analysis/jobs` | Create new analysis job | 10/hour |
| GET | `/api/v1/sites/{siteId}/analysis/jobs` | List jobs for site | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/analysis/jobs/{jobId}` | Get job progress with results | 60/min |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/analysis/jobs/{jobId}` | Cancel pending/running job | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/analysis/indicators` | Get available indicators | 60/min |

### Create Job Endpoint

**Request:**
```
POST /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/analysis/jobs
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "indicators": ["meta_tags", "headings", "images"]
}
```

**Validation Rules:**
| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `indicators` | Required, array, min 1 item, each must be valid indicator slug |

**Success Response (201):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "status": "pending",
    "totalIndicators": 3,
    "completedIndicators": 0,
    "failedIndicators": 0,
    "progressPercent": 0,
    "startedAt": null,
    "completedAt": null,
    "results": []
  }
}
```

### List Jobs Endpoint

**Request:**
```
GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/analysis/jobs?status=running&page=1&perPage=20
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `status` | string | - | Filter by status (pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled) |
| `page` | int | 1 | Page number |
| `perPage` | int | 20 | Items per page (max 100) |

**Success Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total": 10,
    "last_page": 1
  }
}
```

**Request:**

Authorization: Bearer {token}

**Success Response (200):**

## Progress Tracking and Updates (TASK-19-8)

### Feature Description
Progress tracking service for the Progressive Analysis & Job System feature (FEAT-019) that updates job state and broadcasts real-time progress events. Provides atomic database updates, automatic progress calculation, and event dispatching for Server-Sent Events (SSE) integration.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/ProgressService.php`
- **Events:**
  - `backend/app/Events/AnalysisProgressUpdated.php`
  - `backend/app/Events/AnalysisIndicatorComplete.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/ProgressServiceTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-19-8.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `updateProgress(int $jobId, string $indicatorSlug, float $score): void` | Updates job progress_percent after each indicator |
| `markComplete(int $jobId, string $indicatorSlug, IndicatorResult $result): void` | Marks indicator complete with result data |
| `markFailed(int $jobId, string $indicatorSlug, string $error): void` | Marks indicator failed with error message |
| `markRunning(int $jobId, string $indicatorSlug): void` | Marks indicator as currently processing |
| `isJobCancelled(int $jobId): bool` | Checks if job was cancelled by user |

### Progress Calculation

```
progress_percent = (completed_indicators / total_indicators) * 100
```

- Calculated automatically after each indicator completes
- Stored in `progress_percent` column on `analysis_jobs` table
- Updates are atomic (database transactions)

### Event Dispatching

#### AnalysisProgressUpdated Event

Broadcasts when job progress changes:

```php
class AnalysisProgressUpdated implements ShouldBroadcast
{
    public int $jobId;
    public int $completedIndicators;
    public int $totalIndicators;
    public float $progressPercent;
    public string $status;
    
    // Broadcasts on: private-analysis-job.{id}
}
```

#### AnalysisIndicatorComplete Event

Broadcasts when individual indicator completes:

```php
class AnalysisIndicatorComplete implements ShouldBroadcast
{
    public int $jobId;
    public string $indicatorSlug;
    public float $score;
    public float $percentage;
    public int $processingTimeMs;
    
    // Broadcasts on: private-analysis-job.{id}
}
```

### Broadcasting Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Channel | `private-analysis-job.{id}` | Private channel per job |
| Connection | `log` (MVP) | Currently logs events; configure Pusher/Reverb for WebSocket |
| Authorization | Job ownership | Users can only listen to their own jobs |

**Note:** For real-time WebSocket updates, configure `BROADCAST_CONNECTION` to use Pusher or Laravel Reverb in future iteration.

### Database Transaction Safety

All progress updates are wrapped in database transactions:

```php
DB::transaction(function () use ($jobId, $indicatorSlug, $result) {
    // 1. Update result record
    // 2. Update job progress_percent
    // 3. Dispatch event
});
```

### Integration Points

| Component | Integration |
|-----------|-------------|
| IndicatorProcessor | Calls `markRunning()` → `markComplete()` or `markFailed()` |
| Queue Worker | Checks `isJobCancelled()` before processing each indicator |
| SSE Endpoint | Listens to broadcast events for real-time streaming |
| Frontend | Subscribes to private channel for live updates |

## SSRF Protection Integration (TASK-19-15)

### Feature Description
Enhanced SSRF protection for the Progressive Analysis & Job System feature (FEAT-019) that extends the base URL validation service with DNS rebinding protection, redirect validation, and comprehensive security logging. Protects the analysis system's URL fetching from Server-Side Request Forgery attacks.

### Component Locations
- **URL Validation Service:** `backend/app/Services/URLValidationService.php`
- **Indicator Processor:** `backend/app/Services/Analysis/Indicators/IndicatorProcessor.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/SsrfProtectionTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-19-15.md`

### Security Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| DNS Rebinding Protection | Resolves DNS before connection, verifies resolved IP is not blocked |
| Redirect Validation | Re-checks URL after each redirect via `on_redirect` callback |
| IPv4-mapped IPv6 Detection | Blocks `::ffff:x.x.x.x` style addresses |
| URL-encoded Host Blocking | Decodes URL-encoded hosts before checking |
| Security Audit Logging | All blocked requests logged to `security.log` channel |
| Whitelist Support | Can exempt specific hosts from blocking |

### Blocked IP Ranges

| Range | CIDR | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| Localhost | 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 | Loopback addresses |
| Private (Class A) | 10.0.0.0/8 | Private network |
| Private (Class B) | 172.16.0.0/12 | Private network |
| Private (Class C) | 192.168.0.0/16 | Private network |
| Link-local | 169.254.0.0/16 | Link-local addresses |
| Link-local IPv6 | fe80::/10 | IPv6 link-local |
| Unique local | fc00::/7 | IPv6 private addresses |
| Cloud Metadata | 169.254.169.254 | AWS/GCP/Azure metadata |

### Blocked Hostnames

| Hostname | Reason |
|----------|--------|
| `localhost` | Local system |
| `localhost.localdomain` | Local system alias |
| `metadata.google.internal` | GCP metadata |
| `kubernetes.default` | Kubernetes internal |

### Protocol Restrictions

| Protocol | Allowed |
|----------|---------|
| http | ✅ Yes |
| https | ✅ Yes |
| file:// | ❌ No |
| ftp:// | ❌ No |
| gopher:// | ❌ No |
| ldap:// | ❌ No |
| Others | ❌ No |

### Alternative IP Notation Blocking

| Notation | Example | Blocked |
|----------|---------|---------|
| Decimal | 2130706433 (127.0.0.1) | ✅ Yes |
| Hexadecimal | 0x7f000001 (127.0.0.1) | ✅ Yes |
| Octal | 0177.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1) | ✅ Yes |
| Shorthand | 127.1 (127.0.0.1) | ✅ Yes |
| IPv4-mapped IPv6 | ::ffff:127.0.0.1 | ✅ Yes |

### Request Limits

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Max response size | 10 MB | Maximum response body size |
| Timeout | 30 seconds | Maximum request duration |
| Max redirects | 5 | Maximum redirect hops |

### Whitelist Configuration

```php
// Add host to whitelist
$urlValidationService->addToWhitelist('internal.example.com');

// Remove host from whitelist
$urlValidationService->removeFromWhitelist('internal.example.com');

// Get current whitelist
$whitelist = $urlValidationService->getWhitelist();
```

### Custom Blocking

```php
// Add custom blocked host
$urlValidationService->addBlockedHost('malicious.example.com');

// Add custom blocked IP range
$urlValidationService->addBlockedIP('10.100.0.0/16');
```

### Security Logging

All blocked requests are logged to the `security.log` channel with:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| URL | The blocked URL |
| IP | Resolved IP address |
| Reason | Block reason (private_ip, localhost, etc.) |
| Timestamp | When blocked |

| `getCompetitorById(id)` | Returns CompetitorData or null for invalid ID |
| `getComparisonBySlug(slug)` | Returns ComparisonData or null for invalid slug |
| `parseSlug(slug)` | Extracts competitor IDs from slug format |
| `generateComparisonData(a, b)` | Creates ComparisonData structure |
| `getRelatedComparisons(id)` | Returns array of related comparison slugs |
| `validateCompetitorData(data)` | Validates competitor data structure |
| `validateComparisonData(data)` | Validates comparison data structure |

### Registry Exports

| Export | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `COMPETITOR_REGISTRY` | `Record<string, CompetitorData>` | All competitor data indexed by ID |
| `COMPARISON_SLUGS` | `string[]` | All valid comparison URL slugs |
| `seoindicator` | `CompetitorData` | SEOIndicator competitor data |

### Competitor Data Structure

```typescript
interface CompetitorData {
  id: string;                    // 'ahrefs', 'semrush', etc.
  name: string;                  // Display name
  slug: string;                  // URL-safe name
  website: string;               // Official website
  logo?: string;                 // Logo URL (optional)
  tagline: string;               // Short description
  pricing: PricingTier[];
  features: FeatureCategory[];
  pros: string[];
  cons: string[];
  useCases: UseCase[];
  lastUpdated: string;           // ISO date for freshness tracking
  source: string;                // Data source attribution
}
```

### SEOIndicator Pricing Tiers

| Tier | Monthly Price | Annual Price | Features |
|------|---------------|--------------|----------|
| Free | $0 | $0 | Basic rank tracking, limited keywords |
| Pro | $29 | $290 | Full rank tracking, 500 keywords, site audit |
| Business | $79 | $790 | 2000 keywords, backlink analysis, API access |
| Agency | $199 | $1990 | Unlimited keywords, white-label, priority support |

### Validation Functions

**validateCompetitorData():**
- Checks required fields (id, name, slug, website, tagline, pricing, features, pros, cons, useCases, lastUpdated, source)
- Validates pricing array is non-empty with valid items
- Validates lastUpdated date format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Rejects negative prices
- Validates use case audience values

**validateComparisonData():**
- Checks required fields (slug, title, metaDescription, summary, verdict, competitors)
- Validates featureComparison, pricingComparison, prosCons, faqs arrays
- Validates slug format (`[a-z0-9-]+-vs-[a-z0-9-]+`)

### Error Handling

| Input | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Null slug | Returns `null` (no exception) |
| Invalid slug format | Returns `null` |
| Unknown competitor ID | Returns `null` |
| Missing competitor data | Returns `null` for comparison |

### Next.js 16 Compatibility

**Critical:** In Next.js 16, route params are Promises that must be awaited:

```typescript
// Correct (Next.js 16)
export default async function ComparisonPage({ params }: ComparisonPageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params;  // Await the promise
  const comparison = getComparisonBySlug(slug);
  // ...
}

// Props interface
export interface ComparisonPageProps {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;  // Promise, not direct object
}
```

### Feature Description
REST API endpoints for the Automated SEO Reports feature (FEAT-004) that provide report management operations including listing, viewing, and deleting generated reports. Supports filtering by status and type with pagination, and integrates with the report generation and download workflows.

### Component Locations

## Password Reset Flow (TASK-25-4)

### Feature Description
Password reset flow implementation for the Core Authentication feature (FEAT-025) that enables users to recover access to their accounts through a secure token-based email verification process. Provides forgot password and reset password endpoints with rate limiting, token expiration, and security measures to prevent email enumeration.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/PasswordResetController.php`
- **Requests:** 
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Auth/ForgotPasswordRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Auth/ResetPasswordRequest.php`
- **Notification:** `backend/app/Notifications/ResetPasswordNotification.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/PasswordResetControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-25-4.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/forgot-password` | Request password reset link |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/reset-password` | Reset password with token |

### Forgot Password Endpoint

**Request:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```

**Response (always same for security):**
```json
{
  "message": "If the email exists, a reset link has been sent."
}
```

**Features:**
- Email validation (required, valid format)
- Rate limiting: 1 request per email per 60 seconds
- Generic success response (no email enumeration)
- 429 response with `retry_after` field when rate limited

### Reset Password Endpoint

**Request:**
```json
{
  "token": "abc123...",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "newpassword123",
  "password_confirmation": "newpassword123"
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Password reset successful.",
  "token": "1|xyz789..."
}
```

**Validation Rules:**
| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `token` | Required, string |
| `email` | Required, email format |
| `password` | Required, min 8 chars, must contain letters and numbers |
| `password_confirmation` | Required, must match password |

**Security Actions on Reset:**
- Validates token (60-minute expiration)
- Clears `remember_token`
- Revokes all existing Sanctum tokens
- Creates new Sanctum token (7-day expiration)
- Fires `PasswordReset` event

### Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Token Expiration | 60 minutes | Time before reset link expires |
| Rate Limit | 1 per email per 60s | Prevents abuse |
| Password Min Length | 8 characters | Minimum password length |
| Password Requirement | Letters + numbers | Password complexity rule |

### Email Template

**ResetPasswordNotification:**
- Custom branded email layout
- Link format: `{FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password/{token}?email={email}`
- Shows 60-minute expiration time
- Uses Laravel's built-in token generation

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| No Email Enumeration | Same response for existing/non-existing emails |
| Rate Limiting | Cache-based, 60-second cooldown per email |
| Token Single-Use | Laravel invalidates token after use |
| Session Invalidation | All Sanctum tokens deleted on reset |
| Remember Token Clear | `remember_token` set to null |
| Token Expiration | 60-minute TTL |
| Password Strength | Min 8 chars, letters + numbers required |

## Email Verification (TASK-25-5)

### Feature Description
Email verification flow implementation for the Core Authentication feature (FEAT-025) that ensures newly registered users have valid email addresses. Provides secure verification through signed URLs with timing-safe hash comparison, rate-limited resend functionality, and seamless integration with Laravel's MustVerifyEmail interface.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/EmailVerificationController.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/User.php` (implements `MustVerifyEmail`)
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/EmailVerificationControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-25-5.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/auth/verify-email/{id}/{hash}` | Verify email via signed URL |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/resend-verification` | Resend verification email |

### Verify Email Endpoint

**URL Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | User ID |
| `hash` | string | SHA-256 hash of user's email |

**Required Middleware:**
- `signed` - Validates URL signature to prevent tampering

**Response Codes:**
| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 200 | Email verified successfully |
| 200 | Already verified (idempotent) |
| 403 | Invalid signature or hash |
| 404 | User not found |

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Email verified successfully."
}
```

**Already Verified Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Email already verified."
}
```

### Resend Verification Endpoint

**Authentication:** Required (Sanctum token)

**Response Codes:**
| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 200 | Verification email sent |
| 400 | Email already verified |
| 401 | Unauthenticated |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (1/minute) |

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Verification email sent."
}
```

**Rate Limit Headers:**
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Signed URL Validation | Laravel `signed` middleware prevents URL tampering |
| Timing-Safe Comparison | `hash_equals()` prevents timing attacks |
| IDOR Prevention | Hash tied to user's email address |
| Rate Limiting | 1 request per minute per user on resend |
| SQL Injection | Parameterized queries via Eloquent |
| Path Traversal | Route constraints block malicious inputs |

### Verification Flow

1. **Registration:** AuthController sends verification email after user creation
2. **Email Sent:** Laravel's built-in VerifyEmail notification with signed URL
3. **User Clicks Link:** Frontend redirects to API endpoint
4. **Signature Validation:** `signed` middleware validates URL integrity
5. **Hash Validation:** Controller compares hash with `hash_equals()`
6. **Email Marked Verified:** `markEmailAsVerified()` called on User model
7. **Event Dispatched:** Laravel `Verified` event fired

### User Model Integration

```php
class User extends Authenticatable implements MustVerifyEmail
{
    use Notifiable, Verifiable;
    
    // hasVerifiedEmail() - Check if verified
    // markEmailAsVerified() - Mark as verified
    // sendEmailVerificationNotification() - Send verification email
}
```

## AI Retry Policy (TASK-31-9)

### Feature Description
Comprehensive retry policy service for the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031) that implements intelligent retry decisions for AI requests. Provides exponential backoff with jitter, error classification, and rate limit handling for resilient AI API communication.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/RetryPolicy.php`
- **DTOs:** `backend/app/Services/AI/DTOs/RetryDecision.php`, `backend/app/Services/AI/DTOs/RetryStrategy.php`
- **Exceptions:** 
  - `backend/app/Exceptions/AI/RateLimitException.php`
  - `backend/app/Exceptions/AI/TimeoutException.php`
  - `backend/app/Exceptions/AI/ServiceUnavailableException.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/RetryPolicyTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-31-9.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `shouldRetry(Exception $e, int $attempt): bool` | Determine if request should be retried |
| `getDelayMs(int $attempt): int` | Calculate delay before next retry |
| `getMaxRetries(): int` | Return maximum retry count (3) |
| `isRetryableError(Exception $e): bool` | Check if error is retryable |
| `handleRateLimit(RateLimitException $e): RetryDecision` | Handle rate limit with Retry-After header |
| `getRetryStrategy(string $content, int $attempt): RetryStrategy` | Content-aware retry with truncation |

### Retry Configuration

| Constant | Value | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `MAX_RETRIES` | 3 | Maximum retry attempts |
| `BASE_DELAY_MS` | 1000 | Base delay (1 second) |
| `MAX_DELAY_MS` | 10000 | Maximum delay cap (10 seconds) |
| `JITTER_PERCENT` | 0.1 (10%) | Random jitter percentage |
| `MAX_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT_SECONDS` | 60 | Maximum wait for rate limit |
| `LARGE_CONTENT_THRESHOLD` | 50000 tokens | Threshold for content truncation |
| `TRUNCATION_RATIO` | 0.7 (70%) | Content retention on truncation |

### Retryable HTTP Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 429 | Rate limited |
| 500 | Internal server error |
| 502 | Bad gateway |
| 503 | Service unavailable |
| 504 | Gateway timeout |

### Non-Retryable HTTP Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 400 | Bad request |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 403 | Forbidden |
| 404 | Not found |
| 422 | Validation error |

### Exponential Backoff Formula

```
delay = min(BASE_DELAY_MS * 2^(attempt-1), MAX_DELAY_MS) ± jitter

Example delays:
- Attempt 1: 1000ms ± 10% (900-1100ms)
- Attempt 2: 2000ms ± 10% (1800-2200ms)
- Attempt 3: 4000ms ± 10% (3600-4400ms)
- Attempt 4+: 10000ms ± 10% (max capped)
```

### RetryDecision DTO

```php
class RetryDecision
{
    public bool $shouldRetry;
    public int $delayMs;
    public ?string $reason;
    
    public static function retry(int $delayMs): self;
    public static function fail(string $reason): self;
}
```

### RetryStrategy DTO

```php
class RetryStrategy
{
    public string $type; // 'standard' | 'with_truncation'
    public ?int $targetTokens;
    
    public static function standard(): self;
    public static function withTruncation(int $targetTokens): self;
}
```

### Rate Limit Handling

```php
// Respects Retry-After header up to 60 seconds max
public function handleRateLimit(RateLimitException $e): RetryDecision
{
    $retryAfter = $e->getRetryAfter();
    
    if ($retryAfter > 60) {
        return RetryDecision::fail('Rate limit exceeds acceptable wait time');
    }
    
    return RetryDecision::retry($retryAfter * 1000);
}
```

### Content-Aware Retry

```php
// Truncates large content on retry (attempt 2+)
public function getRetryStrategy(string $content, int $attempt): RetryStrategy
{
    $tokens = $this->contextManager->estimateTokens($content);
    
    if ($tokens > 50000 && $attempt > 1) {
        return RetryStrategy::withTruncation(
            targetTokens: (int) ($tokens * 0.7) // 30% reduction
        );
    }
    
    return RetryStrategy::standard();
}
```

### Retry Flow Diagram

```
Attempt 1 ──► Failure
    │
    ├─► Non-retryable (4xx) ──► Throw immediately
    │
    └─► Retryable (5xx, 429, timeout)
            │
            └─► Wait 1s ± jitter ──► Attempt 2 ──► Failure
                                            │
                                            └─► Wait 2s ± jitter ──► Attempt 3 ──► Failure
                                                                    │
                                                                    └─► Wait 4s ± jitter ──► Attempt 4
                                                                                            │
                                                                                            └─► Max retries ──► Throw
```

### Error Classification

| Exception Type | Retryable | Notes |
|----------------|-----------|-------|
| `RateLimitException` | ✅ Yes | Respects Retry-After header |
| `TimeoutException` | ✅ Yes | Network/processing timeout |
| `ServiceUnavailableException` | ✅ Yes | Temporary service outage |
| `ConnectionException` | ✅ Yes | Network connectivity issue |
| `HttpException (429)` | ✅ Yes | Rate limited |
| `HttpException (5xx)` | ✅ Yes | Server errors |
| `HttpException (4xx)` | ❌ No | Client errors fail fast |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| No sensitive data in logs | Exception class and retry count only |
| Graceful degradation | Returns failure decision instead of throwing |
| Bounded delays | Maximum 10 seconds between retries |
| Rate limit protection | Max 60 second wait for rate limits |

### Performance Characteristics

| Operation | Performance |
|-----------|-------------|
| `shouldRetry()` | < 1ms |
| `getDelayMs()` | < 1ms |
| `handleRateLimit()` | < 1ms |
| 1000 calls | < 100ms |

## Stripe Payment Intent Endpoint (TASK-26-9)

### Feature Description
REST API endpoint for the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026) that initiates Stripe payment flows for credit purchases. Creates a Stripe payment intent with client secret for frontend Stripe.js integration, validates credit packages, calculates bonus credits, and creates pending transaction records for webhook confirmation.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Payments/StripePaymentController.php`
- **Request:** `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Payments/CreateStripeIntentRequest.php`
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/StripeGatewayService.php`
- **Route:** `backend/routes/api.php` - `POST /api/v1/payments/stripe/intent`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/PaymentIntentControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-26-9.md`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/payments/stripe/intent` | Create Stripe payment intent for credit purchase |

### Request Body

```json
{
  "package_id": 2,
  "return_url": "https://example.com/credits/success"
}
```

### Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `package_id` | Required, integer, must exist in `credit_packages` table, must be active |
| `return_url` | Optional, URL format, max 500 characters |

### Response Format

**Success (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "client_secret": "pi_xxx_secret_xxx",
    "payment_intent_id": "pi_xxx",
    "amount": 10.00,
    "credits": 10.50,
    "package_name": "Basic"
  }
}
```

**Validation Error (422 Unprocessable Entity):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "errors": {
    "package_id": ["Invalid package selected"]
  }
}
```

**Inactive Package (400 Bad Request):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Invalid package selected"
}
```

**Stripe Error (500 Internal Server Error):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Payment could not be initiated"
}
```

### Business Logic

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Validate user is authenticated |
| 2 | Validate package exists and is active |
| 3 | Calculate credits: `base + (base * bonus_percent / 100)` |
| 4 | Create Stripe payment intent via gateway |
| 5 | Create pending `CreditTransaction` record with `payment_intent_id` |
| 6 | Return `client_secret` for frontend Stripe.js |

### Credit Calculation Formula

```php
$credits = $package->credits + ($package->credits * $package->bonus_percent / 100);
```

| Package | Base Credits | Bonus % | Effective Credits |
|---------|-------------|---------|-------------------|
| Basic ($10) | 10 | 5% | 10.50 |
| Pro ($90) | 100 | 20% | 120.00 |
| Enterprise ($500) | 1000 | 25% | 1250.00 |

### Idempotency

The endpoint prevents duplicate payment intents for the same user/package combination:

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Pending transaction exists for same user + package | Returns existing payment intent |
| Previous transaction completed or failed | Creates new payment intent |

### Transaction Storage

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `user_id` | Authenticated user ID |
| `amount` | Package price (USD) |
| `type` | `purchase` |
| `status` | `pending` |
| `payment_id` | Stripe payment intent ID |
| `payment_method` | `stripe` |
| `metadata.package_id` | Credit package ID |
| `metadata.credits` | Calculated credits including bonus |
| `metadata.return_url` | Optional return URL |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | `auth:sanctum` middleware (Bearer token) |
| Amount Validation | Package price read from database, never from request |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| XSS Prevention | Input validation, no HTML allowed |
| Idempotency | Check for existing pending transaction before creating |
| User Context | Payment intent created with authenticated user context |

### Error Responses

| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated (no valid bearer token) |
| 422 | Validation error (invalid/missing package_id, invalid return_url) |
| 400 | Inactive package selected |
| 500 | Stripe API error or internal server error |

## Job Timeout and Cancellation Handling (TASK-22-17)

### Feature Description
Robust timeout and cancellation handling for the Headless Crawler Service that prevents runaway processes and resource exhaustion. Implements configurable timeouts at multiple levels (job, page, browser, connection), user-initiated job cancellation via API, graceful shutdown flows, and partial results storage for interrupted jobs.

### Component Locations
- **Timeout Handler Service:** `backend/app/Services/Crawler/TimeoutHandlerService.php`
- **Cancellation Service:** `backend/app/Services/Crawler/CancellationService.php`
- **Partial Results Service:** `backend/app/Services/Crawler/PartialResultsService.php`
- **CrawlWorker Job:** `backend/app/Jobs/CrawlWorker.php`
- **API Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/CrawlController.php` - `destroy()` method
- **Configuration:** `backend/config/crawler.php` - `timeouts` array
- **Tests:**
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Config/TimeoutConfigTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Crawler/TimeoutHandlerServiceTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Crawler/CancellationServiceTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Crawler/PartialResultsServiceTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/CrawlCancellationTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Jobs/CrawlWorkerTimeoutTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TASK-22-17.md`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| DELETE | `/api/v1/crawler/jobs/{jobId}` | Cancel a running or queued crawl job |

**Success Response (202 Accepted):**
```json
{
  "jobId": "crawl-abc123",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "pagesCrawled": 3,
  "totalSize": 600000,
  "cancelledAt": "2026-03-01T10:00:30Z",
  "reason": "User requested cancellation",
  "partialContentUrl": "/api/v1/crawler/jobs/crawl-abc123/content"
}
```

### Timeout Configuration

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `job` | 300 seconds (5 min) | Maximum job duration |
| `page` | 30 seconds | Maximum page load time |
| `browser` | 60 seconds | Browser instance timeout |
| `connection` | 10 seconds | Connection establishment timeout |
| `grace_period` | 30 seconds | Grace time before hard kill |

**Configuration (config/crawler.php):**
```php
'timeouts' => [
    'job' => 300,        // 5 minutes
    'page' => 30,        // 30 seconds
    'browser' => 60,     // 60 seconds
    'connection' => 10,  // 10 seconds
    'grace_period' => 30, // Grace time before hard kill
]
```

### TimeoutHandlerService

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `startTracking(string $jobId, int $timeoutSeconds)` | Begin tracking job timing |
| `stopTracking(string $jobId)` | Stop tracking and clear state |
| `getElapsedSeconds(string $jobId): int` | Get elapsed time since start |
| `getRemainingSeconds(string $jobId): int` | Get remaining time before timeout |
| `isApproachingTimeout(string $jobId): bool` | Check if within grace period |
| `shouldStartGracefulShutdown(string $jobId): bool` | Determine if graceful shutdown needed |
| `canContinueCrawling(string $jobId): bool` | Check if job has time remaining |
| `hasTimeForNextPage(string $jobId): bool` | Check if enough time for another page |
| `isPageTimeout(Carbon $startTime, int $pageTimeout): bool` | Check page-level timeout |

### CancellationService

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `requestCancellation(string $jobId, string $reason): bool` | Set cancellation flag in cache |
| `isCancellationRequested(string $jobId): bool` | Check if cancellation was requested |
| `shouldCancel(string $jobId): bool` | Alias for isCancellationRequested |
| `canCancel(string $status): bool` | Check if job status allows cancellation |
| `clearCancellationFlag(string $jobId): void` | Remove cancellation flag |
| `clearAllCancellationData(string $jobId): void` | Clear all cancellation-related cache |

**Cache Strategy:**
- Cancellation flags stored in Laravel cache
- TTL matches job timeout duration
- Atomic cache operations for race condition prevention

### PartialResultsService

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `storePartialResults(CrawlJob $job, string $reason): void` | Store partial results with reason |
| `formatPartialResults(CrawlJob $job): array` | Format partial results for API response |

**Partial Results Structure:**
```json
{
  "pages": [...],
  "reason": "Job completed with partial results (timeout reached)",
  "storedAt": "2026-03-01T10:05:00Z",
  "totalPages": 8
}
```

### Job Status Response (Cancelled)

```json
{
  "jobId": "crawl-abc123",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "pagesCrawled": 3,
  "totalSize": 600000,
  "cancelledAt": "2026-03-01T10:00:30Z",
  "reason": "User requested cancellation",
  "partialContentUrl": "/api/v1/crawler/jobs/crawl-abc123/content"
}
```

### Job Status Response (Timeout)

```json
{
  "jobId": "crawl-abc123",
  "status": "completed",
  "pagesCrawled": 8,
  "totalSize": 1500000,
  "completedAt": "2026-03-01T10:05:00Z",
  "reason": "Job completed with partial results (timeout reached)",
  "partialContentUrl": "/api/v1/crawler/jobs/crawl-abc123/content"
}
```

### Timeout Handling Flow

```
Job starts → Record start time
    │
    ↓
Before each page → Check elapsed time
    │
    ├─► Elapsed > timeout - grace_period → Start graceful shutdown
    │
    ├─► Elapsed > timeout → Force termination
    │
    └─► Store partial results → Update job status
```

### Cancellation Flow

```
User requests cancellation (DELETE /api/v1/crawler/jobs/{id})
    │
    ↓
Set cancellation flag in cache
    │
    ↓
Worker checks flag before each page
    │
    ├─► Flag set → Stop gracefully
    │
    └─► Close browser → Store partial results → Set status 'cancelled'
```

### Resource Cleanup on Timeout/Cancel

| Resource | Cleanup Action |
|----------|---------------|
| Browser instance | Closed in finally block |
| Queue slot | Released automatically |
| Rate limit tokens | Cleared via RateLimitService |
| Temporary files | Removed on completion |
| URL locks | Unlocked via LockService |

### Worker Process Monitoring

| Monitoring | Implementation |
|------------|----------------|
| Zombie detection | Process supervisors (supervisor/systemd) |
| Browser cleanup | Kill browser processes if worker dies |
| Process logging | Log process start/stop events |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum token authentication |
| Authorization | Job ownership check via policy |
| Rate Limiting | Cancellation endpoint rate limited |
| Input Validation | Job ID validated, status checked |

## Public Audit Page Route (TASK-33-14)

### Feature Description
Public-facing Next.js App Router route for the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033). Implements a query parameter route (`/audit/?h={hash}`) compatible with static export, enabling users to share SEO audit results via unique URLs. Includes ISR-equivalent behavior through client-side data fetching, SEO metadata generation, and comprehensive 404 handling.

### Component Locations
- **Page Component:** `frontend/app/audit/page.tsx` - Main page with Suspense boundary
- **Client Component:** `frontend/app/audit/AuditPageClient.tsx` - Client-side data fetching with useSearchParams()
- **Layout:** `frontend/app/audit/layout.tsx` - Layout wrapper (no auth required)
- **Legacy Redirect:** `frontend/app/audit/[hash]/page.tsx`, `frontend/app/audit/[hash]/LegacyAuditRedirect.tsx`
- **Not Found State:** Client-side `NotFoundState` component within `AuditPageClient.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/audit/page.test.tsx`, `frontend/__tests__/app/audit/[hash]/page.test.tsx`, `frontend/__tests__/app/audit/[hash]/metadata.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-14.md`

### Route Architecture

| URL Pattern | Purpose | Implementation |
|-------------|---------|----------------|
| `/audit/?h={hash}` | Main public audit route | Static page with client-side fetch |
| `/audit/{hash}/` | Legacy route (placeholder only) | Client-side redirect to query format |
| `/audit/_/` | Static placeholder for SSG | Generated via generateStaticParams() |

**Architecture Decision:** Query parameter approach chosen over dynamic route (`/audit/[hash]/`) due to static export compatibility. With `output: 'export'`, dynamic routes require `generateStaticParams()` which cannot pre-generate runtime-generated audit hashes.

### Client-Side Data Flow

```
Page Load → useSearchParams() extracts hash
    │
    ↓
LoadingState renders
    │
    ↓
fetch('/api/v1/public-audit/{hash}')
    │
    ├─► Success → PublicAuditPage renders with data
    │
    └─► Error/Not Found → NotFoundState renders
```

### API Endpoint Used

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/public-audit/{hash}` | Fetch public audit data by hash |

**Response (Success):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "siteUrl": "https://example.com",
    "auditedAt": "2026-03-16T10:00:00Z",
    "overallScore": 85,
    "categoryScores": [...],
    "topIssues": [...]
  }
}
```

**Response (Not Found):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Audit not found"
}
```

### SEO Implementation

**Client-Side Metadata Update:**
```typescript
// Dynamic title update via DOM manipulation
document.title = `SEO Audit: ${siteUrl} - Score ${score}/100 | SEOIndicator`;

// Meta description update
const metaDescription = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
if (metaDescription) {
  metaDescription.setAttribute('content', `SEO audit for ${siteUrl} - Score: ${score}/100`);
}
```

**Canonical URL:** Set via `<link rel="canonical">` in layout

### Not Found Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Invalid hash format | API returns 404, NotFoundState renders |
| Non-existent audit | API returns 404, NotFoundState renders |
| Private/unpublished audit | API returns 404, NotFoundState renders |
| Network error | NotFoundState renders with retry option |

**NotFoundState Component:**
- User-friendly error message
- "Go Home" button linking to `/`
- "Get Your Free Audit" CTA linking to `/tools`
- Contact support link
- Dark theme consistent with app design

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Hash validation | 32-char alphanumeric format validated by API |
| No ID enumeration | Hash is random UUID, not derived from audit ID |
| XSS Prevention | React's default escaping, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML |
| CSRF | Not applicable (public read-only endpoint) |
| Rate Limiting | Handled at API level |

### Architecture Evolution History

**Initial Implementation (Failed):**
- Dynamic route `/audit/[hash]/` with ISR
- Failed with `output: 'export'` - `generateStaticParams()` required but audit hashes are runtime-generated

**Second Attempt (Failed):**
- Client-side component with placeholder `generateStaticParams()`
- Only `/audit/_/` generated, other hashes returned Hostinger 404
- Client component never ran for actual hashes

**Final Solution (Success):**
- Query parameter route `/audit/?h={hash}`
- Fully static page at `/audit/` that reads hash from URL params
- Client-side data fetching via `useSearchParams()` and `fetch()`
- Compatible with static export architecture

## PublicAudit Model (TASK-33-4)

### Feature Description
Core model for the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033) that handles public audit data retrieval, hash generation, and visibility management. This is the foundation model enabling users to share SEO audit results publicly via unique URLs.

### Component Locations
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/PublicAudit.php`
- **Related Model:** `backend/app/Models/Audit.php` (contains `publicAudit` relationship)
- **Migration:** `backend/database/migrations/xxxx_create_public_audits_table.php`
- **Factory:** `backend/database/factories/PublicAuditFactory.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Models/PublicAuditTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-4.md`

### Database Schema

**public_audits table:**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT | Primary key |
| `audit_id` | BIGINT | Foreign key to audits |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(32) | Unique 32-char alphanumeric hash |
| `visibility` | ENUM | 'private' or 'public' |
| `public_hash_created_at` | TIMESTAMP | When hash was generated |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | Record creation time |
| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | Record update time |

### Model Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `generateHash()` | string | Creates 32-char alphanumeric cryptographic random string |
| `publish()` | void | Sets visibility='public', generates hash, sets timestamp |
| `unpublish()` | void | Sets visibility='private', clears hash |
| `isPublic()` | bool | Checks if visibility is 'public' |
| `findByHash(string $hash)` | ?PublicAudit | Retrieves public audit by hash or null |

### Model Relationships

| Method | Type | Related Model |
|--------|------|---------------|
| `audit()` | BelongsTo | `Audit` |

### Query Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `scopePublic($query)` | Filter only public audits |
| `scopePrivate($query)` | Filter only private audits |
| `scopeWithHash($query)` | Filter audits with hash |

### Hash Generation

**Characteristics:**
- 32 characters alphanumeric (a-z, A-Z, 0-9)
- Cryptographically random via `Str::random(32)`
- NOT derived from audit ID (prevents enumeration)
- Collision detection with automatic regeneration

**Uniqueness Guarantee:**
```php
public function generateHash(): string
{
    do {
        $hash = Str::random(32);
    } while (self::where('public_hash', $hash)->exists());
    
    return $hash;
}
```

### Publish/Unpublish Flow

**Publish:**
```php
DB::transaction(function () use ($publicAudit) {
    $publicAudit->public_hash = $publicAudit->generateHash();
    $publicAudit->visibility = 'public';
    $publicAudit->public_hash_created_at = now();
    $publicAudit->save();
});
```

**Unpublish:**
```php
$publicAudit->update([
    'visibility' => 'private',
    'public_hash' => null,
    'public_hash_created_at' => null,
]);
```

### Factory States

| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `published()` | Public audit with hash |
| `unpublished()` | Private audit |
| `withHash($hash)` | Custom hash |
| `forAudit($audit)` | Link to specific audit |
| `publishedAt($date)` | Time-based testing |
| `publishedDaysAgo($days)` | Aging tests |
| `recentlyPublished()` | Fresh public audit |
| `oldHash()` | Long-published audit |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Hash Randomness | `Str::random(32)` - cryptographically secure |
| No ID Enumeration | Hash NOT derived from audit ID |
| Collision Prevention | Loop checks for existing hash |
| Transaction Safety | `publish()` wrapped in database transaction |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |

### Accessor Methods

| Accessor | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `public_url` | Returns full public URL: `https://seoindicator.com/audit/?h={hash}` |

## SPA Authentication Contract (TASK-35-26)

### Feature Description
Production authentication contract for the Single Page Application (SPA) frontend that enables persistent login state for protected routes including Local SEO pages (`/sites/{siteId}/local`). Implements localStorage + bearer token fallback to ensure authenticated sessions survive page reloads and navigation.

### Component Locations
- **Frontend Auth Context:** `frontend/lib/contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
- **Frontend Auth API:** `frontend/lib/api/auth.ts`
- **Backend Auth Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AuthController.php`
- **Frontend Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/contexts/AuthContext.production-spa-auth.test.tsx`, `frontend/__tests__/lib/api/auth.production-routing.test.ts`
- **Backend Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/Api/V1/AuthControllerTest.php`

### Authentication Mode
**localStorage + Bearer Token Fallback**

The production SPA uses a bearer-token backed fallback authentication strategy rather than pure Sanctum session cookies. This ensures the SPA can maintain authenticated state even when session-based auth returns 401.

### Auth Flow

| Action | Endpoint | Response | LocalStorage |
|--------|----------|----------|--------------|
| Register | `POST /api/v1/auth/register` | 201 with `data.token` + user | `seoindicator_user`, `seoindicator_token` |
| Login | `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | 200 with `data.token` + user | `seoindicator_user`, `seoindicator_token` |
| Get User | `GET /api/v1/auth/user` | 200 JSON (Bearer auth) | Reads from `seoindicator_token` |
| Logout | `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` | 200 | Clears `seoindicator_user`, `seoindicator_token` |

### Token Storage

| Key | Type | Purpose |
|-----|------|---------|
| `seoindicator_user` | JSON string | Cached user object |
| `seoindicator_token` | String | Bearer token for API auth |
| `seoindicator_redirect` | String | Post-login redirect path |

### Protected Route Behavior

1. **Hydration:** On protected route load, AuthContext checks for `seoindicator_user` and `seoindicator_token`
2. **Token Present:** If token exists, user stays authenticated even if `/api/v1/auth/user` returns 401
3. **Token Absent:** If no token, redirects to `/login`
4. **Logout:** Clears both localStorage keys and calls logout endpoint

### API Response Format

**Login/Register Success:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "user": { "id": 1, "name": "...", "email": "..." },
    "token": "1|abcdef123456..."
  }
}
```

**Get User Success (Bearer Auth):**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "...",
  "email": "..."
}
```

### Key Implementation Details

| Component | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| `AuthContext` | Preserves stored user when bearer token exists but `/auth/user` returns unauthenticated |
| `auth.ts` | Does not tear down `seoindicator_token` on 401 from `/auth/user`; lets protected APIs decide |
| `AuthController@register` | Returns `data.token` alongside user payload |
| `AuthController@login` | Returns `data.token` alongside user payload |

### Root Cause Fix (2026-03-10)

**Problem:** Registration endpoint returned only user payload without bearer token. SPA appeared authenticated immediately after register but `seoindicator_token` was empty, causing next protected-route hydration to clear auth and redirect to `/login`.

**Solution:** Updated `AuthController.php` to mint and return Sanctum bearer token on registration, matching the login response shape (`data.token`).

## Production Business Location API 500 Fix (TASK-35-27)

### Feature Description
Production hardening fix for the `GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/locations` endpoint. The endpoint was returning 500 HTML server error pages instead of proper JSON responses due to schema drift on the `business_locations` table. The fix implements defensive schema drift tolerance for missing `is_active` and `deleted_at` columns.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationService.php`
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/BusinessLocationController.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-27.md`
- **Backend Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationControllerProductionRegressionTest.php`
- **Service Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationServiceTest.php`
- **Frontend Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/local/LocationManagementPage.endpoint-states.test.tsx`

### Root Cause
The production database schema was missing columns that the API code expected:
- `business_locations.is_active` - Used for `active_only` query scope
- `business_locations.deleted_at` - Used for soft-delete filtering

When the service attempted to query these columns on a schema that lacked them, Laravel threw an exception resulting in 500 HTML error pages.

### Solution

**Schema Drift Tolerance in BusinessLocationService:**
- Modified `active_only` queries to first check if `is_active` column exists
- Modified queries to tolerate missing `deleted_at` column
- Added fallback behavior when columns are missing

**Hardening Pattern:**
```php
// Check for column existence before querying
if (Schema::hasColumn('business_locations', 'is_active')) {
    $query->where('is_active', true);
}

// Soft delete tolerance
if (Schema::hasColumn('business_locations', 'deleted_at')) {
    $query->whereNull('deleted_at');
}
```

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/sites/{siteId}/locations` | List business locations for a site |

### Production Validation Results

| Scenario | Expected | Actual | Status |
|----------|----------|--------|--------|
| Guest request | 401 JSON | `{"message":"Unauthenticated."}` | ✅ |
| Auth request to non-owned site | 403 JSON | `{"message":"This action is unauthorized."}` | ✅ |
| Auth request to missing site (999999) | 404 JSON | `{"message":"No query results for model..."}` | ✅ |
| Frontend page `/sites/1/local/` | 200 HTML | Renders loading state | ✅ |

### Response Codes

| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 200 | Successful list (may be empty) |
| 401 | Unauthenticated request |
| 403 | User does not own site |
| 404 | Site not found |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Authentication | `auth` middleware |
| Authorization | Site ownership via `site->user_id` |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| Schema Drift | Defensive column checks |

| `user_id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | No | - | FK to users.id |

| `alert_type` | VARCHAR(50) | No | - | Alert category |
| `severity` | VARCHAR(20) | No | - | Alert severity (info, warning, critical) |

| `data` | JSON | Yes | NULL | Additional alert payload |

**Foreign Keys:** `user_id` → `users.id` (CASCADE), `location_id` → `business_locations.id` (CASCADE)

### Migration Order

Tables must be created in this order due to foreign key dependencies:

1. `business_locations` (depends on `users`, `sites`)
2. `gbp_insights` (depends on `business_locations`)
3. `gbp_reviews` (depends on `business_locations`)
4. `local_rankings` (depends on `business_locations`, `keywords`)
5. `local_competitors` (depends on `business_locations`)
6. `gbp_posts` (depends on `business_locations`)
7. `local_seo_alerts` (depends on `users`, `business_locations`)

### Technical Decisions

| Decision | Rationale |
|----------|-----------|
| DECIMAL(10,8) for latitude | Provides ~1.1mm precision for GPS coordinates (-90 to 90 range) |
| DECIMAL(11,8) for longitude | Same precision for -180 to 180 range |
| JSON columns for flexible data | Allows schema evolution without migrations for settings, competitors_in_pack, data |
| Soft deletes on business_locations only | Preserves location data for historical analysis |
| ON DELETE CASCADE on all FKs | Prevents orphan records and maintains referential integrity |
| Unique constraint on (location_id, insights_date) | Ensures one insights record per location per day |

| `longitude` | `decimal:8` | Preserves coordinate precision for maps/search |
| `gbp_connected` | `boolean` | Used by helper/accessor methods |
| `gbp_token_expires_at` | `datetime` | Enables `isFuture()` / `isPast()` token checks |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | Backed by the active/inactive location flag |
| `settings` | `array` | JSON payload is exposed as a PHP array |

**Hidden attributes:** `gbp_access_token`, `gbp_refresh_token`

GBP credentials are intentionally excluded from `toArray()` / `toJson()` serialization so API responses and debug output do not leak secrets.

### Model Relationships

| Method | Relationship | Backing Table / Model | Notes |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------|-------|
| `user()` | `belongsTo` | `App\Models\User` | Location owner |
| `site()` | `belongsTo` | `App\Models\Site` | Parent site/account context |
| `alerts()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\LocalSEOAlert` | Local SEO alert inbox items |
| `localRankings()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\LocalRanking` | Raw ranking snapshots |
| `rankings()` | `hasMany` alias | `App\Models\LocalRanking` | Acceptance-criteria friendly alias |
| `localCompetitors()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\LocalCompetitor` | Raw competitor records |
| `competitors()` | `hasMany` alias | `App\Models\LocalCompetitor` | Acceptance-criteria friendly alias |
| `reviews()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\GBPReview` | GBP review records |
| `insights()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\GBPInsight` | Daily GBP insight snapshots with dedicated scopes/helpers |
| `posts()` | `hasMany` | `App\Models\GBPPost` | GBP posts with publication/scheduling helpers |

### Query Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `active()` | Returns only locations with `is_active = true` |
| `gbpConnected()` | Returns only locations with `gbp_connected = true` |
| `connected()` | Alias of `gbpConnected()` for acceptance-criteria compatibility |
| `forUser($userId)` | Filters locations by owning user |

### Accessors and Helper Methods

| Method / Accessor | Return Type | Description |
|-------------------|-------------|-------------|
| `google_location_id` | `?string` | Alias accessor for `gbp_place_id` |
| `is_gbp_connected` | `bool` | Alias accessor for `gbp_connected` |
| `full_address` | `string` | Human-friendly `name - address` label, omitting blanks |
| `coordinates` | `?array{lat: float, lng: float}` | Convenience map payload for frontend/API use |
| `hasConnectedGBP()` | `bool` | Boolean helper around GBP connection status |
| `hasValidGBPToken()` | `bool` | Requires a non-empty access token and a future expiry |
| `getMapsUrl()` | `string` | Builds a Google Maps URL using place ID first, coordinates second, text search fallback last |
| `getSettingsValue($key, $default = null)` | `mixed` | Reads nested settings safely via `data_get()` |

### Lifecycle Behavior

#### Soft Deletes and Dependent Cleanup
`BusinessLocation` uses `SoftDeletes`, so deleting the parent row preserves the location record in `business_locations.deleted_at`. During the `deleting` lifecycle hook, the model explicitly removes dependent child records from tables that do **not** themselves use soft deletes:

- `local_seo_alerts`
- `local_rankings`
- `local_competitors`
- `gbp_reviews`
- `gbp_insights`
- `gbp_posts`

This keeps the soft-deleted location recoverable while preventing orphan child rows.

#### Defensive Mutators
The model also normalizes a few nullable test/runtime inputs:
- `setGbpConnectedAttribute()` defaults null values to `false`
- `setIsActiveAttribute()` defaults null values to `true`
- `setNameAttribute()` normalizes null names to an empty string
- `setIsGbpConnectedAttribute()` maps the alias field to `gbp_connected`

### Factory Behavior

**Factory:** `Database\Factories\BusinessLocationFactory`

| State / Behavior | Description |
|------------------|-------------|
| default | Creates a fresh `User` and a `Site` owned by that same user, keeping ownership aligned |
| `inactive()` | Sets `is_active = false` |
| `withGbp()` | Sets `gbp_connected = true`, ensures a place ID exists, and generates token + expiry data |
| `withoutGbp()` | Clears place ID and token fields and forces `gbp_connected = false` |
| `configure()` hooks | `afterMaking` and `afterCreating` keep `site.user_id` and `location.user_id` internally consistent |

The default dataset uses realistic address, category, phone, website, coordinate, and settings values so downstream tests can exercise real-world shapes without additional setup.
