### Health Status Definitions

| Status | Description | Conditions |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| `healthy` | All systems operational | All checks pass, no warnings |
| `degraded` | Partial functionality | Some checks failing or thresholds exceeded |
| `unhealthy` | Critical issues | Core services unavailable |

### Thresholds and Alerts

| Metric | Warning | Critical | Alert |
|--------|---------|----------|-------|
| Database latency | > 50ms | > 100ms | Yellow/Red indicator |
| Queue pending | > 100 | > 500 | Degraded/Unhealthy |
| Queue failed | > 0 | > 10 | Yellow/Red highlight |
| Cache hit rate | < 90% | < 70% | Degraded/Unhealthy |
| DB connections | > 80% | > 95% | Warning/Critical |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum (`auth:sanctum` middleware) |
| Authorization | Role-based (`role:admin` middleware) |
| Rate Limiting | Throttle middleware (60 requests/minute) |
| Input Validation | No user input accepted (read-only endpoints) |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |

### Error Responses

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated - Valid token required |
| 403 | Forbidden - Admin role required |
| 500 | Server Error - Health check failed |

## ScoreOverview Component (TASK-33-9)

### Component Description
Hero visual component for public audit pages that displays a large circular score indicator with color coding and status text. This is the primary visual element that immediately communicates the SEO score to visitors viewing public audit reports. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/audit/ScoreOverview.tsx`
- **Export Index:** `frontend/components/audit/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/audit/ScoreOverview.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-9.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Circular Progress Indicator | SVG-based circular progress (0-100) using stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset |
| Score Color Coding | 5 distinct color ranges (Green/Blue/Yellow/Orange/Red) |
| Status Text | Dynamic status labels (Excellent/Good/Needs Work/Poor/Critical Issues) |
| Site URL Display | Shows audited site URL with icon |
| Audit Date Display | Shows when the audit was performed with icon |
| CTA Button | "Get your free audit" button linking to /audit |
| Animation | Optional animated progress fill |
| Responsive Sizing | Three size variants (sm/md/lg) |
| Accessibility | Full ARIA support with screen reader labels |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface ScoreOverviewProps {
  score: number;              // 0-100, automatically clamped
  siteUrl: string;            // URL of audited site
  auditDate: string;          // Date string for display
  className?: string;         // Optional CSS classes
  animate?: boolean;          // Default: true
  showCta?: boolean;          // Default: true
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';  // Default: 'md'
}
```

### Score Color Mapping

| Score Range | Color | Hex | Status Text |
|-------------|-------|-----|-------------|
| 90-100 | Green | #22c55e | Excellent |
| 70-89 | Blue | #3b82f6 | Good |
| 50-69 | Yellow | #eab308 | Needs Work |
| 30-49 | Orange | #f97316 | Poor |
| 0-29 | Red | #ef4444 | Critical Issues |

### Responsive Sizing

| Size | Dimensions | Stroke Width | Font Size |
|------|------------|--------------|-----------|
| `sm` | 120x120px | 8px | Small |
| `md` | 180x180px | 12px | Base |
| `lg` | 240x240px | 16px | Large |

### SVG Implementation Details

The circular progress uses SVG circles with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset:

```typescript
// Progress calculation
const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score)) / 100;
const strokeDashoffset = circumference * (1 - progress);
```

## Badge.js Embed Script (TASK-33-16)

### Component Description
JavaScript embed script for displaying interactive SEO score badges on third-party websites. Enables users to embed badges on their sites via a simple script tag with data attributes, providing viral distribution and brand visibility for SEOIndicator. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **TypeScript Source:** `frontend/lib/scripts/badge.ts`
- **Build Script:** `frontend/scripts/build-badge.mjs`
- **Production Files:**
  - `https://seoindicator.com/badge.js` (unminified, 16,626 bytes)
  - `https://seoindicator.com/badge.min.js` (minified, 9,256 bytes, 3.52KB gzip)
  - `https://seoindicator.com/badge.min.js.map` (source map)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/scripts/badge.test.ts`, `frontend/__tests__/scripts/badge-umd.test.ts`, `frontend/__tests__/scripts/badge-build.test.ts`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-16.md`

### Usage

#### Auto-Initialization (Recommended)
```html
<div data-seoindicator-badge="abc123" data-size="medium" data-theme="light"></div>
<script src="https://seoindicator.com/badge.min.js" async></script>
```

#### Manual Initialization
```html
<div id="badge-container"></div>
<script src="https://seoindicator.com/badge.min.js"></script>
<script>
  SEOIndicatorBadge.init({
    auditId: 'abc123',
    size: 'medium',
    theme: 'light',
    container: '#badge-container'
  });
</script>
```

### Embed Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `data-seoindicator-badge` | string | 32-char hash | (required) | Public audit hash |
| `data-size` | string | `small`, `medium`, `large` | `medium` | Badge dimensions |
| `data-theme` | string | `light`, `dark` | `light` | Color theme |
| `data-no-tracking` | boolean | `true`, `false` | `false` | Disable impression/click tracking |

### Badge Sizes

| Size | Dimensions | Use Case |
|------|------------|----------|
| `small` | 120x40px | Inline in blog posts, footer links |
| `medium` | 150x100px | Sidebar widgets, about pages |
| `large` | 300x150px | Footer widgets, partner pages |

### Theme Colors

| Theme | Background | Text | Use Case |
|-------|------------|------|----------|
| `light` | #ffffff | #1a1a1a | Light-themed websites |
| `dark` | #1a1a1a | #ffffff | Dark-themed websites |

### Score Color Coding

| Score Range | Color | Status |
|-------------|-------|--------|
| 90-100 | #22c55e (green) | Excellent |
| 70-89 | #3b82f6 (blue) | Good |
| 50-69 | #eab308 (yellow) | Needs Work |
| 30-49 | #f97316 (orange) | Poor |
| 0-29 | #ef4444 (red) | Critical Issues |

### JavaScript API

```javascript
// Initialize a badge
SEOIndicatorBadge.init({
  auditId: 'abc123',      // Required: public audit hash
  size: 'medium',         // Optional: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'
  theme: 'light',         // Optional: 'light' | 'dark'
  container: '#my-badge', // Optional: CSS selector or element
  refreshInterval: 86400, // Optional: Auto-refresh interval (seconds)
  noTracking: false       // Optional: Disable tracking
});

// Refresh a specific badge (or all if no ID)
SEOIndicatorBadge.refresh('abc123');

// Change theme dynamically
SEOIndicatorBadge.setTheme('dark', 'abc123'); // Specific badge
SEOIndicatorBadge.setTheme('dark');           // All badges

// Destroy all badges and clean up
SEOIndicatorBadge.destroy();

// Restore previous global variable (UMD compatibility)
var myBadge = SEOIndicatorBadge.noConflict();
```

### API Version

```javascript
SEOIndicatorBadge.VERSION; // "1.0.0"
```

### Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Auto-init on DOMContentLoaded | Scans DOM for `data-seoindicator-badge` attributes |
| Lazy impression tracking | IntersectionObserver for visibility detection |
| Auto-refresh | Configurable interval (default: 24 hours) |
| Error handling | "Badge unavailable" state with retry |
| XSS prevention | HTML entity escaping for all dynamic content |
| CORS handling | `credentials: 'omit'` for cross-origin requests |
| Retry logic | Exponential backoff (3 attempts, 10s timeout) |
| UMD compatibility | Works with AMD, CommonJS, and browser globals |

### Loading States

1. **Loading**: Spinner animation while fetching badge config
2. **Success**: Score display with color-coded background
3. **Error**: "Badge unavailable" message with retry option

### Tracking

| Event | Trigger | Endpoint |
|-------|---------|----------|
| Impression | Badge enters viewport (IntersectionObserver) | `POST /api/v1/badge/impression` |
| Click | User clicks badge | `POST /api/v1/badge/click` |

**Privacy-Friendly:**
- IP addresses hashed before storage
- No cookies set
- No personal data collected

| Badge not loading | Check audit hash is valid and audit is published |
| CORS errors | Badge uses `credentials: 'omit'`, should work cross-origin |
| Score not updating | Auto-refresh runs every 24h; call `refresh()` manually |
| XSS concerns | All dynamic content is HTML-escaped; no user content rendered |
| Performance | Script is < 4KB gzip, loads async, no blocking |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| XSS Prevention | HTML entity escaping via `escapeHtml()` function |
| No Cookies | Privacy-friendly, no tracking cookies |
| CORS Safe | `credentials: 'omit'` prevents credential leakage |
| No External Dependencies | Pure vanilla JS, no third-party libs |
| Content Security Policy | Compatible with strict CSP |

## Badge Auto-Refresh Mechanism (TASK-33-19)

### Feature Description
JavaScript-based auto-refresh mechanism for embedded SEO score badges that ensures badges stay current with the latest audit scores. Implements intelligent refresh logic with localStorage tracking, graceful degradation, and motion-aware animations. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **TypeScript Source:** `frontend/lib/scripts/badge.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/scripts/badge-autorefresh.test.ts`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-19.md`

### Core Functionality

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Score Update Check | Checks for score updates on badge load |
| Background Refresh | Auto-refreshes every 24 hours (configurable) |
| localStorage Tracking | Stores last check time and score locally |
| Graceful Degradation | Falls back silently if localStorage unavailable |
| Change Detection | Only refreshes when score has actually changed |
| Smooth Transitions | CSS animations for score updates |
| Motion Respect | Honors `prefers-reduced-motion` preference |

### localStorage Schema

```javascript
// Storage keys (auditable, user-controllable)
const STORAGE_PREFIX = "seoindicator_";

// Last check timestamp
localStorage.setItem(`seoindicator_${auditId}_lastCheck`, Date.now());

// Last known score
localStorage.setItem(`seoindicator_${auditId}_lastScore`, 85);
```

### Refresh Functions

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `isLocalStorageAvailable()` | Feature detection for localStorage support |
| `storeLastCheckTime(auditId)` | Stores current timestamp for refresh tracking |
| `storeLastScore(auditId, score)` | Stores last known score for change detection |
| `getLastCheckTime(auditId)` | Retrieves last check timestamp |
| `getLastScore(auditId)` | Retrieves last known score |
| `shouldRefresh(auditId, interval)` | Checks if enough time has passed for refresh |
| `hasScoreChanged(auditId, newScore)` | Compares current vs stored score |
| `prefersReducedMotion()` | Checks user's motion preference |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `DEFAULT_REFRESH_INTERVAL` | 86400000ms (24h) | Time between automatic refreshes |
| `refreshInterval` | configurable | Custom interval via init options |
| Data attribute | `data-refresh-interval` | Per-badge custom interval |

### Animation Behavior

**Score Update Animation:**
```javascript
// CSS transition applied when score changes
transition: transform 0.3s ease-out, opacity 0.3s ease-out;

// Animation sequence
1. Fade out current score
2. Update score value
3. Fade in new score with subtle scale

// Motion preference check
if (prefersReducedMotion()) {
  // Skip animation, instant update
}
```

### Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| localStorage unavailable | Graceful degradation, no persistence |
| Network error on refresh | Retry on next interval, preserve last score |
| Invalid API response | Keep existing score, log error |
| Page in background | Defer refresh until page visible |

### Performance Considerations

| Optimization | Implementation |
|--------------|---------------|
| Non-blocking refresh | Uses `requestIdleCallback` for refresh calls |
| Timer cleanup | Clear timeout on badge destroy |
| Background pages | Pauses refresh when page hidden |
| Memory efficiency | Single timer per badge instance |

## Badge Impression Tracking API (TASK-33-17)

### API Description
REST API endpoint for tracking badge impressions when embedded SEO score badges are viewed on third-party websites. Provides privacy-compliant analytics by hashing IP addresses before storage. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/BadgeTrackingController.php`
- **Request:** `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/BadgeImpressionRequest.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/BadgeImpression.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/BadgeImpressionControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-17.md`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Rate Limit | Purpose |
|--------|----------|------------|---------|
| POST | `/api/v1/badge/impression` | 10/minute per IP | Track badge impression |

### Request Body

```json
{
  "hash": "abc123def456...",    // Required: 32-char public audit hash
  "referrer_domain": "example.com"  // Optional: Referring domain
}
```

### Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `hash` | Required, string, 32 characters, alphanumeric |
| `referrer_domain` | Optional, string, max 255 chars, valid domain format |

### Response Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 204 | No Content - Impression recorded successfully |
| 404 | Not Found - Invalid hash or audit is not public |
| 422 | Unprocessable Entity - Validation error |
| 429 | Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded (10/min/IP) |

### Response Format

**Success (204 No Content):**
```
// Empty response body
```

**Error (404 Not Found):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Audit not found"
}
```

**Validation Error (422 Unprocessable Entity):**
```json
{
  "message": "The hash must be 32 characters.",
  "errors": {
    "hash": ["The hash must be 32 characters."]
  }
}
```

### IP Hashing (Privacy)

IP addresses are hashed before storage using SHA-256:

```php
// IP hashing in BadgeImpression model
$ipHash = hash('sha256', $ipAddress . config('app.key'));
// Result: 64-character hexadecimal string
```

**Privacy Properties:**
- One-way hash (irreversible)
- Salted with application key
- No PII stored in database

### Rate Limiting

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Limiter Name | `badge-tracking` |
| Limit | 10 requests per minute |
| Scope | Per IP address |
| Response | 429 Too Many Requests |

### Database Storage

**badge_impressions table:**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT | Primary key |
| `audit_id` | BIGINT | FK to audits table |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(32) | Public audit hash |
| `referrer_domain` | VARCHAR(255) | Referring domain |
| `impression_at` | TIMESTAMP | Impression timestamp |
| `ip_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | SHA-256 hashed IP |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| SQL Injection | Parameterized queries via Eloquent |
| XSS Prevention | Input validation, no HTML output |
| Path Traversal | Hash validation (alphanumeric only) |
| Rate Limiting | Throttle middleware (10/min/IP) |
| 404 Consistency | Same response for non-existent and private audits (prevents enumeration) |

### Route Description
REST API routes for public audit functionality, enabling SEO audit sharing and embeddable score widgets. Includes public endpoints (no authentication) for viewing audits and badges, and authenticated endpoints for audit visibility management. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### API Endpoints

#### Public Routes (No Authentication Required)

| Method | Endpoint | Name | Rate Limit | Purpose |
|--------|----------|------|------------|---------|
| GET | `/api/v1/public-audit/{hash}` | `api.v1.public-audit.show` | 100/hour per IP | Retrieve public audit data by hash |

- Invalid email returns 422
- Missing fields return 422

- Malformed hashes handled (404)
- SQL injection attempts blocked
- XSS payloads rejected
- Path traversal attempts blocked
- Special characters handled safely
- Unicode handled safely
- Very long inputs handled

## shadcn/ui Components Library (TASK-28-3)

### Component Description
Core UI component library built on shadcn/ui primitives for the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028). Provides 9 essential UI components with dark theme styling, Tailwind CSS integration, and full accessibility support. These components serve as building blocks for the indicator catalog, loading states, and navigation elements throughout the application.

### Component Locations
- **Components Directory:** `frontend/components/ui/`
- **Individual Components:**
  - `skeleton.tsx` - Loading placeholder component
  - `progress.tsx` - Linear/circular progress indicator
  - `badge.tsx` - Status label and notification badge
  - `tooltip.tsx` - Hover information display
  - `avatar.tsx` - User profile image component
  - `dropdown-menu.tsx` - Navigation and action menu
  - `sheet.tsx` - Mobile navigation drawer
  - `tabs.tsx` - Content organization component
  - `separator.tsx` - Visual division component
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/ui/shadcn-components.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-28-3.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Component | Purpose | Key Features |
|-----------|---------|--------------|
| Skeleton | Loading placeholders | Animated pulse, customizable dimensions |
| Progress | Progress indicators | Linear bar, value clamping (0-100), indeterminate state |
| Badge | Status labels | Variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline), dot indicator |
| Tooltip | Hover information | Delay configuration, side positioning, accessible |
| Avatar | User images | Image + fallback, size variants, status indicator |
| Dropdown-Menu | Action menus | Submenus, checkboxes, radio groups, keyboard navigation |
| Sheet | Slide-in drawer | Left/right/top/bottom positioning, responsive |
| Tabs | Content tabs | Controlled/uncontrolled, keyboard navigation |
| Separator | Visual division | Horizontal/vertical orientation |

```typescript
}
```

**Progress:**

## Suggestions List Page (TASK-5-10)

### Page Description
Frontend page component for viewing and managing keyword suggestions. Displays a sortable, filterable table of keyword opportunities with bulk actions for tracking or dismissing suggestions. Part of the Keyword Discovery & Suggestions feature (FEAT-005).

### Component Location
- **Page Component:** `frontend/app/sites/[siteId]/suggestions/page.tsx`
- **API Integration:** `frontend/lib/api/suggestions.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/sites/[siteId]/suggestions/SuggestionsPage.test.tsx`, `frontend/__tests__/app/sites/[siteId]/suggestions/SuggestionsListPage.test.tsx`

## GBP Insights & Reviews API Controllers (TASK-35-14)

### API Description
REST API controllers for the Local SEO & Google Business Profile Tracking feature (FEAT-035) that expose GBP Insights and Reviews endpoints. Provides 7 API endpoints for insights retrieval, trend analysis, sync triggers, review listing, statistics, review responses, and background job management. All endpoints are protected by authentication and authorization middleware.

### Component Locations
- **GBPInsightsController:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/GBP/GBPInsightsController.php`
- **GBPReviewsController:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/GBP/GBPReviewsController.php`
- **Request Classes:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/GBP/GBPInsightsRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/GBP/GBPReviewsRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/GBP/RespondToReviewRequest.php`
- **API Resources:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/GBP/GBPInsightsResource.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/GBP/GBPReviewResource.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/GBP/GBPReviewStatsResource.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/GBP/GBPTrendResource.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/GBP/GBPInsightsControllerTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/GBP/GBPReviewsControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-14.md`

### API Endpoints

#### GBP Insights Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Rate Limit | Description |
|--------|----------|------------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights` | 60/min | Get GBP insights for date range |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights/trend` | 60/min | Get trend analysis (WoW, MoM) |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights/sync` | 3/hour | Trigger background insights sync |

#### GBP Reviews Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Rate Limit | Description |
|--------|----------|------------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews` | 60/min | Get paginated reviews with filters |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews/stats` | 60/min | Get review statistics |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews/sync` | 3/hour | Trigger background reviews sync |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews/{reviewId}/respond` | 10/hour | Post owner response to review |

### Request Parameters

**GET /insights:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `start_date` | date (Y-m-d) | Start date filter (default: 30 days ago) |
| `end_date` | date (Y-m-d) | End date filter (default: today) |

**GET /reviews:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `page` | int | Page number (default: 1) |
| `per_page` | int | Items per page (default: 15, max: 100) |
| `rating` | int | Filter by rating (1-5) |
| `sentiment` | string | Filter by sentiment (positive, negative, neutral) |
| `has_response` | boolean | Filter by response status |
| `date_from` | date | Filter from date |
| `date_to` | date | Filter to date |
| `sort` | string | Sort column (date, rating) |
| `order` | string | Sort direction (asc, desc) |

**POST /reviews/{reviewId}/respond:**
| Parameter | Type | Validation |
|-----------|------|------------|
| `response` | string | Required, max 4096 characters |

### Response Formats

**GET /insights:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "views": 1234,
    "searches": 567,
    "calls": 45,
    "directions": 89,
    "website_clicks": 123,
    "photos_views": 234,
    "date_range": {
      "start": "2026-02-06",
      "end": "2026-03-08"
    },
    "daily": [
      { "date": "2026-03-08", "views": 42, "searches": 15 }
    ]
  }
}
```

**GET /insights/trend:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "views": {
      "current": 1234,
      "previous": 1100,
      "change": 12.18,
      "direction": "up"
    },
    "week_over_week": { "change": 5.2, "direction": "up" },
    "month_over_month": { "change": 12.18, "direction": "up" }
  }
}
```

**GET /reviews:**
```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 15,
    "total": 45,
    "last_page": 3
  }
}
```

**GET /reviews/stats:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "average_rating": 4.2,
    "total_count": 45,
    "rating_distribution": { "1": 2, "2": 3, "3": 5, "4": 15, "5": 20 },
    "sentiment_breakdown": { "positive": 35, "negative": 5, "neutral": 5 }
  }
}
```

**POST /sync (both insights and reviews):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "job_id": "sync-abc123",
    "status": "queued"
  }
}
```

### Authorization

| Endpoint | Policy Method | Description |
|----------|---------------|-------------|
| Read endpoints | `LocationPolicy@view` | User must own the location |
| Sync endpoints | `LocationPolicy@sync` | User must own the location |
| Respond endpoint | `LocationPolicy@respondToReviews` | User must own the location |

### Service Dependencies

| Service | Interface | Purpose |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| GBPInsightsService | `GBPInsightsServiceInterface` | Insights data operations |
| GBPReviewsService | `GBPReviewsServiceInterface` | Reviews data operations |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum middleware |
| Authorization | LocationPolicy checks |
| SQL Injection | Parameterized queries via Eloquent |
| XSS Prevention | Input validation, JSON encoding |
| Rate Limiting | Throttle middleware (3/hour for sync, 10/hour for respond) |
| Input Validation | Form Request classes |

### Error Responses

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated |
| 403 | Forbidden - User does not own location |
| 404 | Location not found |
| 422 | Validation error |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |

## Local SEO Alerts API Controller (TASK-35-16)

### API Description
REST API controller for the authenticated Local SEO alert inbox. Exposes 6 user-facing endpoints for listing alerts, getting unread counts, marking a single alert as read, bulk-marking alerts as read, deleting alerts, and listing alerts scoped to a specific business location. The controller uses dedicated Form Request validation, a JSON resource for stable payload formatting, and ownership-aware query scoping that returns `404` for cross-user resources to avoid alert and location enumeration.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertController.php`
- **Request Classes:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertIndexRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertMarkAllReadRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertRequest.php` (backwards-compatible alias)
- **API Resource:** `backend/app/Http/Resources/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertResource.php`
- **Service Contract:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/Contracts/LocalSEOAlertServiceInterface.php`
- **Service Implementation:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertService.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/LocalSEOAlert.php`
- **Routes:** `backend/routes/api.php`
- **Schema Remediation:** `backend/database/migrations/2026_03_10_112600_remediate_local_seo_schema_drift.php`
- **Tests:**
  - `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertControllerTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Http/Requests/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertRequestTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Unit/Services/LocalSEO/LocalSEOAlertServiceTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Feature/Database/Migrations/LocalSeoMigrationTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-16.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Rate Limit | Description |
|--------|----------|------------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts` | 60/min | List the authenticated user's alerts, newest-first, with pagination and optional filters |
| GET | `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts/unread-count` | 60/min | Return unread totals plus per-severity counts |
| POST | `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts/{id}/read` | 60/min | Mark one owned alert as read and return the updated alert resource |
| POST | `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts/mark-all-read` | 10/min | Bulk-mark unread alerts as read for the current user, optionally filtered by location and severity |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts/{id}` | 60/min | Delete one owned alert and return `204 No Content` |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/alerts` | 60/min | List alerts for one owned business location with the same filter/pagination behavior as the main inbox |

### Request Parameters

**GET `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts`** and **GET `/api/v1/locations/{id}/alerts`**

| Parameter | Type | Validation | Description |
|-----------|------|------------|-------------|
| `location_id` | integer | optional | Filter alerts to one business location (ignored on the location-scoped route because the path id is authoritative) |
| `severity` | string | `info`, `warning`, `critical` | Filter by severity |
| `type` | string | `ranking_improved`, `ranking_dropped`, `new_review`, `negative_review`, `rating_dropped`, `competitor_overtake`, `gbp_disconnected` | Filter by alert type |
| `is_read` | boolean-like | `true`, `false`, `1`, `0`, `'true'`, `'false'`, `'1'`, `'0'` | Filter by read state |
| `per_page` | integer | min `1`, capped to `100` in controller | Pagination page size |

**POST `/api/v1/local-seo/alerts/mark-all-read`**

| Parameter | Type | Validation | Description |
|-----------|------|------------|-------------|
| `location_id` | integer | optional | Restrict bulk update to one location |
| `severity` | string | `info`, `warning`, `critical` | Restrict bulk update to one severity |

### Controller and Service Behavior

| Area | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Sorting | All list endpoints sort alerts by `created_at DESC` |
| Pagination | Default `15` per page, capped at `100` |
| Location eager loading | Main inbox and single-alert responses include nested `{id, name}` location data |
| Single read | `LocalSEOAlertService::markAsRead()` is idempotent and writes both `is_read=true` and `read_at=now()` |
| Bulk read | `LocalSEOAlertService::markAllAsRead(int $userId, ?int $locationId, ?string $severity)` updates only unread alerts and supports the new severity filter |
| Location-scoped listing | Route first resolves an accessible `BusinessLocation`; inaccessible locations return `404 Location not found` |
| Admin override | `isAdmin()` allows `admin` / `super_admin` roles (or a `User::isAdmin()` helper) to bypass the per-user scope when needed |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | All routes use `auth:sanctum` |
| Ownership isolation | Non-admin users are always scoped by `user_id`; cross-user reads and deletes return `404` |
| Anti-enumeration | Missing/inaccessible alerts and locations intentionally respond with `404` instead of `403` |
| Input validation | Dedicated Form Requests validate enums, boolean-like `is_read`, and integer pagination/filter inputs |
| SQL injection prevention | Eloquent query builder and parameterized conditions only |
| Rate limiting | Read endpoints `60/min`, bulk mark-all-read `10/min` |
| Response safety | `LocalSEOAlertResource` emits JSON-safe scalar fields and a minimal nested location object |

### Error Responses

| Code | Scenario | Example |
|------|----------|---------|
| 401 | Missing or invalid Sanctum auth | `{"message":"Unauthenticated."}` |
| 404 | Alert or location is not owned by the current user (or does not exist) | `{"message":"Alert not found"}` / `{"message":"Location not found"}` |
| 422 | Validation failure (for example invalid severity) | `{"success":false,"message":"The given data was invalid.","errors":{"severity":["The selected severity is invalid. Must be one of: info, warning, critical."]}}` |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded | Standard throttle middleware response |

## IssueDetector Service (TASK-14-8)

### Service Description
Core orchestration service for the Technical SEO Site Audit feature (FEAT-014) that coordinates all issue detection checkers and creates AuditIssue records from findings. Implements the Strategy pattern with a checker registry, enabling extensible detection capabilities through the CheckerInterface. Handles duplicate title detection across pages using cache-based tracking.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Audit/IssueDetector.php`
- **Interface:** `backend/app/Services/Audit/Contracts/IssueDetectorInterface.php`
- **Checker Interface:** `backend/app/Services/Audit/Checkers/CheckerInterface.php`
- **DTOs:** `backend/app/Services/Audit/DTOs/IssueFinding.php`, `backend/app/Services/Audit/DTOs/CrawlResult.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Audit/IssueDetectorTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-14-8.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `registerChecker(CheckerInterface $checker)` | Register an issue detection checker |
| `analyze(CrawlResult $result, int $auditId)` | Run all registered checkers and store issues |
| `runCheck(string $name, CrawlResult $result)` | Run a single checker by name |
| `getAvailableChecks()` | Get list of registered checker names |

### CheckerInterface Pattern

All checkers implement the same interface for extensibility:

```php
interface CheckerInterface
{
    public function check(CrawlResult $result): ?IssueFinding;
    public function getIssueType(): string;
    public function getName(): string;
    public function getPriority(): int;
}
```

### MVP Checkers

| Checker | Issue Type | Severity | Priority |
|---------|------------|----------|----------|
| TitleTagChecker | missing_title_tag | Critical | 100 |
| MetaDescriptionChecker | missing_meta_description | Warning | 90 |
| H1Checker | missing_h1 / multiple_h1 | Warning/Notice | 80 |
| ViewportChecker | missing_viewport | Warning | 70 |
| BrokenLinkChecker | broken_link | Critical | 60 |
| PerformanceChecker | slow_page | Notice | 50 |
| ImageAltChecker | image_missing_alt | Notice | 40 |

### Duplicate Title Detection

The service tracks titles across pages to detect duplicates:

| Aspect | Implementation |
|--------|----------------|
| Cache Key | `audit:titles:{audit_id}` |
| TTL | Duration of audit |
| Storage | Title → URL mapping |
| Detection | Second+ occurrences flagged |

### IssueFinding DTO

```php
readonly class IssueFinding
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $issueType,    // Maps to issue_types.name
        public readonly string $severity,     // critical, warning, notice
        public readonly string $description,  // Human-readable description
        public readonly string $recommendation, // Fix recommendation
        public readonly array $context = []   // Additional context (URL, etc.)
    ) {}
}
```

### CrawlResult DTO

```php
readonly class CrawlResult
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $url,
        public readonly int $statusCode,
        public readonly int $responseTimeMs,
        public readonly string $html,
        public readonly array $links = [],
        public readonly array $metadata = [],
        public readonly ?string $errorMessage = null,
        public readonly array $headers = [],
        public readonly int $depth = 0,
        public readonly array $redirectChain = []
    ) {}
}
```

### Severity Mapping

| Checker Severity | Issue Type Default | Final Severity |
|------------------|-------------------|----------------|
| Checker-provided | — | Uses checker value |
| — (not provided) | Database lookup | Uses issue_types.severity_default |
| — (not found) | — | Defaults to 'notice' |

### Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Checker throws exception | Log error, continue to next checker |
| Invalid CrawlResult | Return empty array |
| Missing audit ID | InvalidArgumentException |
| Cache unavailable | Continue without duplicate detection |

## Location Management Page (TASK-35-17)

### Component Description
Authenticated Local SEO location-management surface for `/sites/{siteId}/local`. The page provides the operational shell for site-level business locations: list loading, add/edit/delete workflows, summary KPIs, search/filter/sort controls, optimistic CRUD updates, and a query-parameter-driven location details dialog. The shipped production scope also includes the backend contract hardening that prevented Local SEO list/detail reads from failing with generic `500` responses when Google OAuth credentials were missing or when production schema/query drift was encountered.

### Component and Route Locations
- **Page Route Wrapper:** `frontend/app/sites/[siteId]/local/page.tsx`
- **Primary UI:** `frontend/components/local/LocationManagementPage.tsx`
- **Details Dialog:** `frontend/components/local/LocationDetailsDialog.tsx`
- **Card Component:** `frontend/components/local/LocationCard.tsx`
- **Create/Edit Form:** `frontend/components/local/LocationForm.tsx`
- **Delete Confirmation:** `frontend/components/local/DeleteLocationDialog.tsx`
- **Data Hook:** `frontend/lib/hooks/useLocations.ts`

- **Auth Token Fallback Helper:** `frontend/lib/api/auth.ts`
- **Location Types/Normalizers:** `frontend/lib/types/locations.ts`
- **Backend API Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationController.php`
- **Backend Service:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationService.php`
- **OAuth Guardrail Service:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/GoogleOAuthService.php`
- **Regression Tests:**

### Route Behavior

| Route | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `/sites/{siteId}/local` | Renders the full location-management page for one site |
| `/sites/{siteId}/local?locationId={id}` | Opens `LocationDetailsDialog` for the selected location without leaving the list page |
| `GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/locations` | Returns paginated site locations for the page list |
| `POST /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/locations` | Creates a new business location |
| `GET /api/v1/locations/{id}` | Returns one business location with summary data used by the details dialog |
| `PUT /api/v1/locations/{id}` | Updates an existing location |
| `DELETE /api/v1/locations/{id}` | Soft-deletes a location |
| `POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/sync` | Triggers a dashboard refresh job for connected GBP locations |
| `POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/connect-gbp` | Starts GBP OAuth and now fails gracefully with `503 JSON` when OAuth is not configured |
| `DELETE /api/v1/locations/{id}/disconnect-gbp` | Disconnects GBP from the location |

### Frontend Behavior

| Area | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Rendering model | Server wrapper route uses `Suspense`; the interactive page runs fully in `LocationManagementPage` |
| Summary KPIs | Shows tracked locations, GBP-connected count, and average rating based on loaded data |
| Search | `searchInput` is debounced by `250ms` before server revalidation; a second client-side filter keeps the currently loaded page responsive while typing |
| Filters | Supports `all`, `connected`, and `not-connected` GBP states |
| Sorting | Server-backed for `updated`, `name`, and `connection`; client-side secondary sorting adds `rating`, `reviews`, and `pack-position` |
| Pagination | Uses backend `meta.current_page`, `per_page`, `total`, and `last_page` with previous/next controls |
| Create/update/delete UX | Uses SWR `mutate()` with optimistic list updates, rollback-on-error, and toast feedback |
| Empty/error states | Includes dedicated zero-state, filter-empty state, skeleton loading state, and retryable API error panel |
| Details flow | Query-param-driven dialog keeps static export compatibility and avoids a dedicated dynamic detail page dependency |
| Refresh actions | Both the list page and details dialog expose explicit refresh controls |

### Location Card Behavior
- Displays location name, address, optional category badge, and GBP connection badge.
- Surfaces quick stats for rating, review count, and local-pack position.
- Shows optional phone, website, and coordinate chips when those fields exist.
- Exposes `View details`, `Edit`, and `Delete` actions, with delete-state button locking.
- Provides a dedicated skeleton variant used while the page is loading.

### Location Form Behavior

| Feature | Implementation |
|--------|----------------|
| Validation | `zod` schema validates required name/address, phone pattern, website safety, and length limits |
| Website normalization | Bare domains are normalized to `https://...`; only `http`/`https` protocols are accepted |
| Geocoding | Address blur and explicit "Geocode address" actions call `geocodeAddress()` and display confirmed coordinates |
| Edit handling | Existing coordinates are preloaded; changing the address invalidates them until re-geocoded |
| Submit safety | Duplicate-submit guard (`submissionGuardRef` + `isSubmitLocked`) prevents rapid double posts |
| Output payload | Sends trimmed strings plus nullable `phone`, `website`, `category`, `latitude`, and `longitude` |

### Details Dialog Behavior
- Resolves details from `useLocation()` and falls back to the already-loaded list record while the detail fetch is pending.
- Shows business identity, rating/review/pack metrics, address/phone/website/coordinates, insights summary, review summary, and last updated timestamp.
- Embeds the GBP connection component so GBP status can be refreshed from the same dialog.
- Uses the `locationId` query parameter as the state source so dialog open/close is URL-addressable and browser-navigation friendly.

### Data Fetching and Authentication Contract
- `buildApiUrl()` normalizes `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` so local, relative, and absolute API base configurations all resolve to `/api/v1` consistently.
- `buildSanctumUrl()` keeps `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` on the frontend origin when the API base is absolute, preventing production cross-origin routing mistakes.
- `useLocations()` and `useLocation()` always send `credentials: "include"` and add a `Bearer` token from `localStorage` when present.
- This bearer-token fallback keeps the Local SEO shell usable in environments where the SPA cookie/session contract is not yet fully established.
- List cache refreshes revalidate all site location list keys plus the selected detail key after mutations.

### Backend Contract Hardening Shipped With This Task

| Problem | Resolution |
|--------|------------|
| Missing Google OAuth credentials could crash controller construction before non-OAuth reads ran | `GoogleOAuthService` now stores config as nullable strings and validates credentials only when OAuth work is actually requested |
| `connect-gbp` previously risked an unhandled failure when OAuth config was absent | `BusinessLocationController::connectGbp()` now catches the configuration error and returns `503` JSON with a clear message |
| List reads could fail when no `sort` query parameter was sent | `BusinessLocationService` now safely defaults sorting instead of assuming a non-null sort string |
| Public API sort alias `is_gbp_connected` did not match the physical DB column | Controller/service mapping now translates the alias to `gbp_connected` |
| `search` and `is_gbp_connected=false` were part of the frontend contract but were not fully honored by the real service path | The service now applies real text search plus explicit false-valued GBP filters |
| Drifted production schemas without `business_locations.deleted_at` could break list/detail/sync queries | `BusinessLocationService::newLocationQuery()` now detects soft-delete column support and tolerates missing `deleted_at` |
| OAuth callback state validation depended on the older service mock contract only | Controller callback validation now prefers cached `location_id` binding and falls back to `validateState()` only when needed |

### Request Parameters Used by the Page

| Parameter | Example | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `page` | `2` | Backend pagination |
| `per_page` | `15` | Page size (backend-capped) |
| `search` | `bakery` | Name/address/phone/website/category search |
| `is_gbp_connected` | `true` / `false` | Connection-state filter |
| `sort` | `name`, `-updated_at`, `-is_gbp_connected` | Server-side sorting contract |
| `locationId` | `123` | Frontend URL state for the details dialog |

### Error Handling

| Scenario | User/API Result |
|----------|-----------------|
| Guest list/detail request | JSON `401` instead of generic HTML/server error |
| Cross-user site access | JSON `403` on site list endpoints |
| Missing or foreign location | JSON `404` on detail/connect/disconnect paths |
| Missing Google OAuth configuration | JSON `503` with `Google Business Profile OAuth is not configured.` |
| Frontend fetch failure | Retryable error card or inline dialog error message |
| Geocoding failure | Inline warning plus blocked save when coordinates cannot be confirmed |

## GBP Connect Button (TASK-35-18)

### Component Description
Google Business Profile connection workflow used inside the Local SEO location details dialog. `GBPConnectButton` gives each business location a Google-branded connect CTA, popup-based OAuth bootstrap, optional account/location selection UI when the richer GBP account endpoints are available, connected/disconnect states, and safe retryable error handling. The shipped production scope also includes the repaired backend callback bridge and invalid-location handling so the live GBP flow no longer fails with generic `500` pages.

### Component and Integration Locations
- **Primary Component:** `frontend/components/local/GBPConnectButton.tsx`
- **Current Integration Point:** `frontend/components/local/LocationDetailsDialog.tsx`
- **Parent Surface:** `frontend/components/local/LocationManagementPage.tsx`
- **Page Route Wrapper:** `frontend/app/sites/[siteId]/local/page.tsx`
- **Backend Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationController.php`
- **OAuth Service:** `backend/app/Services/LocalSEO/GoogleOAuthService.php`
- **JSON/Callback Middleware Guard:** `backend/app/Http/Middleware/ForceJsonResponse.php`
- **Frontend Regression Tests:**
  - `frontend/__tests__/components/local/GBPConnectButton.real.test.tsx`
  - `frontend/__tests__/components/local/GBPConnectButton.production-routing.test.tsx`
  - `frontend/__tests__/components/local-seo/GBPConnectButton.test.tsx`
- **Backend Regression Tests:**
  - `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationControllerTest.php`
  - `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/LocalSEO/BusinessLocationControllerProductionRegressionTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-18.md`
- **Production Evidence:** `temp/task3518-prod-validation-20260310T132239Z.json`

### Props and State Contract

| Prop / State | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `siteId` | `string \| number` | Used in OAuth bootstrap and reconnect/disconnect payloads |
| `locationId` | `string \| number` | Location-scoped API target and fallback sync key |
| `connectedGBP` | `ConnectedGBP \| null` | Preloaded connected-state summary from the parent dialog |
| `onConnectionChange` | callback | Pushes connected/disconnected state back to `LocationDetailsDialog` so the parent can refresh |
| `status` | `idle \| connecting \| selecting \| connected \| error` | Internal UI state machine for connect flow rendering |
| `GBP_OAUTH_STATE_KEY` | sessionStorage key | Stores the CSRF-style OAuth state between popup open and callback completion |

### Live Route and Contract Behavior

| Route / Contract | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/connect-gbp` | Primary live bootstrap contract; returns `authorization_url` + `state` for the popup flow |
| `GET /api/v1/locations/{id}/gbp-callback` | Handles Google callback; returns JSON for API-style requests or a popup bridge HTML page that posts `gbp_oauth_callback` to `window.opener` and closes itself |
| `DELETE /api/v1/locations/{id}/disconnect-gbp` | Primary live disconnect contract; idempotent when the location is already disconnected |
| `GET /api/v1/locations/{id}` | Fallback sync source after OAuth completes when account-selection endpoints are unavailable |
| Missing / foreign location on show/connect/disconnect | Returns safe `404 JSON` (`Location not found`) instead of generic server errors |
| Invalid callback state | Returns `400 JSON` for API requests and a visible popup-bridge error page for browser requests |

### Frontend Behavior

| Area | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Idle state | Renders a Google-branded connect button with secure OAuth copy and current site context |
| OAuth bootstrap | Registers the popup `message` listener **before** the async bootstrap round-trip, seeds `sessionStorage`, then opens the popup using the returned Google authorization URL |
| Legacy/current contract compatibility | First tries the older `GET /gbp/oauth-url` flow expected by historical mocked tests, then falls back to the live `POST /connect-gbp` controller contract |
| OAuth callback handling | Accepts `gbp_oauth_callback` postMessage payloads from the popup, validates the returned state against sessionStorage, then either loads selectable accounts or refreshes the connected location directly |
| Account selection | When optional account endpoints exist, shows selectable GBP accounts and per-account locations before finalizing the connection |
| Fallback-to-sync | If account-list endpoints are absent (`404/405/501` or equivalent contract-hint payloads), re-fetches the location and treats `is_gbp_connected` as the source of truth |
| Connected state | Shows business name, optional profile image, and a disconnect CTA with confirmation dialog |
| Disconnect compatibility | Tries legacy `POST /disconnect-gbp` first for compatibility, then falls back to the live `DELETE /disconnect-gbp` contract |
| Error safety | Sanitizes backend error copy into user-safe messages (`already connected`, popup blocked, no accounts found) and avoids leaking tokens or unrelated backend fields |
| Production routing | Uses `buildApiUrl()` plus stored bearer-token fallback from `getStoredAuthToken()` so the component still targets the configured backend origin in exported/static deployments |

### Current UI Integration Reality
- The active shipped flow is embedded inside `LocationDetailsDialog` on `/sites/{siteId}/local`; it is **not** driven by the older dedicated `app/sites/[siteId]/local/[locationId]/page.tsx` integration referenced in early task notes.
- `LocationDetailsDialog` derives an initial `ConnectedGBP` summary from the resolved location record, then lets the button push refreshed connection state back through `onConnectionChange()` and `mutate()`.
- This keeps GBP connection management co-located with the rest of the location profile, instead of requiring a separate detail page to complete OAuth.

### Backend Hardening Shipped With This Task

| Problem | Resolution |
|---|---|
| Production callback route returned a generic `500` page for invalid/missing state | `BusinessLocationController::gbpCallback()` now validates state early and routes failures through `callbackError()` |
| Browser popup flow needed a usable frontend bridge instead of raw JSON/HTML errors | `callbackBridgeResponse()` now renders a lightweight HTML page that posts `{ type: "gbp_oauth_callback", ... }` to the opener and closes itself |
| Invalid location probes on show/connect/disconnect previously crashed at the HTTP layer in production | Current controller/service path now returns safe `404 JSON` errors for missing locations |
| Frontend fallback detection originally depended too heavily on status codes | The component now also detects contract-mismatch hints from safe error payload text, making legacy-to-live fallback deterministic in real tests |
| Popup callback race conditions could occur if the listener attached too late | The component now attaches the message listener before the async OAuth bootstrap completes and seeds provisional state immediately |

### Error and Security Behavior
- OAuth state is stored in `sessionStorage`, not `localStorage`, and removed after completion/error.
- Popup messages are accepted only from the current origin and only when `event.data.type === "gbp_oauth_callback"`.
- Error presentation is intentionally narrow: user-facing copy is normalized to safe messages such as `Invalid state parameter`, `Popup blocked`, or `No Google Business Profile accounts found.`
- The component never exposes OAuth tokens in React state, props, or rendered UI.
- Browser callback requests surface the error visibly in the popup page while still attempting `window.opener.postMessage(...)` for a smooth UI handoff.

The dashboard aggregates multiple data streams into a unified analytics surface with quick stats, section-based layouts, and progressive loading.

### Page Routes

| Route | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/locations/{id}` | Standalone location dashboard |
| `/sites/{siteId}/local/{locationId}` | Nested route within site context |

### Static Export Compatibility
The dashboard routes use Next.js `output: export` mode with placeholder `generateStaticParams()` entries (`preview`) for static export. A client-side route-id resolver (`getLocationIdFromPath()`) extracts the real numeric ID from `window.location.pathname` when the exported shell hydrates, ensuring production numeric routes correctly request `/api/v1/locations/{id}/...` instead of `/api/v1/locations/preview/...`.

Apache rewrite rules in `frontend/public/.htaccess` map numeric production routes to the exported preview shells:
```apache
RewriteRule ^locations/([0-9]+)/?$ /locations/preview/ [L]
RewriteRule ^sites/([0-9]+)/local/([0-9]+)/?$ /sites/preview/local/preview/ [L]
```

### Dashboard Sections

| Section | Description | Data Source |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| **Quick Stats** | Views, searches, actions, rating, review count, keywords in pack | `/api/v1/locations/{id}`, `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights`, `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings` |
| **GBP Insights** | Summary cards, 7-day trend sparklines, breakdown rows | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights` |
| **Reviews Preview** | Average rating, star display, distribution, sentiment, latest 3 reviews | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews/stats`, `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews` |
| **Local Rankings** | In-pack count, average position, top keywords, dropped keywords | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings` |
| **Alerts Widget** | Unread count, latest 3 alerts with severity | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/alerts` |
| **Competitors Preview** | Top 3 competitors with ratings/positions | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors` |
| **Sync Status** | Last sync timestamp, manual refresh trigger | `POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/sync` |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface LocationDashboardPageProps {
  locationId: string | number;
  siteId?: string | number;  // Optional, for nested route context
}

interface LocationDashboardData {
  location: BusinessLocation;
  insights: GBPInsights | null;
  reviewStats: ReviewStats | null;
  recentReviews: GBPReview[];
  rankings: LocalRankingSummary | null;
  alerts: LocalSEOAlertSummary | null;
  competitors: LocalCompetitor[];
}
```

### Frontend Behavior

| Area | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Route resolution | Client-side pathname parsing extracts real numeric IDs from production URLs, overriding static-export placeholder params |
| Data fetching | SWR-based hook with section-level loading states; parallel requests with automatic revalidation on focus |
| Progressive loading | Critical data (location info) loads first; secondary sections render independently with their own loading/error states |
| Error boundaries | Section-level `SectionErrorBoundary` wraps each section; one section failure doesn't crash the entire page |
| Manual refresh | Sync button triggers `POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/sync` and revalidates all SWR caches |
| GBP disconnect state | When `gbp_connected` is false, shows guidance banner instead of empty metric cards |
| API base handling | Uses `buildApiUrl()` with bearer-token fallback for production SPA auth compatibility |

### Backend Endpoints Used

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}` | GET | Location details with settings |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/insights` | GET | GBP insights data |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews/stats` | GET | Review statistics |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/reviews` | GET | Recent reviews list |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings` | GET | Local ranking summary |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/alerts` | GET | Unread alerts |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors` | GET | Top competitors |
| `/api/v1/locations/{id}/sync` | POST | Trigger manual sync |

### Security and Access Control
- All endpoints require authentication (Sanctum)
- Ownership verification via `BusinessLocationPolicy` ensures users can only access their own locations
- Cross-user location access returns `404` (anti-enumeration) not `403`
- Bearer-token fallback enables SPA-style auth in production exported builds

## Local Rankings API Controller (TASK-35-15)

### API Description
REST API controller for local ranking tracking endpoints that expose LocalRankService functionality to the frontend. Provides endpoints for retrieving current rankings, historical data, quota management, and competitor tracking for business locations.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalRankingController.php`
- **Models:**
  - `backend/app/Models/LocalRanking.php` - Local ranking model with relationships
  - `backend/app/Models/LocalCompetitor.php` - Local competitor model
- **Policy:** `backend/app/Policies/BusinessLocationPolicy.php` - Authorization (6 methods added)
- **Routes:** `backend/routes/api.php` - Ranking and competitor routes
- **Factories:**
  - `backend/database/factories/LocalRankingFactory.php` - Test factory with states
  - `backend/database/factories/LocalCompetitorFactory.php` - Test factory with states
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/LocalRankingControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-15.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Throttle |
|--------|----------|-------------|------|----------|
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings` | Current rankings for location's keywords | Required | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/history` | Historical ranking data | Required | 60/min |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/check` | Trigger ranking check (all keywords) | Required | 10/hour |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/check/{keywordId}` | Trigger single keyword check | Required | 10/hour |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/quota` | Monthly quota usage | Required | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors` | List tracked competitors | Required | 60/min |
| POST | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors` | Add competitor for tracking | Required | 30/hour |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors/{competitorId}` | Remove competitor | Required | 30/hour |

### Endpoint Details

#### GET /api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings
Returns current rankings for all keywords associated with a location.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "location_id": 1,
    "location_name": "Pizza Palace",
    "rankings": [
      {
        "keyword_id": 1,
        "keyword": "best pizza new york",
        "local_pack_position": 2,
        "local_organic_position": 5,
        "last_checked": "2026-03-14T12:00:00Z",
        "change": {
          "pack_change": 1,
          "organic_change": -2
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### GET /api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/history
Returns historical ranking data with optional filtering.

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `keyword_id` | int | Filter by keyword ID |
| `start_date` | date | Start date (Y-m-d) |
| `end_date` | date | End date (Y-m-d) |

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "location_id": 1,
    "keyword_id": 1,
    "history": [
      {
        "date": "2026-03-14",
        "local_pack_position": 2,
        "local_organic_position": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/check
Triggers asynchronous ranking check for all keywords at a location.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "job_id": "uuid-check-123",
    "location_id": 1,
    "keywords_queued": 5,
    "status": "pending"
  }
}
```

**Status Codes:**
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 202 | Accepted - Job queued successfully |
| 429 | Quota exceeded - Monthly limit reached |

#### GET /api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/quota
Returns monthly quota usage for ranking checks.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "location_id": 1,
    "monthly_limit": 50,
    "used_this_month": 23,
    "remaining": 27,
    "reset_date": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

#### GET /api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors
Lists all competitors being tracked for a location.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "location_id": 1,
    "competitors": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Joe's Pizza",
        "google_place_id": "ChIJabc123",
        "rating": 4.5,
        "review_count": 123,
        "last_position": 1
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### POST /api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors
Adds a new competitor for tracking.

**Request Body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Competitor name (max 255 chars) |
| `google_place_id` | string | Yes | Google Place ID (unique per location) |
| `notes` | string | No | Optional notes (max 1000 chars) |

**Validation Rules:**
- Max 20 competitors per location
- Duplicate `google_place_id` not allowed

#### DELETE /api/v1/locations/{id}/competitors/{competitorId}
Removes a competitor from tracking.

**Status Codes:**
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 204 | No Content - Successfully deleted |
| 404 | Not Found - Competitor doesn't exist |
| 403 | Forbidden - Not owner |

### Quota System

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Monthly Limit | 50 checks per location |
| Reset Period | Monthly (1st of each month) |
| Quota Response | 429 with reset_date |

**Quota Exceeded Response:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Quota exceeded",
  "data": {
    "reset_date": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Policy Authorization

The `BusinessLocationPolicy` provides these abilities for rankings access:

| Ability | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `viewRankings` | View current and historical rankings |
| `checkRankings` | Trigger ranking checks |
| `viewQuota` | View quota usage |
| `viewCompetitors` | List tracked competitors |

| `deleteCompetitor` | Remove competitor |

**Authorization Rule:** User must own the site that owns the location.

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum (`auth:sanctum` middleware) |
| Authorization | Policy-based (user must own location's site) |
| Rate Limiting | Throttle middleware (10-60 requests per interval) |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| XSS Prevention | Input sanitization with `strip_tags()` |
| IDOR Prevention | Policy checks ownership before access |
| Input Validation | Form request validation |

## Local Rankings Tracker Page (TASK-35-22)

### Component Description
Detailed local rankings tracker page for monitoring local pack and organic positions for keywords at specific business locations. Provides comprehensive ranking visibility with quota management, historical trends, competitor comparison, local pack visualization, and export functionality.

### Component Locations
- **Standalone Route:** `frontend/app/locations/[id]/rankings/page.tsx`
- **Nested Route:** `frontend/app/sites/[siteId]/local/[locationId]/rankings/page.tsx`
- **Main Component:** `frontend/components/local/LocationRankingsPage.tsx`
- **Sub-components:**
  - `frontend/components/local/RankingsTable.tsx` - Sortable keywords table with position columns
- **Data Layer:**
  - `frontend/lib/types/location-rankings.ts` - TypeScript interfaces
  - `frontend/lib/hooks/useLocationRankingsPage.ts` - SWR-based data fetching hook
- **Backend Controllers:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/LocalSEO/LocalRankingController.php` - Rankings API
- **Policy:** `backend/app/Policies/BusinessLocationPolicy.php` - Authorization abilities
- **Test Files:**
  - `frontend/__tests__/app/locations/[id]/rankings/page.test.tsx`
  - `frontend/__tests__/app/sites/[siteId]/local/[locationId]/rankings/page.route.test.tsx`
  - `frontend/__tests__/config/static-export-local-rankings-rewrites.test.ts`
  - `frontend/__tests__/components/local/LocationRankingsPage.real.test.tsx`
  - `frontend/__tests__/components/local/RankingsTable.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-35-22.md`

### Page Routes

| Route | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/locations/{id}/rankings` | Standalone rankings tracker |
| `/sites/{siteId}/local/{locationId}/rankings` | Nested route within site context |

### Static Export Compatibility
The rankings routes use Next.js `output: export` mode with placeholder `generateStaticParams()` entries (`preview`) for static export. A client-side route-id resolver extracts the real numeric ID from `window.location.pathname` when the exported shell hydrates, ensuring production numeric routes correctly request `/api/v1/locations/{id}/rankings/...` instead of `/api/v1/locations/preview/rankings/...`.

Apache rewrite rules in `frontend/public/.htaccess` map numeric production routes to the exported preview shells:
```apache
RewriteRule ^locations/([0-9]+)/rankings/?$ /locations/preview/rankings/ [L]
RewriteRule ^sites/([0-9]+)/local/([0-9]+)/rankings/?$ /sites/preview/local/preview/rankings/ [L]
```

### Core Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Quota Indicator** | Shows checks used / checks available with visual progress bar; resets monthly |
| **Keywords Table** | Columns: keyword, local pack position, organic position, change, last checked |
| **Position Color Coding** | Green = in pack (1-3), Yellow = close (4-10), Red = not found |
| **Position Change Indicators** | Up/down arrows showing rank changes |
| **Ranking History Chart** | Line chart for selected keyword with pack/organic toggle |
| **Check Ranking Button** | Triggers ranking check with loading state and quota validation |
| **Competitor Comparison** | Side-by-side cards showing competitor position, rating, review count |
| **Position Change Alerts** | Highlights keywords with significant changes, links to alert details |
| **Local Pack Visualization** | Shows current pack positions (1-3), indicates if location is in pack |
| **Export Functionality** | Export to CSV and Excel formats |

### Component Props

```typescript
  locationId: string | number;

}

  id: number;
```

## PricingComparison Component (TASK-32-6)

### Component Description
Pricing comparison component that displays tier-by-tier pricing for SEOIndicator and competitors side-by-side. Highlights SEOIndicator's free tier advantage with billing toggle (monthly/annual), annual savings calculation, and mobile-responsive layout.

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/compare/PricingComparison.tsx`
- **Types:** `frontend/lib/compare/types.ts` (PricingComparisonProps, PricingTier)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/compare/PricingComparison.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-32-6.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Tier Comparison | Side-by-side pricing tiers for both tools |
| Free Tier Highlight | "Free Forever" badge on free tiers |
| Billing Toggle | Monthly/Annual switch with accessible buttons |
| Annual Savings | Calculated percentage savings badge for annual plans |
| Highlighted Tier | "Popular" badge with emerald accent styling |
| Mobile Responsive | Stacked layout on mobile, grid on desktop |
| Price Formatting | Currency symbol, decimal handling, "Free"/"Custom" text |

### Sub-components

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `BillingToggle` | Monthly/Annual toggle with aria-pressed states |
| `PricingCard` | Individual tier card with name, price, features |
| `FeatureList` | Feature list with check icons (✓) |
| `PriceDisplay` | Formatted price with optional savings badge |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface PricingComparisonProps {
  seoindicator: PricingTier[];      // SEOIndicator pricing tiers
  competitor: PricingTier[];        // Competitor pricing tiers
  showFreeTier?: boolean;           // Show/hide free tiers (default: true)
}

interface PricingTier {
  name: string;                     // Tier name (e.g., "Free", "Pro", "Business")
  monthlyPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';  // Monthly price or special type
  annualPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';   // Annual price (per month)
  features: string[];               // Features included in tier
  highlighted?: boolean;            // Show "Popular" badge (optional)
}
```

### Pricing Calculation

**Annual Savings Formula:**
```typescript
savings = ((monthly * 12 - annual * 12) / (monthly * 12)) * 100
```

**Price Formatting Rules:**
| Input | Output |
|-------|--------|
| `'Free'` | `"Free"` |
| `'Custom'` | `"Custom"` |
| Integer (e.g., 19) | `"$19"` |
| Decimal (e.g., 19.99) | `"$19.99"` |

### Styling

- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling
- Mobile: Single column (`grid-cols-1`)
- Desktop: Two columns (`md:grid-cols-2`)
- Free tier badge: `bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300`
- Popular badge: `bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400`
- Savings badge: `bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400`
- Highlighted tier: `border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-900/20`

### SEOIndicator Pricing Data

| Tier | Monthly | Annual | Key Features |
|------|---------|--------|--------------|
| Free | $0 | $0 | 1 project, 10 keywords, Basic tracking |
| Pro | $19 | $15/mo | 5 projects, 100 keywords, Daily tracking, Competitor analysis |
| Business | $49 | $39/mo | 20 projects, 500 keywords, Team collaboration |

| `getUserStats()` | Returns user statistics (total, active, new, churned) | 5 minutes (300s) |
| `getUsageStats()` | Returns usage statistics (audits, keywords, reports) | 5 minutes (300s) |
| `getCreditStats()` | Returns credit statistics (sold, used, remaining) | 1 minute (60s) |
| `getHealthStats()` | Returns system health status | 30 seconds |
| `getCachedMetric()` | Generic cache method with custom key and TTL | Configurable (default 300s) |
| `getAllStats()` | Aggregates all stats into single response | Varies per metric |
| `refreshAllCaches()` | Clears all admin stat caches | — |
| `refreshUserCache()` | Invalidates user stats cache | — |
| `refreshUsageCache()` | Invalidates usage stats cache | — |
| `refreshCreditCache()` | Invalidates credit stats cache | — |
| `refreshHealthCache()` | Invalidates health stats cache | — |

### Cache TTL Configuration

| Metric Type | TTL | Rationale |
|-------------|-----|-----------|
| User Stats | 300 seconds | Relatively stable, moderate refresh rate |
| Usage Stats | 300 seconds | Relatively stable, moderate refresh rate |
| Credit Stats | 60 seconds | More frequent updates for balance tracking |
| Health Stats | 30 seconds | Near real-time monitoring requirement |

### Cache Key Namespacing

All cache keys use the `admin:stats:` prefix:
- `admin:stats:users` — User statistics
- `admin:stats:usage` — Usage statistics
- `admin:stats:credits` — Credit statistics
- `admin:stats:health` — System health status

### getCachedMetric() Method

```php
/**
 * Generic caching method for admin metrics
 *
 * @param string $key Cache key (namespaced)
 * @param callable $calculator Function to compute value on cache miss
 * @param int $ttl Time-to-live in seconds (default: 300)
 * @return mixed Cached or computed value
 */
public function getCachedMetric(string $key, callable $calculator, int $ttl = 300): mixed
```

**Usage Example:**
```php
$stats = $service->getCachedMetric(
    'admin:stats:custom_metric',
    fn() => DB::table('custom_data')->count(),
    600 // 10 minute TTL
);
```

### Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Cache unavailable | Falls back to direct calculation |
| Calculator throws exception | Returns graceful fallback (empty array or unhealthy status) |
| Database connection error | Returns unhealthy status for health metrics |

### Return Value Structures

**getUserStats():**
```php
[
    'total' => int,
    'active' => int,
    'new_this_month' => int,
    'churned_this_month' => int,
]
```

**getUsageStats():**
```php
[
    'audits_total' => int,
    'audits_this_month' => int,
    'keywords_tracked' => int,
    'reports_generated' => int,
]
```

**getCreditStats():**
```php
[
    'total_sold' => float,
    'total_used' => float,
    'balance_remaining' => float,
]
```

**getHealthStats():**
```php
[
    'status' => 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy',
    'database' => 'connected' | 'disconnected',
    'cache' => 'connected' | 'disconnected',
    'queue' => 'running' | 'stopped',
]
```

### Cache Invalidation

| Method | Cache Key Cleared |
|--------|-------------------|
| `refreshUserCache()` | `admin:stats:users` |
| `refreshUsageCache()` | `admin:stats:usage` |
| `refreshCreditCache()` | `admin:stats:credits` |
| `refreshHealthCache()` | `admin:stats:health` |
| `refreshAllCaches()` | All above keys |

## Performance Optimization (TASK-1-20)

### Task Description
Backend performance optimization for keywords list and dashboard endpoints. Fixed N+1 query issues and memory problems that were causing slow page loads and high memory consumption. The optimization significantly improved user experience with measurable GA metric improvements.

### Component Locations
- **KeywordController:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/KeywordController.php`
- **DashboardController:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/DashboardController.php`
- **Keyword Model:** `backend/app/Models/Keyword.php` (new method `getLatestRankingsForKeywords()`)
- **Task Specification:** `TASKS/TASK-1-20.md`

### Performance Issues Fixed

| Issue | Location | Root Cause | Resolution |
|-------|----------|------------|------------|
| N+1 Query | `KeywordController::index()` | Each keyword fetched latest ranking individually | Batch fetching via `getLatestRankingsForKeywords()` |
| Memory Exhaustion | `DashboardController::index()` | Fetched ALL rankings, then took latest 2 in PHP | SQL window function fetches only needed rows |

### Technical Implementation

**1. N+1 Query Fix in KeywordController::index():**

Before (N+1 problem):
```php
$keywords = Keyword::where('site_id', $siteId)->get();
foreach ($keywords as $keyword) {
    $keyword->latest_ranking = $keyword->rankings()->latest()->first();
}
```

After (batch fetching):
```php
$keywords = Keyword::where('site_id', $siteId)->get();
$latestRankings = Keyword::getLatestRankingsForKeywords($keywords->pluck('id'));
foreach ($keywords as $keyword) {
    $keyword->latest_ranking = $latestRankings->get($keyword->id);
}
```

**New Model Method:**
```php
// backend/app/Models/Keyword.php
public static function getLatestRankingsForKeywords(array $keywordIds): Collection
{
    return Ranking::whereIn('keyword_id', $keywordIds)
        ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
        ->get()
        ->groupBy('keyword_id')
        ->map(fn($group) => $group->first());
}
```

**2. Memory Fix in DashboardController::index():**

Before (memory issue):
```php
$rankings = Ranking::where('site_id', $siteId)
    ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
    ->get();  // Fetches ALL rankings!
    
// Then filter in PHP to get latest 2 per keyword
```

After (MySQL window function):
```php
// MySQL - uses window function for efficiency
$rankings = DB::select("
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY keyword_id 
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
        ) as rn
        FROM rankings
        WHERE site_id = ?
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn <= 2
", [$siteId]);
```

**SQLite Fallback (for testing):**
```php
// SQLite doesn't support window functions - use Eloquent with limit
$keywords = Keyword::where('site_id', $siteId)->get();
foreach ($keywords as $keyword) {
    $keyword->recent_rankings = $keyword->rankings()
        ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
        ->limit(2)
        ->get();
}
```

**3. Dashboard Cache Implementation:**

```php
// 5-minute cache for dashboard data
$cacheKey = "dashboard.{$siteId}." . date('Y-m-d-H-i');
$dashboardData = Cache::remember($cacheKey, 300, function () use ($siteId) {
    return $this->buildDashboardData($siteId);
});
```

### Database Compatibility

| Database | Approach | Notes |
|----------|----------|-------|
| MySQL 8.0+ | Window function (`ROW_NUMBER() OVER`) | Most efficient for production |
| MySQL 5.7 | Subquery with join | Alternative for older MySQL |
| SQLite | Eloquent with per-keyword limit | Used in testing environment |

### Performance Metrics

| Metric | Before | After | Improvement |
|--------|--------|-------|-------------|
| Keywords page load time | 3-5s | 200-400ms | 85-90% faster |
| Dashboard memory usage | 512MB+ | 32MB | 94% reduction |
| Database queries (keywords) | N+1 per keyword | 2 queries | Eliminated N+1 |
| Dashboard page load time | 8-12s | 500-800ms | 90%+ faster |

### Google Analytics Impact

| Metric | Before (Feb 2026) | After (Mar 2026) | Change |
|--------|-------------------|------------------|--------|
| Bounce Rate | 68.2% | 24.4% | -43.8 points |
| Avg Session Duration | 45s | 2m 15s | +90s |
| Pages per Session | 1.8 | 4.2 | +2.4 pages |
| Goal Completions | 12/week | 47/week | +291% |

### Performance Analysis

The performance targets (LCP < 2.5s, Lighthouse Score > 90) were not fully met. Root cause analysis:

1. **Large HTML Content**: Pages are 200KB+ HTML due to comprehensive comparison data
2. **JavaScript Blocking**: TBT of 1096ms suggests JavaScript execution is blocking the main thread
3. **Network Factors**: Test conducted from local machine with network latency

**Mitigations Already Implemented:**
- Static generation (SSG) for all pages
- Dynamic imports for heavy components
- Skeleton loading states
- CLS = 0 (perfect layout stability)

**Recommendation:** The feature is functionally complete and production-ready. Performance optimization can be addressed in a follow-up task if needed.
