## Static Fallback Provider (TASK-21-3)

### Service Description
Static, rule-based fallback provider for AI suggestions that generates SEO optimization suggestions without external AI dependencies. Ensures the AI suggestions feature always returns useful results even when AI providers are unavailable, rate-limited, or experiencing outages. Implements `AIProviderInterface` for seamless integration with the AI suggestion pipeline.

### Component Location
- **Provider:** `backend/app/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallbackProvider.php`
- **Service Provider:** `backend/app/Providers/AIServiceProvider.php`
- **Unit Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallbackProviderTest.php`
- **Indicator Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallback/` (10 files)

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `generate($prompt, $options)` | Generate rule-based suggestions based on indicator type |
| `isAvailable()` | Always returns `true` (no external dependencies) |
| `getName()` | Returns 'static_fallback' |

### Supported Indicators (10 Types)

| Indicator | Rules Implemented | Score Range |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| `title` | Length (50-60 chars optimal), keyword presence, duplicate words, all caps, brand-only detection | 0-100 |
| `meta_description` | Length (150-160 chars optimal), CTA detection, keyword presence, title duplication | 0-100 |
| `robots` | Site blocking detection, CSS/JS blocking, admin path exposure, sitemap reference | 0-100 |
| `sitemap` | XML parsing, urlset/sitemapindex detection, lastmod/changefreq/priority validation | 0-100 |
| `headings` | H1 uniqueness, hierarchy validation (H1→H2→H3), empty heading detection, keyword boost | 0-100 |
| `image_alt` | Missing/empty alt detection, keyword presence in alt text | 0-100 |
| `filenames` | Spaces, special chars, generic names, uppercase, missing extension detection | 0-100 |
| `url` | HTTPS check, query parameters, dynamic URLs, underscores, keyword presence | 0-100 |
| `links` | Internal/external balance, broken links, noopener/nofollow, anchor text analysis | 0-100 |
| `404` | Error detection, redirect suggestions, referrer analysis | 0-100 |

### Rule-Based Scoring Example (Title)

```php
private function scoreTitle(string $title, array $context): array
{
    $score = 100;
    $issues = [];

    // Length check (optimal: 50-60 characters)
    $length = strlen($title);
    if ($length < 30) {
        $score -= 20;
        $issues[] = "Title is too short ({$length} chars). Aim for 50-60 characters.";
    } elseif ($length > 60) {
        $score -= 15;
        $issues[] = "Title is too long ({$length} chars). Keep under 60 characters.";
    }

    // Keyword presence
    $keyword = $context['keyword'] ?? '';
    if ($keyword && stripos($title, $keyword) === false) {
        $score -= 25;
        $issues[] = "Target keyword '{$keyword}' not found in title.";
    }

    return [
        'score' => max(0, $score),
        'issues' => $issues,
        'suggestions' => $this->generateTitleSuggestions($title, $context),
    ];
}
```

### Response Format

All responses follow the standard AI provider JSON schema:

```json
{
  "score": 78,
  "issues": [
    "Title is too short (15 chars). Aim for 50-60 characters.",
    "Target keyword 'test' not found in title."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "type": "improve",
      "text": "Test Page Title | Premium Quality Products",
      "reason": "Includes target keyword and value proposition"
    }
  ],
  "best_practices": [
    "Keep title under 60 characters",
    "Place primary keyword near the beginning"
  ]
}
```

### Provider Identification

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `provider` | `static_fallback` |
| `model` | `rule-based` |
| `tokens` | `0` (no token consumption) |
| `latency` | `< 50ms` (typical) |

### Service Container Integration

**AIServiceProvider Binding:**
```php
$this->app->bind(AIProviderInterface::class, function ($app) {
    return new \App\Services\AI\Providers\StaticFallbackProvider();
});
```

**AISuggestionService Integration:**
```php
class AISuggestionService
{
    public function getSuggestions(string $indicator, array $context): SuggestionResult
    {
        return $this->provider->generate($indicator, $context);
    }
}
```

## AI Suggestion API Endpoint (TASK-21-5)

### Service Description
REST API endpoint for generating AI-powered SEO suggestions. Receives indicator type and page context, processes through the AI suggestion service, and returns structured optimization recommendations with scoring and actionable suggestions.

### Component Location
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AISuggestionController.php`
- **Request:** `backend/app/Http/Requests/AISuggestionRequest.php`
- **Rule:** `backend/app/Rules/MaxContextLength.php`
- **Exception:** `backend/app/Exceptions/AIServiceUnavailableException.php`
- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/ai/suggestions`

### API Endpoint

**POST /api/v1/ai/suggestions**

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Content-Type | application/json |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request Body:**
```json
{
    "indicator": "title",
    "context": {
        "title": "Home - My Website",
        "content_summary": "E-commerce homepage selling widgets...",
        "keyword": "best widgets"
    },
    "provider": "openrouter",
    "debug": false
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `indicator` | string | Yes | SEO indicator type (enum) |
| `context` | object | Yes | Page context data (max 5000 chars) |
| `provider` | string | No | AI provider: openrouter, vercel, static |
| `debug` | boolean | No | Enable debug mode (requires auth) |

**Supported Indicators:**
| Indicator | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `title` | Title tag optimization |
| `meta_description` | Meta description optimization |
| `robots` | Robots.txt analysis |
| `sitemap` | XML sitemap analysis |
| `headings` | Heading structure analysis |
| `image_alt` | Image alt text suggestions |

| 500 | Internal Server Error | `{"message": "An error occurred processing your request."}` |
| 503 | Service Unavailable | `{"message": "AI service temporarily unavailable."}` |

## AI Suggestion Caching Layer (TASK-21-6)

### Service Description
Caching layer for AI suggestions that stores responses for identical requests to reduce API calls, costs, and improve response times. Uses SHA-256 hashing for request deduplication with configurable TTL (default 24 hours). Part of the AI Suggestions via OpenRouter/Vercel Gateway feature (FEAT-021).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/AISuggestionCache.php`
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/AICacheController.php`
- **Command:** `backend/app/Console/Commands/AICacheClear.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/ai.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/AISuggestionCacheTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Services/AI/AISuggestionCacheIntegrationTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Console/AICacheClearCommandTest.php`

### Core Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|--------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `generateHash()` | indicator, context, provider | string | SHA-256 hash for request deduplication |
| `get()` | hash | ?array | Retrieve cached response or null |
| `set()` | hash, response, ttlHours | void | Store response in cache with TTL |
| `invalidate()` | hash | bool | Remove specific cache entry |
| `invalidateByIndicator()` | indicator | int | Remove all entries for indicator |
| `clear()` | - | int | Clear all cache entries |
| `getStats()` | - | array | Get hit/miss statistics |
| `resetStats()` | - | void | Reset statistics counters |
| `logMetrics()` | - | void | Log cache metrics to file |

### Hash Generation

```php
public function generateHash(string $indicator, array $context, string $provider): string
{
    $data = [
        'indicator' => $indicator,
        'context' => $this->normalizeContext($context),
        'provider' => $provider,
    ];
    return hash('sha256', json_encode($data));
}

private function normalizeContext(array $context): array
{
    ksort($context); // Sort keys for consistent hashing
    return $context;
}
```

### Cache Flow

```
Request → Generate Hash → Check Cache
                           ↓
                    ┌──────┴──────┐
                    ↓             ↓
                   HIT           MISS
                    ↓             ↓
              Return cached   Call AI provider
                    ↓             ↓
                    └─────→ Store in cache ←─────┘
                                  ↓
                          Return response
```

### Admin API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|----------|--------|------|-------------|
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache/stats` | GET | Admin | Get cache statistics |
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache/invalidate` | POST | Admin | Invalidate specific entry |
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache` | DELETE | Admin | Clear all cache entries |

**POST /api/v1/admin/ai/cache/invalidate Request:**
```json
{
    "hash": "abc123...64chars"
}
```

**GET /api/v1/admin/ai/cache/stats Response:**
```json
{
    "total_entries": 1250,
    "hits": 8500,
    "misses": 3200,
    "hit_ratio": 0.726,
    "evictions": 45
}
```

### Artisan Command

```bash
php artisan ai:cache:clear [options]

Options:
  --force     Skip confirmation prompt
  --dry-run   Show what would be cleared without deleting
  --stats     Show cache statistics before/after clearing
```

### Configuration

| Environment Variable | Default | Description |
|---------------------|---------|-------------|
| `AI_CACHE_ENABLED` | `true` | Enable/disable caching |
| `AI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS` | `24` | Cache time-to-live in hours |
| `CACHE_DRIVER` | `file` | Laravel cache driver |

**config/ai.php:**
```php
'cache' => [
    'enabled' => env('AI_CACHE_ENABLED', true),
    'ttl_hours' => env('AI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS', 24),
],
```

### Performance Characteristics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Hash generation | < 5ms |
| Cache get | < 1ms |
| Cache set | < 2ms |
| Cache hit response time | < 10ms (vs 1-5s AI generation) |
| Expected hit rate | 60-80% for common indicators |
| Storage | File-based (`storage/framework/cache/data/`) |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Admin-only endpoints | Sanctum authentication with admin role |
| Input validation | Hash must be 64-character hexadecimal |
| Cache key isolation | Prefix `ai_suggestions:` prevents collision |
| No sensitive data | Only stores AI suggestions (non-PII) |

## AILogger Service with Debug Mode (TASK-21-7)

### Service Description
Debug logging and monitoring service for AI suggestions feature. Provides comprehensive logging of AI requests, responses, and errors with privacy-focused data sanitization. Debug mode exposes detailed information about prompts, responses, and provider behavior for troubleshooting while protecting sensitive data. Part of the AI Suggestions via OpenRouter/Vercel Gateway feature (FEAT-021).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/AILogger.php`
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AISuggestionController.php` (debug mode integration)
- **Config:** `backend/config/logging.php` (ai channel)
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/AILoggerTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/AIDebugModeTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

**AILogger Methods:**
| Method | Parameters | Description |
|--------|------------|-------------|
| `logRequest(string $indicator, array $context, string $provider): void` | indicator type, request context, provider name | Log AI request with sanitized context |
| `logResponse(string $indicator, array $response, int $latencyMs): void` | indicator type, response data, latency in ms | Log AI response with metrics |
| `logError(string $indicator, string $error, array $context = []): void` | indicator type, error message, optional context | Log AI errors with sanitized context |
| `logDebug(string $message, array $data = []): void` | debug message, optional data | Log debug information when debug mode enabled |

### Debug Mode Implementation

**Activation Requirements:**
| Requirement | Implementation |
|-------------|----------------|
| Environment Variable | `AI_DEBUG=true` in `.env` |
| Authentication | User must be authenticated (Sanctum) |
| Both Required | Debug mode only active when BOTH conditions met |

**Debug Response Structure:**
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "data": { /* suggestions */ },
    "debug": {
        "prompt": "Full prompt text sent to AI...",
        "raw_response": "Raw JSON from provider...",
        "tokens_used": 245,
        "latency_ms": 1250,
        "provider": "openrouter",
        "model": "llama-3.1-8b-instruct"
    }
}
```

**Security Constraints:**
| Constraint | Implementation |
|------------|----------------|
| No API keys in debug | Keys masked as `***REDACTED***` |
| No PII in debug | User data excluded from debug output |
| Auth required | Unauthenticated requests never get debug info |
| Production safe | Debug mode disabled by default |

### Privacy Protection

**Sensitive Key Masking:**
The AILogger automatically masks sensitive keys in logged data:
| Key Pattern | Masked Value |
|-------------|--------------|
| `api_key`, `apikey` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `password`, `passwd` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `token`, `secret` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `authorization` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `private_key` | `***REDACTED***` |

**PII Exclusion:**
The following fields are excluded from logs entirely:
| Excluded Field | Reason |
|----------------|--------|
| `user_email` | Personal identifier |
| `user_name` | Personal identifier |
| `user_id` | Personal identifier |
| `ip_address` | Personal identifier |

**URL Anonymization:**
URLs are anonymized in logs by hashing the path/query:
```
Original: https://example.com/users/123/profile?token=abc
Logged:   https://example.com/[anon:a1b2c3d4e5f6...]
```

### Log Channel Configuration

**Logging Channel:**
```php
// config/logging.php
'channels' => [
    'ai' => [
        'driver' => 'daily',
        'path' => storage_path('logs/ai.log'),
        'level' => 'debug',
        'days' => 30,
    ],
],
```

**Log Retention:**
| Setting | Value | Purpose |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Driver | `daily` | Automatic rotation |
| Retention | 30 days | Reasonable debug window |
| Level | `debug` | Capture all log levels |

### Request Hash Generation

Each AI request is assigned a unique SHA-256 hash for correlation:
```php
$hash = hash('sha256', $indicator . json_encode($context) . time());
```

**Hash Usage:**
- Correlate request/response logs
- Track request lifecycle
- Debug timing issues
- Identify duplicate requests

## ContextWindowManager Service (TASK-31-2)

### Service Description
Core AI context window management service that estimates token counts, validates content against model context limits, and selects optimal AI models based on content size. Foundation service for the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031), enabling intelligent model selection and prompt size validation.

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/ContextWindowManager.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/ContextWindowManagerTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `estimateTokens(string $content): int` | Estimate token count from content using character-based approximation |
| `fitsInContext(string $model, int $estimatedTokens): bool` | Check if content fits within model's effective context limit |
| `selectOptimalModel(int $estimatedTokens): string` | Choose the smallest sufficient model for content size |
| `getEffectiveLimit(string $model): int` | Return effective context limit after safety margin and overhead |
| `getModelLimits(): array` | Return all supported model context limits |

### Model Context Limits

| Model | Context Window | Effective Limit |
|-------|----------------|-----------------|
| `google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free` | 1,000,000 | ~996,600 tokens |
| `qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free` | 32,768 | ~28,600 tokens |
| `mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free` | 32,768 | ~28,600 tokens |
| `meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free` | 8,192 | ~4,600 tokens |

### Implementation Details

**Constants:**
```php
private const MODEL_LIMITS = [
    'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free' => 1000000,
    'qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free' => 32768,
    'mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free' => 32768,
    'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free' => 8192,
];

private const SAFETY_MARGIN = 0.10;      // 10% safety margin
private const BASE_PROMPT_OVERHEAD = 3400; // System prompt + schema
```

**Token Estimation:**
```php
public function estimateTokens(string $content): int
{
    // Character-based estimation: 1 token ≈ 4 characters
    return (int) ceil(strlen($content) / 4);
}
```

**Effective Limit Calculation:**
```php
public function getEffectiveLimit(string $model): int
{
    $limit = self::MODEL_LIMITS[$model] ?? 8192;
    return (int) ($limit * (1 - self::SAFETY_MARGIN)) - self::BASE_PROMPT_OVERHEAD;
}
```

**Model Selection Logic:**
```php
public function selectOptimalModel(int $estimatedTokens): string
{
    // Model priority: smallest sufficient first (Llama → Qwen → Mistral → Gemini)
    $models = [
        'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free',
        'qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free',
        'mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free',
        'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free',
    ];

    foreach ($models as $model) {
        if ($this->fitsInContext($model, $estimatedTokens)) {
            return $model;
        }
    }

    // Fallback: will need truncation
    return 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free';
}
```

### Effective Limit Formula

```
effectiveLimit = (rawLimit × 0.9) - 3400
```

**Example Calculations:**
| Model | Raw Limit | After Safety (90%) | After Overhead | Effective |
|-------|-----------|-------------------|----------------|-----------|
| Gemini 2.0 Flash | 1,000,000 | 900,000 | 896,600 | ~996,600 |
| Qwen 2 7B | 32,768 | 29,491 | 26,091 | ~28,600 |
| Mistral 7B | 32,768 | 29,491 | 26,091 | ~28,600 |
| Llama 3 8B | 8,192 | 7,373 | 3,973 | ~4,600 |

### Model Selection Priority

The service selects the **smallest sufficient model** to optimize for:
1. **Cost efficiency** - Smaller models are faster and cheaper
2. **Resource optimization** - Reserve larger context for content that needs it
3. **Graceful fallback** - Always returns a model (Gemini for oversized content)

**Selection Order:**
1. Llama 3 8B (~4,600 tokens effective) - For small content
2. Qwen 2 7B (~28,600 tokens effective) - For medium content
3. Mistral 7B (~28,600 tokens effective) - Alternative medium
4. Gemini 2.0 Flash (~996,600 tokens effective) - For large content / fallback

## Error Handling and Recovery (TASK-19-13)

### Feature Description
Comprehensive error handling and recovery mechanisms for the Progressive Analysis & Job System (FEAT-019). Provides error categorization, user-friendly messages, retry logic with backoff, memory monitoring, partial completion support, and structured logging for the analysis pipeline.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Analysis/ErrorHandlingService.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Analysis/ErrorHandlingServiceTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-19-13.md`

### Files Modified
- `backend/app/Jobs/ProcessIndicatorJob.php` - Integrated ErrorHandlingService
- `backend/app/Jobs/StartAnalysisJob.php` - Added partial completion support
- `backend/app/Services/ProgressService.php` - Added `markSkipped()` method
- `backend/config/logging.php` - Added `analysis-errors` channel

### Error Categories

| Category | Description | Retryable |
|----------|-------------|-----------|
| `timeout` | Network or processing timeout | Yes |
| `rate_limit` | Target site rate limiting (429) | Yes |
| `invalid_url` | Malformed or blocked URL | No |
| `ssrf` | SSRF attack attempt blocked | No |
| `memory` | Memory exhaustion approaching | No |
| `network` | Connection failure | Yes |
| `parsing` | HTML/content parsing failure | No |
| `unknown` | Unclassified error | No |

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `categorizeError(Exception $e): string` | Classifies error into one of 8 categories |
| `getUserMessage(Exception $e): string` | Returns user-friendly error message |
| `shouldRetry(string $category): bool` | Determines if error is retryable |
| `getBackoffSeconds(int $attempt): int` | Calculates exponential backoff delay |
| `isMemoryExhausted(): bool` | Checks if approaching memory limit |
| `logError(Exception $e, array $context): void` | Logs to dedicated channel |

### User-Friendly Messages

| Error Category | User Message |
|----------------|--------------|
| `timeout` | "The request took too long to complete. Please try again." |
| `rate_limit` | "The target site is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." |
| `invalid_url` | "The URL provided is not valid or accessible." |
| `ssrf` | "The URL provided cannot be accessed for security reasons." |
| `memory` | "The analysis is too large to process. Please try with a smaller scope." |
| `network` | "Unable to connect to the target site. Please check your connection." |
| `parsing` | "Unable to analyze the page content." |
| `unknown` | "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again." |

### Retry Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Max retries | 3 | Maximum retry attempts for retryable errors |
| Base backoff | 1 second | Initial backoff delay |
| Max backoff | 30 seconds | Maximum backoff cap |
| Backoff multiplier | 2x | Exponential growth factor |

**Backoff Calculation:**
```
delay = min(base * 2^(attempt-1), max_backoff)
Example: 1s → 2s → 4s → 8s → 16s → 30s (capped)
```

### Memory Monitoring

| Threshold | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| 80% of limit | Warning logged |
| 90% of limit | Graceful shutdown initiated |
| 95% of limit | Critical alert, job marked failed |

**Memory Check Implementation:**
```php
public function isMemoryExhausted(): bool
{
    $usage = memory_get_usage(true);
    $limit = ini_get('memory_limit');
    $limitBytes = $this->parseMemoryLimit($limit);
    
    return ($usage / $limitBytes) > 0.90;
}
```

### Partial Completion Support

Jobs can complete with partial results when some indicators fail:

```php
// In ProgressService
public function markSkipped(int $jobId, string $indicatorSlug, string $reason): void
{
    $result = AnalysisJobResult::where('job_id', $jobId)
        ->where('indicator_slug', $indicatorSlug)
        ->first();
    
    $result->update([
        'status' => 'skipped',
        'error_message' => $reason,
    ]);
    
    $this->updateProgress($jobId);
}
```

### Structured Logging

All errors logged to dedicated `analysis-errors` channel:

**Log Entry Format:**
```json
{
  "level": "error",
  "message": "Analysis indicator failed",
  "context": {
    "job_id": 123,
    "indicator": "meta_tags",
    "category": "timeout",
    "url": "https://example.com",
    "attempt": 2,
    "duration_ms": 30000
  },
  "channel": "analysis-errors"
}
```

### Integration Points

| Component | Integration |
|-----------|-------------|
| ProcessIndicatorJob | Wraps indicator processing with error handling |
| StartAnalysisJob | Handles partial completion scenarios |
| ProgressService | Provides `markSkipped()` for graceful degradation |
| IndicatorProcessor | Reports errors with context |

### Error Flow

```
Indicator Processing
    │
    ├─► Success → markComplete()
    │
    └─► Failure
            │
            ├─► categorizeError()
            │
            ├─► shouldRetry()?
            │       │
            │       ├─► Yes → backoff → retry
            │       │
            │       └─► No → logError() → markFailed()
            │
            └─► isMemoryExhausted()?
                    │
                    ├─► Yes → graceful shutdown
                    │
                    └─► No → continue with next indicator
```

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| No sensitive data in logs | URLs sanitized, credentials stripped |
| SSRF errors hidden | Generic message for security-related blocks |
| Memory safe | Graceful handling before exhaustion |

## Rate Limiting for Analysis Jobs (TASK-19-14)

### Service Description
Comprehensive rate limiting system for analysis job creation and API endpoints. Implements multiple rate limit tiers to prevent abuse while allowing legitimate usage, with Redis-backed distributed rate limiting for multi-instance deployments.

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Analysis/AnalysisRateLimiterService.php`
- **Middleware:** `backend/app/Http/Middleware/PollingRateLimiter.php`
- **Config:** `bootstrap/app.php` (middleware alias: `polling.ratelimit`)

### Core Functionalities

**AnalysisRateLimiterService Class:**
| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool` | Check if user can create a new job |
| `canMakeApiRequest(User $user): bool` | Check API rate limit (60/min) |
| `canPollJob(User $user, AnalysisJob $job): bool` | Check polling rate limit (30/min/job) |
| `recordJobCreation(User $user, Site $site): void` | Record job creation for rate limiting |
| `recordApiRequest(User $user): void` | Record API request |
| `recordPollRequest(User $user, AnalysisJob $job): void` | Record polling request |
| `getRateLimitHeaders(string $key, int $limit): array` | Generate rate limit headers |
| `buildRateLimitResponse(string $message, int $retryAfter): JsonResponse` | Build 429 response |

### Rate Limit Tiers

| Limit Type | Value | Scope | Purpose |
|------------|-------|-------|---------|
| Jobs per user per hour | 10 | Per user | Prevent job flooding |
| Jobs per site per hour | 5 | Per site | Site-level protection |
| Concurrent jobs per user | 2 | Per user | Resource management |
| API requests per minute | 60 | Per user | General API protection |
| Polling requests per minute | 30 | Per job | Prevent polling abuse |

### Sliding Window Algorithm

Rate limiting uses a sliding window via Laravel Cache (Redis-backed):

```php
class AnalysisRateLimiterService
{
    private const JOB_LIMITS = [
        'user_hourly' => 10,
        'site_hourly' => 5,
        'user_concurrent' => 2,
    ];

    private const API_LIMITS = [
        'requests_per_minute' => 60,
        'polling_per_minute' => 30,
    ];

    public function canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool
    {
        // Check all three limits
        return $this->checkUserHourlyLimit($user)
            && $this->checkSiteHourlyLimit($site)
            && $this->checkConcurrentLimit($user);
    }
}
```

### Rate Limit Headers

All rate-limited responses include standard headers:

```http
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 45
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1709049600
```

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests allowed in window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining in current window |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when window resets |

### 429 Response Format

When rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.",
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

**Response Headers:**
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 30
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1709049600
```

### Admin Bypass

Admin users can bypass rate limits for testing and debugging:

```php
public function canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool
{
    // Admin bypass
    if ($user->is_admin ?? false) {
        return true;
    }

    return $this->enforceLimits($user, $site);
}
```

### PollingRateLimiter Middleware

Dedicated middleware for polling endpoint rate limiting:

```php
class PollingRateLimiter
{
    public function handle($request, Closure $next)
    {
        $job = $request->route('job');
        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$this->rateLimiter->canPollJob($user, $job)) {
            return $this->rateLimiter->buildRateLimitResponse(
                'Polling rate limit exceeded',
                $this->rateLimiter->getRetryAfter($user, $job)
            );
        }

        $this->rateLimiter->recordPollRequest($user, $job);

        $response = $next($request);

        // Add rate limit headers
        foreach ($this->rateLimiter->getRateLimitHeaders($user, $job) as $name => $value) {
            $response->header($name, $value);
        }

        return $response;
    }
}
```

### Redis Configuration

Rate limiting uses Laravel Cache with Redis driver for distributed systems:

```php
// config/cache.php
'default' => env('CACHE_STORE', 'redis'),

'stores' => [
    'redis' => [
        'driver' => 'redis',
        'connection' => 'cache',
        'lock_connection' => 'default',
    ],
],
```

**Key Patterns:**
| Key Pattern | TTL | Purpose |
|-------------|-----|---------|
| `rate_limit:user:{id}:hourly` | 3600s | User hourly job limit |
| `rate_limit:site:{id}:hourly` | 3600s | Site hourly job limit |
| `rate_limit:user:{id}:concurrent` | - | Concurrent job count |
| `rate_limit:api:{id}:minute` | 60s | API rate limit |
| `rate_limit:poll:{job_id}:minute` | 60s | Polling rate limit |

### SPEC-006 Compatibility

Rate limit responses follow the existing SPEC-006 format:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 30 seconds.",
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Per-User Isolation | Each user has separate rate limit tracking |
| Per-Job Isolation | Polling limits scoped to individual jobs |
| Timing Attack Prevention | Consistent response times |
| Admin Bypass | Admin users skip rate limits |
| Distributed Support | Redis-backed for multi-instance |

### Component Interface

### State Management

|-------|-----------|----------|
| `isModalOpen` | boolean | Controls ExportModal visibility |
| `hasResults` | `data && Object.keys(data).length > 0` | Determines if export is available |

### Disabled State Logic

```typescript
const hasResults = data && Object.keys(data).length > 0;
const isDisabled = !hasResults || isGenerating;
```

| Condition | hasResults | isGenerating | Disabled |
|-----------|------------|--------------|----------|
| Empty data | false | false | ✓ Yes |
| Null data | false | false | ✓ Yes |
| Valid data | true | false | ✗ No |
| Generating | true | true | ✓ Yes |

When `isGenerating=true`:

- Text changes to "Generating..."
- Button remains disabled
- aria-label updates to "Generating export..."

### Description

### Integration Points

### Integration Pattern

Each tool result page integrates ExportResultsButton using a consistent pattern:

```tsx
{analysisComplete && (
  <div className="flex justify-end mb-4">
    <ExportResultsButton
      toolName="meta-tag-analyzer"
      url={analyzedUrl}
      data={resultsData}
    />
  </div>
)}
```

### Data Structure (ToolResultData)

```typescript
interface ToolResultData {
  analyzedAt: string;  // ISO timestamp
  results: {
    [indicatorName: string]: {
      value: string | number | boolean;
      status: 'ok' | 'warning' | 'error';
      recommendation?: string;
    };
  };
  summary?: {
    score?: number;
    passed: number;
    warnings: number;
    failed: number;
  };
}
```

### Data Mapping by Tool

**Meta Tag Analyzer:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    title: { value: result.title, status: titleStatus },
    description: { value: result.description, status: descStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passCount, warningCount, failCount },
};
```

**Keyword Density Checker:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    density: { value: density.toFixed(2), status: densityStatus },
    occurrences: { value: occurrences, status: 'ok' },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed: passCount, warnings: warnCount, failed: failCount },
};
```

**Mobile-Friendly Checker:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    viewport: { value: viewportContent, status: viewportStatus },
    responsive: { value: hasResponsiveGrid, status: responsiveStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed, warnings, failed },
};
```

**Social Media Preview:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    openGraph: { value: ogTitle, status: ogStatus },
    twitterCard: { value: cardType, status: twitterStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed, warnings, failed },
};
```

### Consistent UX Implementation

| Aspect | Implementation |
|--------|---------------|
| Button Positioning | `flex justify-end mb-4` in results header |
| Button Text | "Export Results" with Download icon |
| aria-label | "Export analysis results" |
| Conditional Display | `analysisComplete && !isLoading` |
| Disabled State | No data or during generation |
| Mobile Responsive | Standard touch targets, responsive classes |

## Mobile Navigation Sheet Component (TASK-28-13)

### Component Description
Responsive mobile navigation component implementing a slide-in Sheet drawer with hamburger menu trigger. Provides touch-friendly navigation for authenticated users on mobile devices (< 768px breakpoint). Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/layout/MobileNav.tsx`
- **Integration:** `frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/layout/MobileNav.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TASK-28-13.md`

### Core Functionalities

**MobileNav Component:**
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Hamburger Menu | Toggle button visible on mobile only (`md:hidden` class) |
| Sheet Drawer | Slides in from left side with animation |
| Navigation Items | Full navigation menu with icons and labels |
| Active State | Visual indicator for current route |
| Touch Targets | Minimum 44px height for accessibility |
| Route Change | Auto-closes on navigation |
| Escape Key | Closes sheet on Escape press |
| Backdrop Click | Closes sheet when clicking outside |

### Component Interface

```typescript
interface NavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  icon?: string;      // Lucide icon name
  badge?: string | number; // Optional badge (notification count)
}

interface UserInfo {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  avatar?: string;
}

interface MobileNavProps {
  navItems: NavItem[];
  currentPath: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  user?: UserInfo | null;
  side?: 'left' | 'right';
}
```

### Responsive Behavior

| Breakpoint | Behavior |
|------------|----------|
| < 768px (md) | Hamburger menu visible, Sheet drawer functional |
| >= 768px | Hamburger menu hidden (`md:hidden`), desktop nav shown |

### Navigation Items Configuration

```typescript
const navItems: NavItem[] = [
  { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard', icon: 'LayoutDashboard' },
  { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects', icon: 'FolderKanban' },
  { label: 'Keywords', href: '/keywords', icon: 'Key' },
  { label: 'Reports', href: '/reports', icon: 'FileBarChart' },
  { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings', icon: 'Settings' },
];
```

### Accessibility Implementation

| ARIA Attribute | Value | Purpose |
|----------------|-------|---------|
| `aria-label` (hamburger) | "Open navigation menu" | Screen reader announcement |
| `aria-expanded` | true/false | State indication |
| `role` (sheet) | "dialog" | Dialog semantics |
| `aria-modal` | "true" | Focus trap indication |
| `aria-label` (sheet) | "Navigation menu" | Sheet purpose |

**WCAG 2.1 Compliance:**
- Touch targets minimum 44x44px (Success Criterion 2.5.5)
- Focus trap when sheet is open
- Focus returns to hamburger on close
- Keyboard navigation support (Tab, Escape)
- Screen reader state announcements

### Close Triggers

| Trigger | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Route change | `useEffect` on `pathname` from `usePathname()` |
| Backdrop click | Handled by shadcn Sheet component |
| Escape key | Native Sheet behavior |
| Nav item click | Calls `onOpenChange(false)` |

### Active State Styling

| State | Styling |
|-------|---------|
| Active nav item | Blue indicator bar, highlighted background |
| Inactive nav item | Default styling, hover effects |

### Integration with Header

The MobileNav component integrates with `Header.tsx`:

```typescript
// Header.tsx integration
<header>
  {/* Desktop navigation - visible on md+ */}
  <nav className="hidden md:flex">
    {/* Desktop nav items */}
  </nav>

  {/* Mobile navigation - visible below md */}
  <MobileNav
    navItems={navItems}
    currentPath={pathname}
    isOpen={mobileNavOpen}
    onOpenChange={setMobileNavOpen}
    user={user}
    className="md:hidden"
  />
</header>
```

## ToolEmbed Component for Guide-Tool Integration (TASK-20-22)

### Service Description
Frontend component for embedding interactive SEO tools from FEAT-016 into SEO guide pages. Provides a seamless user experience where users can test their meta tags, check mobile-friendliness, or preview social media shares directly within the educational guide context. Part of the SEO Guides Library + Clean Routing feature (FEAT-020).

### Component Location
- **File:** `frontend/components/guides/ToolEmbed.tsx`
- **Export:** `frontend/components/guides/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/guides/ToolEmbed.test.tsx`

### Component Architecture

```
ToolEmbed (main export)
├── ToolEmbedInner (wrapped in ErrorBoundary)
│   ├── LoadingSkeleton (lazy loading state)
│   ├── FallbackUI (invalid tool slug)
│   └── ToolWidget (actual tool rendering)
└── ErrorFallback (error boundary UI)
```

### Supported Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `toolSlug` | `ToolSlug \| string` | **required** | Tool to embed |
| `title` | `string` | tool name | Custom title override |
| `description` | `string` | tool description | Custom description override |
| `showCta` | `boolean` | `true` | Show "Use Full Tool" CTA button |
| `ctaText` | `string` | `"Use Full Tool"` | CTA button text |
| `className` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable lazy loading |
| `stateKey` | `string` | - | State persistence key |
| `onAnalysisComplete` | `(result) => void` | - | Analysis callback |

### Valid Tool Slugs

| toolSlug | Tool Page Route | Description |
|----------|-----------------|-------------|
| `meta-tag-analyzer` | `/tools/meta-tag-analyzer/` | Meta title and description analyzer |
| `keyword-density` | `/tools/keyword-density/` | Keyword frequency analysis |
| `social-preview` | `/tools/social-preview/` | Open Graph and Twitter Card preview |
| `mobile-friendly-checker` | `/tools/mobile-friendly/` | Mobile responsiveness checker |

### Core Features

**Graceful Fallback:**
- Invalid or missing `toolSlug` displays friendly message
- CTA button directs users to tools index page
- Error boundary catches and displays tool errors

**Mobile Responsiveness:**
- Responsive wrapper adapts to container width
- CTA button styled for touch targets
- Full-width tool widget on mobile

**Security:**
- XSS prevention for all text inputs
- `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on external links
- Sanitized tool slug validation

**Accessibility:**
- Proper ARIA attributes on interactive elements
- Screen reader support for tool status
- Keyboard accessible CTA button

**Performance:**
- Lazy loading via Next.js `dynamic()` import
- Loading skeleton during tool load
- Error boundary prevents full page crashes

### TypeScript Types

```typescript
type ToolSlug = 'meta-tag-analyzer' | 'keyword-density' | 'social-preview' | 'mobile-friendly-checker';

interface ToolEmbedProps {
  toolSlug: ToolSlug | string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  showCta?: boolean;
  ctaText?: string;
  className?: string;
  lazy?: boolean;
  stateKey?: string;
  onAnalysisComplete?: (result: AnalysisResult) => void;
}
```

### Usage Examples

**Basic Tool Embed:**
```tsx
import { ToolEmbed } from '@/components/guides';

export default function MetaTitleGuide() {
  return (
    <GuideLayout>
      <GuideContent guide={guide} />
      <ToolEmbed toolSlug="meta-tag-analyzer" />
    </GuideLayout>
  );
}
```

**Custom Title and CTA:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="social-preview"
  title="Preview Your Social Shares"
  ctaText="Open Full Preview Tool"
/>
```

**With State Persistence:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="meta-tag-analyzer"
  stateKey="guide-meta-title-demo"
  onAnalysisComplete={(result) => console.log('Analysis:', result)}
/>
```

**Disable Lazy Loading:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="keyword-density"
  lazy={false}
/>
```

### Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Invalid `toolSlug` | Fallback UI with CTA to tools index |
| Tool crashes | Error boundary catches, shows error fallback |
| Tool unavailable | Loading skeleton → fallback UI |

## Public Audit Views Table (TASK-33-2)

### Service Description
Database migration for tracking analytics on public audit page views. Stores view events with privacy-conscious data collection (IP hashing, referrer tracking) to measure the reach and effectiveness of shared SEO audits. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports feature (FEAT-033).

### Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE public_audit_views (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    audit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    public_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    viewed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    referrer VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    ip_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    user_agent VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    country_code CHAR(2) NULL,
    is_lead_capture BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    lead_email VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    FOREIGN KEY (audit_id) REFERENCES audits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX public_audit_views_audit_id_index (audit_id),
    INDEX public_audit_views_public_hash_index (public_hash),
    INDEX public_audit_views_viewed_at_index (viewed_at)
);
```

### Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | Primary key |
| `audit_id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | FK to audits.id (CASCADE delete) |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | Public sharing hash for the audit |
| `viewed_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the view occurred |
| `referrer` | VARCHAR(500) | HTTP Referrer header (truncated to 500 chars) |
| `ip_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | SHA-256 hash of IP + app.key salt (privacy) |
| `user_agent` | VARCHAR(500) | Browser user agent (truncated to 500 chars) |
| `country_code` | CHAR(2) | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code |
| `is_lead_capture` | BOOLEAN | Whether visitor submitted email |
| `lead_email` | VARCHAR(255) | Email if lead capture submitted |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | Record creation timestamp |

### Indexes

| Index Name | Columns | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| `public_audit_views_audit_id_index` | audit_id | Query views by audit |
| `public_audit_views_public_hash_index` | public_hash | Query views by public hash |
| `public_audit_views_viewed_at_index` | viewed_at | Date range queries |

### Foreign Keys

| Constraint | Columns | References | On Delete |
|------------|---------|------------|-----------|
| `public_audit_views_audit_id_foreign` | audit_id | audits.id | CASCADE |

### Model Relationships

**PublicAuditView Model:**
| Method | Relationship | Description |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| `audit()` | belongsTo | The audit this view belongs to |

### Model Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `forAudit($id)` | Filter views by audit_id |
| `forHash($hash)` | Filter views by public_hash |
| `leadCaptures()` | Filter where is_lead_capture = true |
| `withLeadEmail()` | Filter where lead_email is not null |
| `viewedBetween($start, $end)` | Filter by date range |
| `fromCountry($code)` | Filter by country_code |
| `recent($days)` | Filter views from last N days |

### Factory States

| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `forAudit($audit)` | Associate with specific audit |
| `withHash($hash)` | Set specific public_hash |
| `withReferrer()` | Include referrer URL |
| `withCountry($code)` | Set country code |
| `leadCapture($email)` | Mark as lead capture with email |
| `viewedAt($timestamp)` | Set specific viewed_at time |
| `viewedDaysAgo($days)` | Set viewed_at to N days ago |
| `fromGoogle()` | Set referrer to Google |
| `directVisit()` | No referrer (direct traffic) |
| `chromeBrowser()` | Chrome user agent |
| `safariBrowser()` | Safari user agent |
| `mobileDevice()` | Mobile user agent |
| `withFullAnalytics()` | All analytics fields populated |
| `withIpHash($ip)` | Custom IP hash |

### Privacy Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| IP Hashing | SHA-256 hash with app.key salt |
| No PII Storage | Original IP never stored |
| Referrer Truncation | Limited to 500 chars |
| User Agent Truncation | Limited to 500 chars |

## Badge Impressions Table (TASK-33-3)

### Service Description
Database migration for tracking analytics on embedded badge impressions and clicks. Measures the reach of embedded SEO score widgets on third-party sites, storing impression and click events with privacy-conscious data collection (IP hashing, referrer domain extraction). Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports feature (FEAT-033).

### Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE badge_impressions (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    audit_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    public_hash VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    referrer_domain VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    impression_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    clicked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    click_target VARCHAR(10) NULL,
    ip_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (audit_id) REFERENCES audits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX idx_badge_impressions_audit_id (audit_id),
    INDEX idx_badge_impressions_public_hash (public_hash),
    INDEX idx_badge_impressions_impression_at (impression_at)
);
```

### Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | Primary key |
| `audit_id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | FK to audits.id (CASCADE delete) |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(32) | Public sharing hash for the audit |
| `referrer_domain` | VARCHAR(255) | Domain extracted from HTTP Referer (domain only, no path) |
| `impression_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the impression occurred (auto-set on create) |
| `clicked_at` | TIMESTAMP NULL | When the user clicked the badge (initially NULL) |
| `click_target` | VARCHAR(10) NULL | Where the click led: 'audit' or 'home' |
| `ip_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | SHA-256 hash of IP + app.key salt (privacy) |

### Indexes

| Index Name | Columns | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| `idx_badge_impressions_audit_id` | audit_id | Query impressions by audit |
| `idx_badge_impressions_public_hash` | public_hash | Query impressions by public hash |
| `idx_badge_impressions_impression_at` | impression_at | Date range queries |

### Foreign Keys

| Constraint | Columns | References | On Delete |
|------------|---------|------------|-----------|
| `badge_impressions_audit_id_foreign` | audit_id | audits.id | CASCADE |

### Model Relationships

**BadgeImpression Model:**
| Method | Relationship | Description |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| `audit()` | belongsTo | The audit this impression belongs to |

### Model Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `forAudit($id)` | Filter impressions by audit_id |
| `forHash($hash)` | Filter impressions by public_hash |
| `clicked()` | Filter where clicked_at is not null |
| `notClicked()` | Filter where clicked_at is null |
| `withClickTarget($target)` | Filter by click_target ('audit' or 'home') |
| `recent($days)` | Filter impressions from last N days |

### Model Accessors

| Accessor | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `is_clicked` | Boolean check if clicked_at is not null |

### Model Static Helpers

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `hashIp($ip)` | Generate SHA-256 hash of IP with app.key salt |
| `extractDomain($url)` | Extract domain from URL (strips path/query) |
| `recordImpression($auditId, $hash, $ip, $referrer)` | Create new impression record |

### Factory States

| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `clicked()` | Impression with click event (clicked_at set) |
| `notClicked()` | Impression without click (clicked_at null) |
| `forAudit($audit)` | Associate with specific audit |
| `fromDomain($domain)` | Set referrer_domain |
| `clickAudit()` | Set click_target to 'audit' |
| `clickHome()` | Set click_target to 'home' |
| `recent($days)` | Set impression_at to N days ago |
| `withIpHash($ip)` | Set custom IP hash |
| `fromGoogle()` | Set referrer_domain to 'google.com' |
| `directVisit()` | No referrer (direct traffic) |
| `withHash($hash)` | Set specific public_hash |

### Privacy Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| IP Hashing | SHA-256 hash with app.key salt |
| No PII Storage | Original IP never stored, only hash |
| Domain Extraction | Only domain stored, no full URL or path |
| Hidden Attribute | `ip_hash` hidden from JSON serialization |

### Click Tracking

| Click Target | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| `audit` | User clicked to view full audit report |
| `home` | User clicked to visit SEOIndicator homepage |
| NULL | No click yet (impression only) |

### CTR Calculation

```sql
-- Click-Through Rate formula
SELECT
    COUNT(*) as total_impressions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN clicked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as clicks,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN clicked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 as ctr_percent
FROM badge_impressions
WHERE audit_id = ?;
```

### Endpoint: GET /api/v1/public-audit/{hash}

**Purpose:** Retrieve public audit data for display on public audit page.

**Request Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `hash` | string | Yes | 32-character public audit hash |

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "hash": "abc123def456...",
    "site_url": "https://example.com",
    "audited_at": "2026-03-06T12:00:00Z",
    "overall_score": 85,
    "category_scores": {
      "technical": 90,
      "on_page": 85,
      "content": 80,
      "performance": 88
    },
    "top_issues": [
      { "id": 1, "name": "Missing meta description", "severity": "medium" },
      { "id": 2, "name": "H1 tag missing", "severity": "high" }
    ],
    "is_partial": true
  }
}
```

**Response Fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `hash` | string | 32-character public audit hash |
| `site_url` | string | Audited site URL |
| `audited_at` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of audit |
| `overall_score` | integer | Overall SEO score (0-100) |
| `category_scores` | object | Scores by category (technical, on_page, content, performance) |
| `top_issues` | array | Top issues found in audit |
| `is_partial` | boolean | true for anonymous users, false for audit owners |

**Error Responses:**
| Status | Condition |
|--------|-----------|
| 404 | Invalid hash, non-existent audit, or private audit |

### Endpoint: POST /api/v1/public-audit/{hash}/lead

**Purpose:** Capture lead email for users requesting full audit access.

**Request Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `hash` | string | Yes | 32-character public audit hash |
| `email` | string | Yes | User email address (validated) |

**Request Body:**
```json

  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "success": true,

```

**Email Validation:**
- RFC-compliant email format validation
- Maximum 254 characters
- Normalized to lowercase
- Whitespace trimmed

**Error Responses:**
| Status | Condition |
|--------|-----------|
| 404 | Invalid hash or non-public audit |
| 422 | Invalid email format |

### Endpoint: GET /api/v1/public-audit/{hash}/badge

**Purpose:** Retrieve badge configuration for embedding on third-party sites.

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "hash": "abc123def456...",
    "score": 85,
    "site_url": "https://example.com",
    "badge_url": "https://seoindicator.com/badge/abc123def456",
    "sizes": ["small", "medium", "large"],
    "themes": ["light", "dark"],
    "embed_code": {
      "svg": "<a href=\"https://seoindicator.com/audit/abc123/\"><img src=\"https://seoindicator.com/badge/abc123/small.svg\" /></a>",
      "js": "<div data-seoindicator-badge=\"abc123\"></div><script src=\"https://seoindicator.com/badge.js\"></script>"
    }
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
| Status | Condition |
|--------|-----------|
| 404 | Invalid hash or non-public audit |

### Score Calculation Logic

The controller calculates overall SEO score from audit issues:

```php
$score = 100;
foreach ($issues as $issue) {
    match ($issue->severity) {
        'critical' => $score -= 10,
        'warning' => $score -= 5,
        'notice' => $score -= 2,
        default => null
    };
}
return max(0, min(100, $score)); // Clamp to 0-100
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Hash Enumeration Protection | Same 404 response for non-existent and non-public audits |
| SQL Injection Prevention | Parameterized queries via Eloquent, hash validation |
| XSS Prevention | Email sanitized, no raw user content in responses |
| Path Traversal Prevention | Hash validated as 32-char alphanumeric |
| Rate Limiting | 100 requests/hour per hash (IP + hash key) |
| No Sensitive Data | Only technical SEO data exposed, no PII |
| Private Audit Isolation | visibility='private' audits return 404 |

### Rate Limiting Configuration

| Endpoint | Limit | Window | Key |
|----------|-------|--------|-----|
| All public endpoints | 100 requests | 60 minutes | IP + hash combination |

### View Tracking

Each GET request to the audit endpoint creates a record in `public_audit_views`:
- Records view timestamp, referrer, IP hash
- Used for analytics on public audit reach
- Privacy-conscious: IP hashed with SHA-256 + salt

### Lead Capture Storage

Lead emails are stored in `public_audit_views` table:
- `is_lead_capture` = true
- `lead_email` = captured email address
- Linked to audit via `audit_id`

## PublicAuditPage Component (TASK-33-8)

Integrates child components (CategoryBreakdown, TopIssues, PublicAuditCTA) for a complete user experience. Server-side rendered for SEO optimization with ISR revalidation. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

```typescript
// Server Component - fetches data for SEO
export default async function AuditPage({ params }: { params: { hash: string } }) {

  return <AuditPageClient hash={params.hash} initialData={data} />;
}
```

```typescript
// Client Component - handles interactivity

}
```

## IndicatorIcon Wrapper Component (TASK-28-4)

### Service Description
Reusable React component that wraps Lucide icons with consistent styling for SEO indicators. Supports custom SVG icons, size variants, and color variants. Foundation component for the Indicator Catalog and used throughout the application for consistent iconography. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **File:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorIcon.tsx`
- **Export:** `frontend/components/indicators/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/components/indicators/__tests__/IndicatorIcon.test.tsx`

### Props Interface

```typescript
interface IndicatorIconProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'color'> {
  /** Lucide icon name from the registry */
  icon?: LucideIconName;
  /** Custom SVG element to render instead of Lucide icon */
  customIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Size variant: sm (16px), md (24px), lg (32px) */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  /** Color variant */
  color?: 'default' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
  /** Accessible label for screen readers */
  'aria-label'?: string;
  /** Additional CSS classes */
  className?: string;
}
```

### Icon Registry

The component maintains a registry of Lucide icons commonly used for SEO indicators:

| Icon Name | Lucide Component | Use Case |
|-----------|------------------|----------|
| `Activity` | Activity | Activity/engagement metrics |
| `AlertCircle` | AlertCircle | Critical alerts |
| `AlertTriangle` | AlertTriangle | Warning indicators |
| `CheckCircle` | CheckCircle | Success/completion |
| `ChevronDown` | ChevronDown | Expandable content |
| `Eye` | Eye | Visibility score |
| `FileText` | FileText | Content analysis |
| `HelpCircle` | HelpCircle | Help/tooltip triggers |
| `Info` | Info | Information |
| `Link2` | Link2 | Backlink profile |
| `Search` | Search | Search/keywords |
| `Star` | Star | SERP features |
| `TrendingUp` | TrendingUp | Keyword rankings |
| `Users` | Users | Competitor analysis |
| `Warning` | AlertTriangle | Warning (backward compat) |
| `Wrench` | Wrench | Technical health |
| `XCircle` | XCircle | Error states |
| `Zap` | Zap | Page speed |

### Size Variants

| Size | Dimensions | Stroke Width | Tailwind Class |
|------|------------|--------------|----------------|
| `sm` | 16px | 1.5px | `size-4 stroke-[1.5]` |
| `md` | 24px (default) | 2px | `size-6 stroke-2` |
| `lg` | 32px | 2.5px | `size-8 stroke-[2.5]` |

### Color Variants

| Color | Light Mode | Dark Mode | Use Case |
|-------|------------|-----------|----------|
| `default` | `text-current` | `text-current` | Inherits text color |
| `primary` | `text-primary` | `text-primary` | Primary brand |
| `success` | `text-emerald-600` | `text-emerald-400` | Good status |
| `warning` | `text-amber-500` | `text-amber-400` | Warning status |
| `error` | `text-destructive` | `text-destructive` | Error/critical |

### Core Features

**Visual Elements:**
- Consistent 24x24 viewBox (default)
- 2px stroke width (default)
- Rounded corners (1px radius via `rounded-sm`)
- Inline-flex container for proper alignment

**Behavior:**
- Returns `null` if no icon or customIcon provided
- Returns `null` if icon name not found in registry
- Supports both Lucide icons and custom SVGs

**Accessibility:**
- `aria-hidden="true"` by default (decorative)
- `role="img"` with `aria-label` when label provided
- `focusable="false"` on SVG to prevent keyboard focus

### Usage Examples

```tsx
// Basic Lucide icon (default size: md, default color: inherits text)
<IndicatorIcon icon="TrendingUp" />

// With size and color variants
<IndicatorIcon icon="CheckCircle" size="lg" color="success" />

// Small icon for inline use
<IndicatorIcon icon="Search" size="sm" />

// Custom SVG icon
<IndicatorIcon
  customIcon={<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>}
  size="md"
/>

// With accessibility label
<IndicatorIcon
  icon="AlertTriangle"
  aria-label="Warning: needs attention"
  color="warning"
/>

// With custom class
<IndicatorIcon
  icon="Star"
  className="animate-pulse"
/>
```

- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-28-15.md`

### Registry Structure

```typescript
// Type for valid custom icon names
export type CustomIconName = string;

// Props interface for custom icon components
export interface CustomIconProps extends React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}

// Frozen registry object
export const CUSTOM_ICONS: Readonly<Record<CustomIconName, React.FC<CustomIconProps>>> = Object.freeze({
  // Custom icons are added here as needed
  // Example: 'robot-indicator': RobotIndicatorIcon,
});

// Array of all custom icon names
export const CustomIconNames: readonly CustomIconName[] = Object.freeze(
  Object.keys(CUSTOM_ICONS) as CustomIconName[]
);
```

### Design Guidelines

All custom icons must follow these design guidelines to ensure consistency with Lucide icons:

| Guideline | Value | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| ViewBox | 24x24 | Standard icon size |
| Stroke Width | 2px | Matches Lucide style |
| Corner Radius | 1px | Rounded appearance |
| Color | `currentColor` | Inherits from parent text color |
| Fill | `none` | Stroke-based icons |
| strokeLinecap | `round` | Smooth line endings |
| strokeLinejoin | `round` | Smooth corners |

### Size Variants

Custom icons support the same size variants as IndicatorIcon:

| Size | Dimensions | Use Case |
|------|------------|----------|
| `sm` | 16x16px | Inline indicators, badges |
| `md` | 24x24px | Default size, cards |
| `lg` | 32x32px | Hero sections, dashboards |

### Integration with IndicatorIcon

Custom icons are used through the `customIcon` prop on the IndicatorIcon component:

```tsx
import { CUSTOM_ICONS } from '@/components/icons/custom';
import { IndicatorIcon } from '@/components/indicators';

// Using a custom icon
<IndicatorIcon
  customIcon={<CUSTOM_ICONS['robot-indicator'] />}
  size="md"
  color="primary"
/>

// With accessibility label
<IndicatorIcon
  customIcon={<CUSTOM_ICONS['custom-icon']} />}
  aria-label="Custom indicator description"
/>
```

### Current Registry Status

**Registry Status:** Empty (by design)

The registry intentionally starts empty because:
1. TASK-28-14 (Lucide Icon Mapping) provides complete icon coverage for all 8 SEO indicators
2. Custom icons are created **only where Lucide doesn't provide suitable alternatives**
3. This follows the explicit task requirement: "Start with Lucide icons. Only create custom icons where Lucide doesn't provide a suitable alternative."

### Adding New Custom Icons

When a need for a custom icon is identified:

1. **Create the SVG component** following design guidelines:
```tsx
// frontend/components/icons/custom/my-custom-icon.tsx
export const MyCustomIcon: React.FC<CustomIconProps> = ({ size = 'md', ...props }) => {
  const dimensions = { sm: 16, md: 24, lg: 32 }[size];
  
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={dimensions}
      height={dimensions}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      {...props}
    >
      {/* SVG paths */}
    </svg>
  );
};
```

2. **Add to registry:**
```tsx
// frontend/components/icons/custom/registry.ts
export const CUSTOM_ICONS = Object.freeze({
  'my-custom-icon': MyCustomIcon,
});
```

3. **Update type and exports:**
```tsx
// Update CustomIconName type
export type CustomIconName = 'my-custom-icon';

// Export from barrel
export { MyCustomIcon } from './my-custom-icon';
```

## IndicatorGrid Responsive Layout (TASK-28-6)

### Component Description
React component for displaying multiple SEO indicator cards in a responsive CSS Grid layout. Provides a 12-column grid system with configurable breakpoints, gap spacing variants, and animated transitions. Serves as the container for IndicatorCard components in the homepage indicator catalog. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **File:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorGrid.tsx`
- **Export:** `frontend/components/indicators/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/components/indicators/__tests__/IndicatorGrid.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-28-6.md`

### Props Interface

```typescript
interface IndicatorGridProps {
  indicators: IndicatorData[];  // Array of indicator data to display
  columns?: ColumnConfig;       // Responsive column configuration
  gap?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';     // Gap spacing variant
  className?: string;           // Additional CSS classes
}

interface ColumnConfig {
  mobile?: number;  // Columns at mobile (< 640px)
  sm?: number;      // Columns at sm (≥ 640px)
  md?: number;      // Columns at md (≥ 768px)
  lg?: number;      // Columns at lg (≥ 1024px)
  xl?: number;      // Columns at xl (≥ 1280px)
}

interface IndicatorData {
  id: string;
  icon: LucideIconName | React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  value: string | number;
  description: string;
  status: 'good' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'neutral';
  href: string;
  tooltip?: string;
}
```

### Default Responsive Breakpoints

| Breakpoint | Min Width | Columns | Tailwind Class |
|------------|-----------|---------|----------------|
| Mobile | 0px | 1 | `grid-cols-1` |
| sm | 640px | 2 | `sm:grid-cols-2` |
| md | 768px | 3 | `md:grid-cols-3` |
| lg | 1024px | 4 | `lg:grid-cols-4` |
| xl | 1280px | 4 | `xl:grid-cols-4` |

### Gap Spacing Variants

| Gap | Tailwind Class | Size | Use Case |
|-----|----------------|------|----------|
| `sm` | `gap-2` | 0.5rem (8px) | Compact layouts |
| `md` | `gap-4` | 1rem (16px) | Default, standard spacing |
| `lg` | `gap-6` | 1.5rem (24px) | Spacious layouts |

### Core Features

**CSS Grid Layout:**
- 12-column grid system using Tailwind CSS
- Responsive column configuration at all breakpoints
- Custom column override support via `columns` prop

**Responsive Behavior:**
- Mobile-first approach (1 column by default)
- Automatic column adjustment at breakpoints
- Custom column config merges with defaults

**Animated Transitions:**
- Smooth layout transitions on resize
- `transition-all duration-200 ease-out`
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` media query
- GPU-accelerated transforms

**Loading State:**
- Displays 8 skeleton cards when `isLoading` context is true
- `aria-busy="true"` attribute during loading
- `data-loading="true"` attribute for testing

| Row Count | `aria-rowcount` for item count |

| Keyboard | Tab navigation through cards |

## SEO Guides Library - Apache .htaccess Configuration (TASK-20-26)

### Service Description
Apache `.htaccess` configuration for SEO guides clean URL routing with trailing slash normalization, 301 permanent redirects, and comprehensive security features. Ensures all 17 guide routes work correctly on production Apache/LiteSpeed servers with proper SEO optimization.

### Component Location
- **File:** `frontend/public/.htaccess`
- **Deployed To:** `out/.htaccess` (copied during build)
- **Production Path:** `public_html/.htaccess` (Hostinger)

### Core Functionalities

**Routing Rules:**

| Rule | Pattern | Action | Status Code |
|------|---------|--------|-------------|
| Index Redirect | `/seo-guides` | → `/seo-guides/` | 301 |
| Index Serve | `/seo-guides/` | Serve `index.html` | 200 |
| Guide Redirect | `/seo-guides/[slug]` | → `/seo-guides/[slug]/` | 301 |
| Guide Serve | `/seo-guides/[slug]/` | Serve `index.html` | 200 |

**Rewrite Rules:**
```apache
# Enable rewrite engine
RewriteEngine On

# /seo-guides -> /seo-guides/ (301 permanent redirect)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/seo-guides$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ /seo-guides/ [L,R=301]

# /seo-guides/[slug] -> /seo-guides/[slug]/ (301 permanent redirect)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/seo-guides/([a-z0-9-]+)$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^seo-guides/(.*)$ /seo-guides/$1/ [L,R=301]
```

### Security Features

**File Access Blocking:**

| Category | Pattern | Reason |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Hidden Files | `^\.([a-z]+)$` | Block .htaccess, .env, .git, etc. |
| Backup Files | `\.(bak|backup|old|orig|save)$` | Prevent backup file exposure |
| Sensitive Files | `package\.json|composer\.json|yarn\.lock` | Hide project configuration |

**Security Headers:**
```apache
# Security Headers
Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
Header set X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block"
Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
```

### Performance Features

**Gzip Compression:**
| Content Type | Extensions |
|--------------|------------|
| Text/HTML | html, htm, css, js |
| Application | json, xml, atom, rss |
| Fonts | woff, woff2, svg |

**Cache Headers:**

| Resource Type | Cache Duration | Headers |
|---------------|----------------|---------|
| Images | 1 year | Cache-Control: max-age=31536000 |
| Fonts | 1 year | Cache-Control: max-age=31536000 |
| CSS/JS | 1 month | Cache-Control: max-age=2592000 |
| HTML | 1 hour | Cache-Control: max-age=3600 |

### Configuration

**Apache Requirements:**
- `mod_rewrite` enabled
- `mod_headers` enabled
- `mod_deflate` enabled (for gzip)
- `AllowOverride All` in Apache config

**Next.js Integration:**
```typescript
// next.config.ts
{
  output: 'export',           // Static site generation
  trailingSlash: true,        // Required for clean URLs
  images: { unoptimized: true }
}
```

**Build Output Structure:**
```
out/
├── .htaccess                    # Apache configuration
├── seo-guides/
│   ├── index.html               # Guide index
│   ├── meta-title/index.html    # Guide page
│   ├── meta-description/index.html
│   └── ... (17 guides total)
```

## Google CSE Fetcher (TASK-1-8)

### Service Description
SERP fetcher implementation using Google Custom Search API free tier. Provides real search results within free quota limits (100 queries/day), enabling production testing with actual search data while respecting the free tools constraint.

### Core Functionalities

**GoogleCSEFetcher Class:**
| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `fetch(string $keyword, array $options = []): SERPResult` | Fetch SERP results for a keyword |
| `isQuotaExceeded(): bool` | Check if API quota has been exceeded |
| `setFallbackFetcher(?SERPFetcherInterface $fetcher): void` | Set fallback fetcher for quota/rate limit scenarios |

### API Configuration

**Environment Variables:**
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GOOGLE_CSE_API_KEY` | Google Custom Search API key |
| `GOOGLE_CSE_ID` | Custom Search Engine ID |

**Configuration (config/services.php):**
```php
'google_cse' => [
    'api_key' => env('GOOGLE_CSE_API_KEY'),
    'search_engine_id' => env('GOOGLE_CSE_ID'),
    'timeout' => 30,
    'max_results' => 10,
],
```

### Free Tier Limitations

| Limitation | Value | Mitigation |
|------------|-------|------------|
| Daily quota | 100 queries/day | Fallback to MockSERPFetcher |
| Results per query | 10 results | Document limitation, use for top 10 tracking |
| Rate limiting | 429 errors | Retry with exponential backoff |

### Error Handling

| HTTP Code | Error Type | Behavior |
|-----------|------------|----------|
| 200 | Success | Parse and return results |
| 400 | Invalid credentials | Return error, no fallback |
| 403 | Quota exceeded | Fall back to MockSERPFetcher |
| 429 | Rate limited | Fall back to MockSERPFetcher |
| 500+ | Server error | Retry up to 3 times |

### SERP Result Structure

```php
interface SERPResult {
    public string $keyword;
    public string $searchEngine;
    public string $location;
    public string $device;
    public array $results;       // SERPEntry[]
    public DateTime $checkedAt;
    public ?string $error;
    public int $durationMs;
}

interface SERPEntry {
    public int $position;
    public string $url;
    public string $title;
    public string $description;
    public bool $isOurSite;
}
```

### SERP Features Extraction

The fetcher extracts additional SERP features from API response:
- `did_you_mean` - Spelling correction suggestions
- `images` - Image pack results
- `structured_data` - Rich snippets (reviews, ratings)

### Fallback Behavior

When quota is exceeded or rate limited:
1. Log warning with quota usage details
2. If fallback fetcher is configured, delegate to it
3. Return fallback results with indication of fallback status

```php
// Fallback configuration
$googleFetcher = new GoogleCSEFetcher($apiKey, $searchEngineId);
$mockFetcher = new MockSERPFetcher();
$googleFetcher->setFallbackFetcher($mockFetcher);
```

### Quota Monitoring

Daily logging of API usage for quota tracking:
```php
Log::channel('daily')->info('Google CSE API usage', [
```

## AI Rate Limiting for Suggestions API (TASK-21-10)

### Service Description
Comprehensive rate limiting system for AI suggestion endpoints to prevent abuse, manage API quotas, and ensure fair usage. Implements per-user and per-IP rate limits with configurable thresholds using a sliding window algorithm. Part of the AI Suggestions via OpenRouter/Vercel Gateway feature (FEAT-021).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/AIRateLimiter.php`
- **Middleware:** `backend/app/Http/Middleware/AIRateLimiter.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/ai.php` (rate_limits section)
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/AIRateLimiterTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Http/Middleware/AIRateLimiterTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

**AIRateLimiter Service Methods:**
| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `checkLimit(string $identifier, string $type): bool` | Check if request is within rate limit |
| `getRemaining(string $identifier, string $type): int` | Get remaining requests in window |
| `getResetTime(string $identifier, string $type): int` | Get Unix timestamp when window resets |
| `increment(string $identifier, string $type): void` | Record a request against the limit |

### Rate Limit Tiers

| Limit Type | Default | Environment Variable | Scope |
|------------|---------|---------------------|-------|
| Per-User | 20 requests/hour | `AI_RATE_LIMIT_USER` | Authenticated users by user ID |
| Per-IP | 10 requests/hour | `AI_RATE_LIMIT_IP` | Anonymous users by IP address |

### Sliding Window Algorithm

Rate limiting uses a sliding window via Laravel Cache:

```php
class AIRateLimiter
{
    private const WINDOW_SECONDS = 3600; // 1 hour

    public function checkLimit(string $identifier, string $type): bool
    {
        $key = "ai_rate_limit:{$type}:{$identifier}";
        $current = Cache::get($key, []);

        // Filter out expired entries
        $windowStart = now()->subSeconds(self::WINDOW_SECONDS);
        $current = array_filter($current, fn($t) => $t > $windowStart);

        $limit = $this->getLimit($type);
        return count($current) < $limit;
    }
}
```

### Rate Limit Headers

All AI endpoint responses include rate limit headers:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests per window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Remaining requests in current window |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when window resets |

### 429 Response Format

When rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429:

```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 1800
X-RateLimit-Limit: 10
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1709123456

{
    "success": false,
    "error": {
        "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
        "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 30 minutes.",
        "retry_after": 1800
    }
}
```

### Configuration

```php
// config/ai.php
'rate_limits' => [
    'user' => [
        'limit' => env('AI_RATE_LIMIT_USER', 20),
        'window_seconds' => 3600,
    ],
    'ip' => [
        'limit' => env('AI_RATE_LIMIT_IP', 10),
        'window_seconds' => 3600,
    ],
],
```

### Middleware Registration

```php
// bootstrap/app.php
->alias([
    'ai.ratelimit' => \App\Http\Middleware\AIRateLimiter::class,
])

// routes/api.php
Route::post('/ai/suggestions', [AISuggestionController::class, 'generate'])
    ->middleware('ai.ratelimit');
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| User Isolation | Each user has separate rate limit tracking |
| IP Validation | X-Forwarded-For header validated |
| Null Byte Handling | Identifiers truncated at null bytes |
| SQL Injection Protection | No database interaction with identifiers |
| Admin Bypass | Admin users can bypass rate limits |
| OPTIONS Bypass | CORS preflight requests bypass rate limiting |

### Identifier Formats

| Type | Format | Example |
|------|--------|---------|
| User | `user:{id}` | `user:123` |
| IP | `ip:{address}` | `ip:192.168.1.1` |

## SEO Analyses Table (TASK-18-1)

### Service Description
Database migration for storing SEO analysis results. Foundation table for the Legacy 17-Indicator SEO Analysis feature (FEAT-018), supporting both authenticated users and anonymous session-based tracking.

### Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE seo_analyses (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    session_id VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    domain VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    normalized_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    overall_score TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending',
    error_message TEXT NULL,
    analysis_data JSON NOT NULL,
    checked_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    INDEX seo_analyses_user_id_domain_index (user_id, domain),
    INDEX seo_analyses_session_id_domain_index (session_id, domain),
    INDEX seo_analyses_normalized_url_index (normalized_url),
    INDEX seo_analyses_status_index (status),
    INDEX seo_analyses_expires_at_index (expires_at)
);
```

### Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | Primary key |
| `user_id` | BIGINT UNSIGNED | FK to users.id (nullable for anonymous users) |
| `session_id` | VARCHAR(64) | Session identifier for anonymous tracking |
| `domain` | VARCHAR(500) | Original domain input |
| `normalized_url` | VARCHAR(500) | Normalized URL (https:// + domain) |
| `overall_score` | TINYINT UNSIGNED | Weighted SEO score (0-100) |
| `status` | ENUM | Analysis status: `pending`, `running`, `completed`, `failed` |
| `error_message` | TEXT | Error message if analysis failed |
| `analysis_data` | JSON | Full analysis results (indicators, scores, suggestions) |
| `checked_at` | TIMESTAMP | When analysis was completed |
| `expires_at` | TIMESTAMP | Cache expiry timestamp (24 hours) |

### Indexes

| Index Name | Columns | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| `seo_analyses_user_id_domain_index` | user_id, domain | User's analyses by domain |
| `seo_analyses_session_id_domain_index` | session_id, domain | Anonymous analyses by domain |
| `seo_analyses_normalized_url_index` | normalized_url | Lookup by normalized URL |
| `seo_analyses_status_index` | status | Filter by status |
| `seo_analyses_expires_at_index` | expires_at | Cache cleanup queries |

### Foreign Keys

| Constraint | Columns | References | On Delete |
|------------|---------|------------|-----------|
| `seo_analyses_user_id_foreign` | user_id | users.id | CASCADE |

### analysis_data JSON Structure

```json
    }

  }
}
```
