## Backlink Suggestions Service (TASK-23-12)

### Service Description
Generates actionable suggestions for improving backlink profile. Analyzes metrics from BacklinkProfileScorer and produces prioritized recommendations based on detected issues. Part of the Backlinks Indicator feature (FEAT-023).

### Component Location
- **Service:** ackend/app/Services/SEO/BacklinkSuggestionService.php
- **Dependency:** ackend/app/Services/SEO/BacklinkProfileScorer.php (TASK-23-8)
- **Tests:** ackend/tests/Unit/Services/SEO/BacklinkSuggestionServiceTest.php

### Core Methods

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| generate(Project ): array | Generate suggestions for a project (uses BacklinkProfileScorer internally) |
| generateFromMetrics(array ): array | Generate suggestions from raw metrics array |
| setScorer(BacklinkProfileScorer ): self | Set scorer instance (for testing) |

### Suggestion Thresholds

| Trigger | Threshold | Priority | Suggestion ID |
|---------|-----------|----------|---------------|
| Low referring domains | < 50 | High | low_referring_domains |
| High exact-match anchors | > 25% | High | high_exact_match_anchors |
| Low domain trust | < 40 | Medium | low_domain_trust |
| Declining backlinks | < -5% growth | Medium | declining_backlinks |
| High nofollow ratio | > 50% | Low | high_nofollow_ratio |

### Suggestion Output Structure

`php
[
    'id' => 'low_referring_domains',
    'title' => 'Increase Referring Domains',
    'description' => 'Build more referring domains. Guest posting and content marketing can help.',
    'priority' => 'high',      // high|medium|low
    'impact' => 'medium',      // high|medium|low (based on severity)
    'metrics' => [
        'current' => 15,       // Current value
        'benchmark' => 50,     // Target threshold
        'gap' => 35,           // Difference
    ],
]
`

### Impact Calculation Logic

**For Counts (referring domains, domain trust):**
- high: Gap = 70% of benchmark
- medium: Gap = 30% of benchmark
- low: Gap < 30% of benchmark

**For Ratios (exact match, nofollow):**
- high: Value = 50%
- medium: Value = 35%
- low: Value < 35%

**For Growth Rate (declining backlinks):**
- high: Decline = 20%
- medium: Decline = 10%
- low: Decline < 10%

### Priority Sorting

Suggestions are sorted by:
1. Priority level (high ? medium ? low)
2. Impact level (high ? medium ? low) within same priority

### Null/Edge Case Handling

| Case | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Null metric value | No suggestion generated (no data = no recommendation) |
| Negative domain count | Treated as 0 |
| Negative trust score | Treated as 0 |
| Invalid ratio > 1.0 | Capped at 1.0 |
| Zero total links | No nofollow ratio suggestion |
| At threshold value | No suggestion (thresholds are exclusive) |

### Integration Points

| Component | Relationship |
|-----------|--------------|
| BacklinkProfileScorer | Consumes output (component_details) |
| Backlink Dashboard | Displays suggestions with priority indicators |
| Visibility Score | Suggestions inform user of improvement areas |

### Controller Implementation

**BacklinkDomainsController:**
```php
class BacklinkDomainsController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private ReferringDomainRepository $domains
    ) {}

    public function index(Request $request, Project $project): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $project);
        
        $sort = $request->get('sort', 'backlinks_count');
        $perPage = min($request->get('perPage', 20), 100);
        
        $domains = $this->domains->paginate(
            $project->id,
            $perPage,
            $sort
        );
        
        return response()->json([
            'data' => $domains->items(),
            'meta' => [
                'total' => $domains->total(),
                'page' => $domains->currentPage(),
                'perPage' => $domains->perPage(),
                'lastPage' => $domains->lastPage(),
            ],
        ]);
    }
}
```

**BacklinkAnchorsController:**
```php
class BacklinkAnchorsController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private AnchorTextRepository $anchors
    ) {}

    public function index(Request $request, Project $project): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $project);
        
        $sort = $request->get('sort', 'percentage');
        
        $anchors = $this->anchors->getForProject($project->id, $sort);
        
        return response()->json([
            'data' => $anchors,
        ])->setEncodingOptions(JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION);
    }
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Bearer token required via `auth:sanctum` middleware |
| Authorization | ProjectPolicy `view` check before data access |
| IDOR Prevention | User must own the project (via ProjectPolicy) |
| SQL Injection | Parameterized queries via Eloquent/Query Builder |
| XSS Prevention | JSON response encoding with proper escaping |
| Input Validation | Sort field whitelist, perPage capped at 100 |

**Authorization Flow:**
1. User authenticates with Bearer token
2. Route resolves `{projectId}` to `Project` model
3. `ProjectPolicy::view()` checks `user_id === auth()->id()`
4. If authorized, controllers query data scoped to project
5. Cross-project data isolation enforced at repository level

## Backlinks API Endpoints - History & Sync (TASK-23-11)

### Feature Description
REST API endpoints for backlink history charts and manual sync triggering. Enables historical trend visualization and on-demand data refresh for backlink profiles. Part of the Backlinks Indicator feature (FEAT-023).

### Component Locations
- **History Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Backlinks/BacklinkHistoryController.php`
- **Sync Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Backlinks/BacklinkSyncController.php`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Permission | Description |
|--------|----------|------------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/backlinks/history` | `view` | Get historical backlink snapshots |
| POST | `/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/backlinks/sync` | `update` | Trigger manual backlink sync |

### History Endpoint

**Request:**
```
GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/backlinks/history?from=2026-01-01&to=2026-02-28
```

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `from` | date | No | Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to 30 days ago |
| `to` | date | No | End date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today |

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "date": "2026-01-01",
      "total_backlinks": 1100,
      "referring_domains_count": 75,
      "dofollow_count": 792,
      "nofollow_count": 308,
      "avg_domain_trust": 42.5,
      "anchor_diversity_score": 65.0
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-02-01",
      "total_backlinks": 1250,
      "referring_domains_count": 89,
      "dofollow_count": 900,
      "nofollow_count": 350,
      "avg_domain_trust": 45.2,
      "anchor_diversity_score": 68.0
    }
  ]
}
```

**History Response Fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `date` | string | Snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `total_backlinks` | integer | Total backlinks count |
| `referring_domains_count` | integer | Number of unique referring domains |
| `dofollow_count` | integer | Dofollow backlinks count |
| `nofollow_count` | integer | Nofollow backlinks count |
| `avg_domain_trust` | decimal | Average domain trust score (0-100) |
| `anchor_diversity_score` | decimal | Anchor text diversity score (0-100) |

### Sync Endpoint

**Request:**
```
POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/backlinks/sync
```

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "job_id": "backlink-sync-abc123",
    "status": "queued",
    "estimated_duration": "2-5 minutes"
  }
}
```

**Sync Response Fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `job_id` | string | Unique job identifier (format: `backlink-sync-{uuid}`) |
| `status` | string | Job status (`queued`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`) |
| `estimated_duration` | string | Estimated completion time |

### Rate Limiting

| Endpoint | Limit | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| Sync | 1/hour per project | Prevents excessive sync requests |
| History | Standard API limits | Standard rate limiting applies |

**Rate Limit Exceeded Response (429):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Sync already in progress or recently completed. Please wait before requesting another sync.",
    "retry_after": "2026-03-14T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Authorization

| Permission | Endpoint | Description |
|------------|----------|-------------|
| `view` | History | User must own project or have view access |
| `update` | Sync | User must own project or have update access |

**Authorization enforced via:**
- Laravel Sanctum authentication middleware
- ProjectPolicy for ownership verification

### Error Responses

| Status | Code | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| 401 | UNAUTHORIZED | Missing or invalid authentication token |
| 403 | FORBIDDEN | User lacks permission for this project |
| 404 | NOT_FOUND | Project does not exist |
| 422 | VALIDATION_ERROR | Invalid date parameters or precondition failed |
| 429 | TOO_MANY_REQUESTS | Rate limit exceeded |
| 503 | SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE | Job queue at capacity |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Bearer token via Laravel Sanctum |
| Authorization | ProjectPolicy ownership verification |
| IDOR Protection | Project-scoped queries, user isolation |
| SQL Injection Prevention | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| XSS Prevention | JSON response encoding, no HTML rendering |
| Rate Limiting | Cache-based per-project throttling |
| Input Validation | Date format, range, and boundary validation |

## Backlinks History Chart Component (TASK-23-14)

### Component Description
Interactive React chart component for visualizing backlink history trends over time. It renders historical backlink snapshot data from the authenticated history API and plots backlink count, referring domains, and average domain trust on a dual-axis line chart. The component keeps a local preset selector (`7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `1y`), derives the active preset from an incoming custom date range, and exposes `onDateRangeChange` so parent dashboards can synchronize filters. Part of the Backlinks Indicator feature (FEAT-023).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/backlinks/BacklinkHistoryChart.tsx`
- **API Client / Hook:** `frontend/lib/api/backlinks.ts`
- **Types:** `frontend/components/backlinks/types.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/components/backlinks/__tests__/BacklinkHistoryChart.simple.test.ts`

### Key Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Line Chart | Recharts `LineChart` with `CartesianGrid`, `Legend`, custom `Tooltip`, and `ResponsiveContainer` |
| 3 Data Series | Backlinks (blue), Domains (green), Trust Score (orange) |
| Date Range Selector | 4-button preset selector (`7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `1y`), defaulting to `30d` when no range is supplied |
| Trend Summary | Header badge showing signed percentage growth with `TrendingUp` / `TrendingDown` icons |
| Responsive Layout | Header stacks on small screens; chart renders inside an `h-80` container (~320px) |
| Loading State | Animated skeleton placeholder while SWR request is pending |
| Empty State | Icon + explanatory empty state when the API returns no history rows |
| Error State | Card-scoped error message when the history request fails |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface BacklinkHistoryChartProps {
  projectId: number;
  dateRange?: DateRange;
  onDateRangeChange?: (range: DateRange) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

### Data Visualization

**Line Configuration:**
| Series | Data Key | Color | Y-Axis |
|--------|----------|-------|--------|
| Backlinks | `total_backlinks` | `#2563eb` | Left |
| Referring Domains | `referring_domains_count` | `#16a34a` | Left |
| Trust Score | `avg_domain_trust` | `#f59e0b` | Right |

**Chart Behavior:**
- X-axis renders `displayDate` labels derived from the raw ISO `date` field.
- Left Y-axis formats counts through `formatNumber()` (`1.5K`, `1.0M`).
- Right Y-axis is fixed to the 0-100 trust-score range.
- All three series use `connectNulls` and hover `activeDot` styling.
- Tooltip content is custom-rendered and shows backlinks, domains, trust score, and growth/decline direction.

**Date Range Presets:**
| Preset | Days |
|--------|------|
| `7d` | 7 |
| `30d` | 30 |
| `90d` | 90 |
| `1y` | 365 |

### API Integration

**Hook:** `useBacklinkHistory(projectId, dateRange)`

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/backlinks/history`

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `from` | string | Optional start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `to` | string | Optional end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |

**Runtime Behavior:**
- Fetching is skipped when `projectId <= 0`.
- Requests are keyed by project ID + date range.
- SWR disables `revalidateOnFocus` and uses a 60s `dedupingInterval`.
- Query strings are assembled with `URLSearchParams`.

**Response Structure:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "date": "2026-03-01",
      "total_backlinks": 1250,
      "referring_domains_count": 89,
      "dofollow_count": 910,
      "nofollow_count": 340,
      "avg_domain_trust": 45.2,
      "anchor_diversity_score": 61.8
    }
  ]
}
```

**Backend Enforcement:**
- Route: `backend/routes/api.php`
- Controller: `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Backlinks/BacklinkHistoryController.php`
- Requires authenticated access and project `view` authorization.
- Rejects non-numeric `projectId` with `404`.
- Validates `from` / `to` as dates not later than today and rejects `from > to` with `422`.

### Helper Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `formatNumber(value)` | Formats large counts with K/M suffixes |
| `formatDate(dateStr)` | Formats ISO dates to short month/day labels |
| `getDateRangeFromPreset(preset)` | Converts `7d` / `30d` / `90d` / `1y` to a concrete `{ from, to }` range |
| `getPresetFromDateRange(range)` | Maps an incoming range back to the closest preset |
| `calculateGrowthRate(data)` | Calculates backlink growth percentage across the selected period |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| HTML Safety | Component renders plain React text and does not use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` |
| Encoded Query Params | `URLSearchParams` handles `from` / `to` encoding |
| Client Fetch Guard | `useBacklinkHistory()` only fetches when `projectId > 0` |
| Auth & Authorization | Backend route requires authenticated access plus `ProjectPolicy` view permission |
| Server-side Validation | Backend validates numeric project IDs and date boundaries before returning data |
| Low-Sensitivity Payload | Chart consumes aggregate snapshot metrics, not raw backlink-page content |

## Generate Suggestions Form Component (TASK-5-11)

### Component Description
React form component for generating new keyword suggestions. Users enter a seed keyword, select suggestion sources, and configure the maximum number of results. Integrates with the Keyword Discovery API (TASK-5-8) to fetch suggestions from Google Suggest and Question Keywords sources. Part of the Keyword Discovery & Suggestions feature (FEAT-005).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/suggestions/GenerateSuggestionsForm.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/suggestions/GenerateSuggestionsForm.test.tsx`

### Component Props

```typescript
interface GenerateSuggestionsFormProps {
  siteId: number;                              // Site ID for API calls
  onSuggestionsGenerated?: (count: number) => void;  // Success callback
}
```

### Form Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `seedKeyword` | text | Yes | - | Seed keyword for suggestion generation |
| `sources.suggest` | checkbox | No | `true` | Enable Google Suggest API |
| `sources.question` | checkbox | No | `true` | Enable Question Keywords generator |
| `sources.related` | checkbox | No | `false` | Enable Related Searches (disabled in MVP) |
| `maxResults` | slider | No | `50` | Maximum suggestions to return (10-100) |

### UI Elements

| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Seed Keyword Input | Text input with placeholder "Enter a seed keyword..." |
| Source Checkboxes | Toggle for each suggestion source |
| Max Results Slider | Range slider (10-100) with current value display |
| Generate Button | Submit button with loading state |
| Success Message | Displays count of new suggestions generated |
| Error Alert | Shows user-friendly error messages |
| Rate Limit Indicator | Displays remaining API requests (X/10) |

### Form Validation

| Validation Rule | Field | Behavior |
|-----------------|-------|----------|
| Required | `seedKeyword` | Submit disabled when empty |
| Min Length | `seedKeyword` | Minimum 2 characters |
| Max Length | `seedKeyword` | Maximum 100 characters |
| At Least One Source | `sources` | Submit disabled when no sources selected |

### Default Values

| Field | Default Value |
|-------|---------------|
| Google Suggest | `true` (checked) |
| Question Keywords | `true` (checked) |
| Related Searches | `false` (disabled in MVP) |
| Max Results | `50` |

### API Integration

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/suggestions/generate`

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "seedKeyword": "seo tools",
  "sources": ["suggest", "question"],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

**Success Response (202):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "jobId": "suggest-abc123",
    "status": "queued",
    "suggestionsGenerated": 37
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated request |
| 403 | User does not own site |
| 422 | Invalid seed keyword or sources |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (10 requests/hour) |

### State Management

| State | Display |
|-------|---------|
| `idle` | Form ready for input |
| `loading` | Button shows "Generating...", disabled |
| `success` | Success message with suggestion count |
| `error` | Error alert with retry option |

### User Experience

**Debounce Protection:**
- Submit button disabled during API call
- Rapid clicks ignored to prevent duplicate requests

**Form Reset:**
- Form resets to default values after successful generation
- Seed keyword input cleared
- Sources remain selected (user preference preserved)

**Rate Limit Display:**
- Shows remaining requests in real-time
- Updates after each successful generation

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| XSS Prevention | Input sanitized before API call |
| CSRF Protection | API uses Sanctum token authentication |
| Input Validation | Client-side validation + server-side validation |
| Rate Limiting | 10 requests per hour per user |
| Debounce | Prevents rapid form submissions |

## Suggestion Card Component (TASK-5-12)

### Component Description
React card component for displaying individual keyword suggestions in the suggestions list. Shows keyword text, source badge, opportunity score with progress bar, and action buttons (Track/Dismiss). Supports expanded view with additional details and keyboard accessibility. Part of the Keyword Discovery & Suggestions feature (FEAT-005).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/suggestions/SuggestionCard.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/suggestions/SuggestionCard.test.tsx`

### Component Props

```typescript
interface SuggestionCardProps {
  suggestion: KeywordSuggestion;           // Suggestion data object
  onTrack?: (id: number) => void;          // Track button callback
  onDismiss?: (id: number) => void;        // Dismiss button callback
  isLoading?: boolean;                     // Loading state for actions
}
```

### KeywordSuggestion Data Structure

```typescript
interface KeywordSuggestion {
  id: number;
  keyword: string;
  source: 'suggest' | 'question' | 'related';
  opportunityScore: number;                // 0-100
  isTracking: boolean;
  isDismissed: boolean;
  discoveredAt: string;                    // ISO date string
}
```

### Card Elements

| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Keyword Text | Primary display of the suggested keyword |
| Source Badge | Color-coded badge showing suggestion source |
| Opportunity Score | Numeric score (0-100) with progress bar |
| Track Button | Button to add keyword to tracking |
| Dismiss Button | Button to hide suggestion |
| Status Indicator | Checkmark if already tracking |
| Expanded Details | Discovered date, full score breakdown |

### Source Badge Colors

| Source | Color | CSS Class |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| `suggest` | Blue | `bg-blue-100 text-blue-800` |
| `question` | Purple | `bg-purple-100 text-purple-800` |
| `related` | Green | `bg-green-100 text-green-800` |

### Opportunity Score Display

| Score Range | Progress Bar Color | Visual |
|-------------|-------------------|--------|
| 0-33 | Red | Low opportunity |
| 34-66 | Yellow | Medium opportunity |
| 67-100 | Green | High opportunity |

### Card States

| State | Display |
|-------|---------|
| Default | Collapsed view with keyword, source, score |
| Expanded | Full details with discovered date |
| Tracking | Checkmark icon, "Tracking" label |
| Dismissed | Grayed out, "Dismissed" label |
| Loading | Spinner on action buttons |

### User Interaction

**Action Buttons:**
| Button | Action | Result |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Track | Click/Enter | Calls `onTrack(id)`, shows loading state |
| Dismiss | Click/Enter | Calls `onDismiss(id)`, shows loading state |
| Expand | Click card | Toggles expanded view |

**Keyboard Navigation:**
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Tab | Focus next card/action |
| Enter | Activate focused button |
| Space | Toggle expanded view |

### Loading States

| Loading Type | Display |
|--------------|---------|
| Track Loading | Track button shows spinner, disabled |
| Dismiss Loading | Dismiss button shows spinner, disabled |
| Action Complete | Button state updates immediately |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |

| XSS Prevention | Keyword text escaped before rendering |
| Script Tag Handling | `<script>` tags displayed as text, not executed |
| Special Characters | HTML entities properly encoded |
| URL Injection | No URL rendering in keyword display |

## Metric Cards and Overview Section (TASK-27-15)

### Feature Description
Admin dashboard overview page with key metric cards and summary visualizations. Displays real-time statistics for users, requests, revenue, and system health with trend indicators and auto-refresh capabilities. Part of the Admin Dashboard feature (FEAT-027).

### Component Location
- **Page:** `frontend/app/admin/overview/page.tsx`
- **Components:**
  - `frontend/components/admin/MetricCard.tsx` - Individual metric card with formatting
  - `frontend/components/admin/MetricGrid.tsx` - Responsive grid layout with auto-refresh
  - `frontend/components/admin/TrendIndicator.tsx` - Trend direction display
  - `frontend/components/admin/HealthBadge.tsx` - System health status badge
- **API/Types:**
  - `frontend/lib/types/admin-stats.ts` - TypeScript interfaces

### Metric Cards

| Metric | Description | Format | Trend |
|--------|-------------|--------|-------|
| Total Users | Total registered users | Number (K/M suffix) | vs previous period |
| Active Users Today | Users active in last 24h | Number | vs yesterday |
| Total Requests (24h) | API requests in 24 hours | Number (K/M suffix) | vs previous 24h |
| Revenue This Month | Monthly revenue | Currency ($X,XXX) | vs last month |
| System Health | Overall system status | Badge (healthy/degraded/unhealthy) | N/A |

### Component Props

**MetricCard:**
```typescript
interface MetricCardProps {
  title: string;           // Card title (e.g., "Total Users")
  value: number | string;  // Current value
  format?: 'number' | 'currency' | 'percent';  // Display format
  trend?: TrendData;       // Trend comparison data
  icon?: React.ReactNode;  // Optional icon
  href?: string;           // Click navigation target
  isLoading?: boolean;     // Loading state
  error?: string;          // Error message
}
```

**MetricGrid:**
```typescript
interface MetricGridProps {
  refreshInterval?: number;  // Auto-refresh interval in ms (default: 30000)
  onRefresh?: () => void;    // Manual refresh callback
}
```

**TrendIndicator:**
```typescript
interface TrendIndicatorProps {
  value: number;        // Percentage change
  direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral';
  showValue?: boolean;  // Show percentage text
}
```

**HealthBadge:**
```typescript
interface HealthBadgeProps {
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  label?: string;       // Custom label override
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  showPulse?: boolean;  // Pulse animation for degraded
}
```

## ARIA Labels and Keyboard Navigation (TASK-28-16)

### Feature Description
Comprehensive accessibility implementation for all interactive components in the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature. Implements WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with proper ARIA labels, focus management, and keyboard navigation support.

### Component Location
- **SkipLink:** rontend/components/layout/SkipLink.tsx
- **IndicatorCard:** rontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCard.tsx
- **IndicatorGrid:** rontend/components/indicators/IndicatorGrid.tsx
- **IndicatorCatalog:** rontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCatalog.tsx
- **Header:** rontend/components/layout/Header.tsx
- **MobileNav:** rontend/components/layout/MobileNav.tsx

### Core Accessibility Features

| Feature | Implementation | WCAG Criterion |
|---------|---------------|----------------|
| Skip Link | SkipLink.tsx - links to #main-content | 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks |
| Focus Indicators | ocus-visible:ring-2 classes | 2.4.7 Focus Visible |
| ARIA Labels | All interactive elements have descriptive labels | 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value |
| Keyboard Navigation | Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow keys | 2.1.1 Keyboard |
| Touch Targets | Minimum 44x44px for mobile | 2.5.5 Target Size |

### SkipLink Component

`	ypescript
// SkipLink.tsx - Skip to main content link
<a
  class="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:absolute focus:top-4 focus:left-4 focus:z-50..."
  data-testid="skip-link"
  aria-label="Skip to main content"
  href="#main-content"
>
  Skip to main content
</a>
`

**Behavior:**
- Hidden by default (sr-only)
- Becomes visible on focus (ocus:not-sr-only)
- Links to <main id="main-content">
- Auto-focuses main content on activation

### Main Content Wrapper

`html
<main
  id="main-content"
  tabindex="-1"
  class="outline-none"
  data-testid="main-content"
  role="main"
  aria-label="Main content"
>
  <!-- Page content -->
</main>
`

### Indicator Card Accessibility

**ARIA Label Format:**
`
"{title}: {value}. {description}. Status: {status}"
`

**Example Labels:**
| Card | aria-label |
|------|------------|
| Keyword Rankings | "Keyword Rankings: 42. Track SERP positions. Status: Good" |
| Visibility Score | "Visibility Score: 78%. Overall SEO visibility. Status: Warning" |
| Technical Health | "Technical Health: 95. Site audit score. Status: Good" |

**Implementation:**
`	ypescript
<a
  role="link"
  tabIndex={0}
  aria-label={${title}: . . Status: }
  className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary"
>
  {/* Card content */}
</a>
`

### Category Tabs Keyboard Navigation

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Tab | Move focus to tab list |
| Arrow Left/Right | Navigate between tabs |
| Home | Move to first tab |
| End | Move to last tab |
| Enter/Space | Activate selected tab |

**ARIA Implementation:**
`html
<div role="tablist" aria-orientation="horizontal" aria-label="Filter by category">
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="content-All">All</button>
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="content-Rankings">Rankings</button>
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="content-Traffic">Traffic</button>
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="content-Technical">Technical</button>
</div>
`

### Status Badge Accessibility

| Status | aria-label | Icon |
|--------|------------|------|
| Good | "Status: Good" | ✓ CircleCheckBig |
| Warning | "Status: Warning" | ⚠ TriangleAlert |
| Critical | "Status: Critical" | ✕ CircleX |
| Neutral | "Status: Neutral" | - Minus |

**Implementation:**
`html
<span role="status" aria-label="Status: Good">
  <svg aria-hidden="true"><!-- Icon --></svg>
  Good
</span>
`

### Focus Management

| SkipLink | Focus moves to main content on activation |
| IndicatorCard | Focus visible ring on keyboard focus |
| MobileNav | Focus trap in sheet, returns to hamburger on close |

| Modal/Sheet | Focus trap, Escape to close |

| <nav> |
avigation | "Main navigation" |

egion | Section-specific label |

## Skeleton Loader Variants (TASK-28-9)

### Component Description
Specialized skeleton loader components for different content types: cards, tables, charts, and the indicator catalog. Provides visual placeholders during data loading with pulse animations for improved perceived performance. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **CardSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/CardSkeleton.tsx`
- **TableSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/TableSkeleton.tsx`
- **ChartSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/ChartSkeleton.tsx`
- **IndicatorCatalogSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/IndicatorCatalogSkeleton.tsx`
- **Barrel Export:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/ui/skeletons/SkeletonLoaders.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-28-9.md`

### Core Functionalities

**Skeleton Components:**
| Component | Purpose | Key Props |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| `CardSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for indicator cards | `showIcon`, `lines`, `className` |
| `TableSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for data tables | `rows`, `columns`, `showHeader`, `className` |
| `ChartSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for charts | `type` ('line' | 'bar' | 'pie'), `className` |
| `IndicatorCatalogSkeleton` | Full catalog loading state | `count`, `columns`, `className` |

### CardSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface CardSkeletonProps {
  showIcon?: boolean;    // Default: true
  lines?: number;        // Default: 3
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Configurable icon placeholder (default: visible)
- Variable line count (default: 3)
- Varying line widths for visual interest (75%, 100%, 50%)
- Dark mode support with `dark:` classes
- Accessibility: `aria-busy="true"`, `aria-label="Loading content"`

### TableSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface TableSkeletonProps {
  rows?: number;         // Default: 5
  columns?: number;      // Default: 4
  showHeader?: boolean;  // Default: true
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Semantic HTML structure (`<table>`, `<thead>`, `<tbody>`)
- Configurable row/column counts
- Toggle header row visibility
- Hover effects and striped rows styling
- Responsive column handling

### ChartSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface ChartSkeletonProps {
  type?: 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';  // Default: 'line'
  className?: string;
}
``

**Chart Type Visualizations:**
| Type | Visual Placeholder |
|------|-------------------|
| `line` | SVG path with data points, axis placeholders, grid lines |
| `bar` | Vertical bars with varying heights, axis placeholders |
| `pie` | Circular segments with legend placeholders |

**Features:**
- Unique visual for each chart type
- Axis and grid line placeholders for data charts
- Legend area for pie charts
- Dark mode compatible

### IndicatorCatalogSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface ResponsiveColumns {
  default?: number;  // Default: 1
  sm?: number;       // Small screens
  md?: number;       // Medium screens
  lg?: number;       // Large screens
  xl?: number;       // Extra large screens
  '2xl'?: number;    // 2X large screens
}

interface IndicatorCatalogSkeletonProps {
  count?: number;           // Number of card skeletons, default: 6
  columns?: ResponsiveColumns;
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Configurable count of card skeletons
- Responsive grid layout with breakpoint support
- Header and search/filter skeleton areas
- Uses CardSkeleton components internally
- Responsive columns: default(1), sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl breakpoints

### Pulse Animation

All skeleton components use the `animate-pulse` Tailwind CSS class for consistent loading animation:

``css
.animate-pulse {
  animation: pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}
``

### Accessibility Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| ARIA Busy State | `aria-busy="true"` on all skeleton containers |
| ARIA Labels | `aria-label="Loading..."` for screen readers |
| Semantic Structure | Proper HTML elements (table, thead, tbody) |
| Reduced Motion | Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` media query |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| No User Input | Components render static placeholder content only |
| XSS Prevention | No dynamic content rendering |
| No Sensitive Data | No data exposure risk |

### Test Coverage

## Loading State Integration (TASK-28-11)

### Component Description
Comprehensive loading state system integrating skeleton loaders, progress indicators, and optimistic update patterns throughout the application. Provides unified loading UX with error boundaries, empty states, and retry functionality. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Locations
- **useLoadingState Hook:** `frontend/lib/hooks/useLoadingState.ts`
- **useOptimisticUpdate Hook:** `frontend/lib/hooks/useOptimisticUpdate.ts`
- **Hooks Index:** `frontend/lib/hooks/index.ts`
- **LoadingContext:** `frontend/lib/contexts/LoadingContext.tsx`
- **ErrorBoundary:** `frontend/components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx`
- **EmptyState:** `frontend/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx`
- **LoadingWrapper:** `frontend/components/ui/LoadingWrapper.tsx`
- **ButtonLoading:** `frontend/components/ui/ButtonLoading.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/integration/loading-state-integration.test.tsx` (54 tests)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/integration/loading-state-actual-components.test.tsx` (44 tests)
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-28-11.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `useLoadingState` | Hook for managing loading state with retry logic |
| `useOptimisticUpdate` | Hook for optimistic updates with rollback |
| `LoadingContext` | Context provider for global loading state |
| `ErrorBoundary` | Error catching with retry functionality |
| `EmptyState` | Helpful messaging when no data available |
| `LoadingWrapper` | Unified loading/error/empty state wrapper |
| `ButtonLoading` | Button with CircularProgress integration |

### useLoadingState Hook

**Interface:**
```typescript
interface UseLoadingStateOptions {
  initialLoading?: boolean;
  maxRetries?: number;
}

interface UseLoadingStateReturn {
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  retryCount: number;
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setError: (error: Error | null) => void;
  retry: () => void;
  reset: () => void;
}
```

**Features:**
- Configurable initial loading state
- Maximum retry count tracking
- Error state management
- Reset functionality for clean state

### useOptimisticUpdate Hook

**Interface:**
```typescript
interface UseOptimisticUpdateOptions<T> {
  data: T;
  onUpdate: (newData: T) => Promise<void>;
}

interface UseOptimisticUpdateReturn<T> {
  optimisticData: T;
  isPending: boolean;
  update: (newData: T) => Promise<void>;
  rollback: () => void;
}
```

**Features:**
- Shows expected result before API response
- Automatic rollback on API failure
- Confirms state on API success
- Tracks pending state during operation

### ErrorBoundary Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  maxRetries?: number;
}
```

**Features:**
- Class component for error catching (React requirement)
- Retry functionality with count tracking
- Custom fallback support
- ARIA-compliant error display

**Error Display:**
- Clear error message with icon
- Retry button with attempt count
- Graceful degradation UI

### EmptyState Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface EmptyStateProps {
  type?: 'keywords' | 'competitors' | 'reports' | 'analyses' | 'projects' | 'default';
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  ctaText?: string;
  onCtaClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Pre-defined Types:**
| Type | Title | Description | CTA |
|------|-------|-------------|-----|
| `keywords` | No keywords yet | Start tracking your first keyword | Add Keyword |
| `competitors` | No competitors configured | Add competitors to track | Add Competitor |
| `reports` | No reports generated | Create your first report | Create Report |
| `analyses` | No analyses yet | Run your first SEO analysis | Start Analysis |
| `projects` | No projects created | Create your first project | Create Project |
| `default` | No data available | Get started by adding items | Get Started |

### LoadingWrapper Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface LoadingWrapperProps {
  isLoading: boolean;
  error?: Error | null;
  isEmpty?: boolean;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  skeleton?: React.ReactNode;
  emptyState?: EmptyStateProps;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  showLinearProgress?: boolean;
  progress?: number;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Features:**
- Unified loading state wrapper
- Shows skeleton during loading
- Shows error with retry option
- Shows empty state when no data
- Optional LinearProgress integration
- Determinate progress support (0-100)

### ButtonLoading Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface ButtonLoadingProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  loadingText?: string;
  progress?: number;
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'link';
  size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon';
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Features:**
- CircularProgress integration for buttons
- Loading text support (replaces children during loading)
- Determinate progress support (0-100)
- Multiple variants and sizes
- Automatic disable during loading

### Loading UX Patterns

| Pattern | Implementation | Use Case |
|---------|---------------|----------|
| **Optimistic Updates** | useOptimisticUpdate hook | Keyword status changes, project updates |

## Indicator Catalog Component (TASK-28-10)

### Component Description
Interactive grid component displaying all 17 SEO indicators on the homepage. Provides visual representation of indicator status, scores, and quick access to detailed analysis. Features responsive layout, category filtering, and real-time score updates. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCatalog.tsx`
- **Card Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCard.tsx`
- **Grid Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorGrid.tsx`
- **Types:** `frontend/lib/types/indicator.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/indicators/IndicatorCatalog.test.tsx`
- **Skeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/IndicatorCatalogSkeleton.tsx`

### Component Props

```typescript
interface IndicatorCatalogProps {
  indicators?: Indicator[];           // Pre-loaded indicator data
  showFilters?: boolean;              // Show category filter tabs (default: true)
  showSearch?: boolean;               // Show search input (default: true)
  columns?: ResponsiveColumns;        // Responsive column configuration
  className?: string;
}

interface ResponsiveColumns {
  default?: number;  // Default: 1
  sm?: number;       // 640px breakpoint
  md?: number;       // 768px breakpoint
  lg?: number;       // 1024px breakpoint
  xl?: number;       // 1280px breakpoint
  '2xl'?: number;    // 1536px breakpoint
}
```

### Indicator Data Structure

```typescript
interface Indicator {
  id: string;                        // Unique identifier (e.g., 'keyword-rankings')
  slug: string;                      // URL-friendly identifier
  title: string;                     // Display title
  description: string;               // Short description
  category: IndicatorCategory;       // Category classification
  icon: string;                      // Icon name from lucide-react
  score?: number;                    // Current score (0-100)
  maxScore: number;                  // Maximum possible score (100)
  status: IndicatorStatus;           // good | warning | critical | neutral
  lastAnalyzed?: string;             // ISO timestamp
  trend?: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral'; // Score trend direction
  trendValue?: number;               // Percentage change
}

type IndicatorCategory = 'Rankings' | 'Traffic' | 'Technical' | 'Content' | 'Backlinks';
type IndicatorStatus = 'good' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'neutral';
```

### Category Filter Tabs

| Category | Indicators | Description |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| All | All 17 | Default view showing all indicators |
| Rankings | 4 | Keyword Rankings, SERP Features, Visibility Score, Competitor Rankings |
| Traffic | 3 | Organic Traffic, Click-Through Rate, Bounce Rate |
| Technical | 5 | Page Speed, Mobile Friendly, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals, Crawlability |
| Content | 3 | Meta Tags, Headings, Image Alt Text |
| Backlinks | 2 | Backlink Count, Domain Authority |

### Responsive Grid Layout

| Viewport | Default Columns | Example Configuration |
|----------|-----------------|----------------------|
| Mobile (< 640px) | 1 column | `{ default: 1 }` |
| Small (640px+) | 2 columns | `{ sm: 2 }` |
| Medium (768px+) | 3 columns | `{ md: 3 }` |
| Large (1024px+) | 4 columns | `{ lg: 4 }` |
| XL (1280px+) | 4 columns | `{ xl: 4 }` |
| 2XL (1536px+) | 4 columns | `{ '2xl': 4 }` |

### Card Visual Elements

**IndicatorCard Components:**
| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Icon | Category-specific icon from lucide-react |
| Title | Indicator name |
| Score | Percentage score with progress bar |
| Status Badge | Color-coded status indicator |
| Description | Short indicator description |
| Trend Arrow | Up/down/neutral trend indicator |
| Last Analyzed | Relative time since last analysis |

**Status Badge Colors:**
| Status | Background | Text | Icon |
|--------|------------|------|------|
| Good | `bg-green-100` | `text-green-800` | ✓ CircleCheckBig |
| Warning | `bg-yellow-100` | `text-yellow-800` | ⚠ TriangleAlert |
| Critical | `bg-red-100` | `text-red-800` | ✕ CircleX |
| Neutral | `bg-gray-100` | `text-gray-800` | - Minus |

### Loading States

| State | Display |
|-------|---------|
| Initial Load | IndicatorCatalogSkeleton with configurable card count |
| Refresh | Pulse animation on cards being updated |
| Error | Error boundary with retry button |
| Empty | EmptyState component with "No indicators" message |

### Accessibility Implementation

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| ARIA Labels | Comprehensive labels on all interactive elements |
| Keyboard Navigation | Tab through cards, Enter to activate |
| Screen Reader | Status and score announced |
| Focus Indicators | Visible focus ring on cards |
| Skip Link | Skip to main content link |

**ARIA Label Format:**
```
"{title}: {score}%. {description}. Status: {status}"
```

### Performance Optimizations

| Lazy Loading | Cards rendered on scroll intersection |
| Memoization | React.memo on IndicatorCard |
| Virtualization | Considered for 50+ indicators |
| Image Optimization | Icons loaded from lucide-react (SVG) |

## Design System Reference (TASK-28-19)

### Description
Comprehensive design system documentation including color tokens, typography, spacing, component patterns, and accessibility guidelines. Provides single source of truth for all UI/UX decisions and ensures consistency across the application.

### Documentation Location
- **Design System Doc:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`
- **CSS Variables:** `frontend/app/globals.css`
- **Tailwind Config:** `tailwind.config.ts`

### Design Tokens Overview

**Color System:**
| Category | Variables | Count |
|----------|-----------|-------|
| Brand Colors | `--brand-primary`, `--brand-secondary`, `--brand-accent` | 3 |
| Semantic Colors | `--success`, `--warning`, `--error`, `--info` | 4 |
| Surface Layers | `--surface-0` through `--surface-3` | 4 |
| Base Colors | `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--border` | 12 |

**Typography:**
| Category | Tokens | Count |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Font Families | `--font-geist-sans`, `--font-geist-mono` | 2 |
| Font Sizes | `text-xs` through `text-5xl` | 8 |
| Font Weights | `font-normal` through `font-bold` | 4 |

**Spacing:**
| Category | Tokens | Base Unit |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Spacing Scale | `p-1` through `p-16` | 4px |
| Gap Scale | `gap-1` through `gap-16` | 4px |

### Component Patterns

**Button Variants:**
| Variant | Usage | Classes |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Primary | Main CTAs | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` |
| Secondary | Secondary actions | `bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground` |
| Destructive | Delete, remove | `bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground` |
| Outline | Tertiary actions | `border border-input bg-background` |
| Ghost | Minimal actions | `hover:bg-accent` |
| Link | Text links | `text-primary underline-offset-4` |

**Status Indicators:**
| Status | Color | Usage |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Good | `--success` | Positive states, scores ≥80% |
| Warning | `--warning` | Caution states, scores 50-79% |
| Critical | `--error` | Error states, scores <50% |
| Neutral | `--muted-foreground` | No data, pending |

### Tailwind Integration

Colors are integrated via the `@theme` directive:

```css
@theme inline {
  --color-brand-primary: var(--brand-primary);
  --color-success: var(--success);
  --color-surface-0: var(--surface-0);
  /* ... etc */
}
```

**Usage in Components:**
```tsx
<button className="bg-brand-primary text-white">
  Primary Button
</button>

<div className="bg-surface-2 border-border rounded-lg">
  Card content
</div>
```

### Dark Mode

All color variables have dark mode counterparts applied via the `.dark` class:

```css
:root {
  --background: oklch(1 0 0);  /* Light mode */
}

.dark {
  --background: oklch(0.145 0 0);  /* Dark mode */
}
```

### Accessibility Guidelines

| Guideline | Implementation |
|-----------|---------------|
| Color Contrast | WCAG 2.1 AA minimum (4.5:1 for text) |
| Focus Indicators | 2px ring with offset |
| ARIA Labels | Required for all interactive elements |
| Keyboard Navigation | Tab, Enter, Space, Escape support |
| Reduced Motion | Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` |

- `DOCUMENTATION.md` - Feature and component documentation
- `frontend/components/README.md` - Component usage guide

```typescript
}
```

## Project CRUD API Endpoints (TASK-34-6)

### Service Description
RESTful API endpoints for managing AI Visibility Tracking projects. Provides full CRUD operations for creating, reading, updating, and deleting projects with proper authorization, validation, and error handling. Part of the AI Visibility Tracking feature (FEAT-034).

### Controller Location
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/ProjectController.php`
- **Routes:** `backend/routes/api.php`
- **Request Classes:**
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/StoreProjectRequest.php`
  - `backend/app/Http/Requests/UpdateProjectRequest.php`
- **Resource:** `backend/app/Http/Resources/ProjectResource.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Controllers/ProjectControllerTest.php`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth |
|--------|----------|-------------|------|
| GET | `/api/v1/projects` | List all user's projects | Required |
| POST | `/api/v1/projects` | Create a new project | Required |
| GET | `/api/v1/projects/{id}` | Get a specific project | Required |
| PUT/PATCH | `/api/v1/projects/{id}` | Update a project | Required |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/projects/{id}` | Delete a project | Required |

### List Projects
`GET /api/v1/projects`

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `page` | int | 1 | Page number for pagination |
| `per_page` | int | 15 | Items per page (max: 100) |
| `search` | string | - | Search by name or domain |
| `status` | string | - | Filter by status (active, paused, archived) |
| `sort_by` | string | created_at | Sort field (name, created_at, updated_at) |
| `sort_order` | string | desc | Sort direction (asc, desc) |

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "My Website",
      "domain": "example.com",
      "status": "active",
      "visibility_score": 78.5,
      "keywords_tracked": 42,
      "last_analyzed_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z",
      "created_at": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 15,
    "total": 5,
    "last_page": 1
  }
}
```

### Create Project
`POST /api/v1/projects`

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "My Website",
  "domain": "example.com",
  "description": "Main company website",
  "status": "active",
  "settings": {
    "track_competitors": true,
    "notification_enabled": true,
    "analysis_frequency": "daily"
  }
}
```

**Validation Rules:**
| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `name` | Required, string, max:255 |
| `domain` | Required, string, max:255, valid domain format, unique per user |
| `description` | Nullable, string, max:1000 |
| `status` | Nullable, enum: active, paused, archived (default: active) |
| `settings` | Nullable, array |
| `settings.track_competitors` | Nullable, boolean |
| `settings.notification_enabled` | Nullable, boolean |
| `settings.analysis_frequency` | Nullable, enum: hourly, daily, weekly |

**Response (201):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "My Website",
    "domain": "example.com",
    "description": "Main company website",
    "status": "active",
    "settings": {
      "track_competitors": true,
      "notification_enabled": true,
      "analysis_frequency": "daily"
    },
    "visibility_score": null,
    "keywords_tracked": 0,
    "last_analyzed_at": null,
    "created_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Get Project
`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}`

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "My Website",
    "domain": "example.com",
    "description": "Main company website",
    "status": "active",
    "settings": {
      "track_competitors": true,
      "notification_enabled": true,
      "analysis_frequency": "daily"
    },
    "visibility_score": 78.5,
    "keywords_tracked": 42,
    "last_analyzed_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z",
    "created_at": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-03-08T10:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Update Project
`PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}`

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Updated Name",
  "status": "paused"
}
```

**Validation Rules:** Same as create, but all fields are optional.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Updated Name",
    "status": "paused",
    ...
  }
}
```

### Delete Project
`DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}`

**Response (204):** No content

### Authorization

All endpoints require authentication via Laravel Sanctum. Users can only access their own projects.

**Authorization Logic:**
```php
// User can only access their own projects
if ($project->user_id !== auth()->id()) {
    abort(403, 'Unauthorized');
}
```

### Error Responses

| Code | Condition |
|------|-----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated |
| 403 | Unauthorized (not project owner) |
| 404 | Project not found |
| 422 | Validation error |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |

**Error Response Format:**
```json
{
  "message": "The given data was invalid.",
  "errors": {
    "domain": ["The domain has already been taken."]
  }
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum token auth |
| Authorization | User-scoped queries, ownership check |
| Input Validation | FormRequest classes with rules |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| XSS Prevention | Input sanitization, output escaping |
| Rate Limiting | 60 requests per minute per user |

## How It Works Page (TASK-30-3)

### Description
Static educational page at `/how-it-works` explaining the SEOIndicator analysis methodology, including step-by-step user journey, 17 SEO indicator breakdown with weight distribution, scoring methodology, and FAQ section. SEO-optimized with WebPage + FAQPage schema markup, accessibility features, and interactive accordion component. Part of the Legal + About + How It Works + Cookie Consent feature (FEAT-030).

- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-30-3.md`

### Core Functionalities

**Page Component (`app/how-it-works/page.tsx`):**
| Feature | Description |

| WebPage + FAQPage Schema | JSON-LD structured data for search engines |
| Breadcrumb Navigation | Home > How It Works with aria-current |
| Responsive Layout | max-w-5xl container with padding |

### User Journey Steps

| Step | Icon | Title | Description |
|------|------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | Search | Enter Your URL | Enter the URL of any website you want to analyze |
| 2 | Settings | Configure Analysis | Select specific indicators or run a comprehensive scan |
| 3 | BarChart3 | Get Results | Receive a detailed SEO score with breakdown by category |
| 4 | Lightbulb | Implement Fixes | Follow actionable suggestions to improve your score |
| 5 | RefreshCw | Track Progress | Monitor improvements over time with historical tracking |

### Indicator Categories & Weights

| Category | Weight | Indicators | Color |
|----------|--------|------------|-------|
| **Technical** | 30% | robots.txt, sitemap, SSL, mobile-friendly, canonical, hreflang | Blue |
| **Content** | 40% | title tag, meta description, H1, keyword density, images | Green |
| **Performance** | 20% | page speed, Core Web Vitals | Orange |
| **UX** | 10% | mobile viewport, font readability | Purple |

**Weight Distribution:** Total = 100%

### Scoring Methodology

| Score Range | Status | Color |
|-------------|--------|-------|
| 0-39 | Poor | Red |
| 40-69 | Needs Improvement | Yellow |
| 70-89 | Good | Blue |
| 90-100 | Excellent | Green |

**Scoring Formula:**
```
Final Score = Σ (Indicator Score × Weight) for all 17 indicators
```

## PWA Recommendations Component (TASK-24-12)

### Component Description
React component that displays actionable PWA improvement suggestions from the PWASuggestionService. Provides a user-friendly interface for understanding and addressing PWA deficiencies with priority badges, expandable sections, and links to relevant guide sections. Part of the PWA / Web App Manifest Indicator feature (FEAT-024).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/pwa/PWARecommendations.tsx`
- **Skeleton:** `frontend/components/pwa/PWARecommendationsSkeleton.tsx`
- **Types:** `frontend/lib/types/pwa.ts`
- **Styles:** `frontend/app/globals.css` (custom animations)
- **Tests:** `frontend/components/pwa/__tests__/PWARecommendations.test.tsx`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Priority Badges | Color-coded badges (high=red, medium=yellow, low=emerald) |
| Sorted Display | Recommendations sorted by priority (high → medium → low) |
| Expandable Sections | Collapsible sections when > 3 items per priority |
| Empty State | Success message with checkmark when no suggestions |
| Guide Links | External link icon for recommendations with guide anchors |
| View Guide Button | Links to `/guides/pwa` for full PWA guide |
| maxVisible Prop | Truncation with "show more" button |

### Component API

``typescript
interface PWARecommendation {
  type: string;
  field?: string;
  message: string;

}

## Comparison Types and Interfaces (TASK-32-1)

### Description
TypeScript interfaces and type guards for the competitor comparison system. Foundation module that defines all data structures used in programmatic SEO comparison landing pages targeting keywords like "SEOIndicator vs [competitor]". Part of the Competitor Comparison Landing Pages feature (FEAT-032).

### Component Location
- **Types File:** `frontend/lib/compare/types.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/lib/compare/types.test.ts`

### Core Interfaces

| Interface | Purpose | Required Properties |
|-----------|---------|-------------------|
| `CompetitorData` | Complete competitor data structure | id, name, slug, website, tagline, pricing, features, pros, cons, useCases, lastUpdated, source |
| `PricingTier` | Pricing tier with monthly/annual options | name, monthlyPrice, annualPrice, features |
| `FeatureCategory` | Feature grouping for comparison tables | name, features[] |
| `Feature` | Individual feature comparison | name, seoindicator, competitor |
| `UseCase` | Target audience use case | title, description, audience, budget |
| `ComparisonData` | Full comparison page data | slug, title, metaDescription, competitors, summary, featureComparison, pricingComparison, prosCons, useCases, verdict, faqs, relatedComparisons |
| `FAQ` | Frequently asked question | question, answer |

### Component Props Interfaces

|-----------|---------|-------|
| `ComparisonTableProps` | Feature comparison table | features, highlightWinner?, showTooltips? |

### PricingTier Interface Details

```typescript
interface PricingTier {
  name: string;                      // 'Lite', 'Pro', 'Enterprise'
  monthlyPrice: number | 'Free';     // Monthly cost or 'Free'
  annualPrice: number | 'Free';      // Annual cost or 'Free'
  features: string[];                // Features included in tier
  highlighted?: boolean;             // UI highlight flag
}
```

### Feature Interface Details

```typescript
interface Feature {
  name: string;                      // Feature name
  seoindicator: boolean | string;    // true, false, 'Yes', 'Partial', 'N/A'
  competitor: boolean | string;      // Competitor's support level
  tooltip?: string;                  // Optional explanation
}
```

### ComparisonData Interface Details

```typescript
interface ComparisonData {
  slug: string;                      // 'seoindicator-vs-ahrefs'
  title: string;                     // Page title for SEO
  metaDescription: string;           // SEO meta description
  competitors: [string, string];     // Exactly 2 competitor IDs
  summary: string;                   // Executive summary
  featureComparison: FeatureCategory[];
  pricingComparison: {
    seoindicator: PricingTier[];
    competitor: PricingTier[];
  };
  prosCons: {
    seoindicator: { pros: string[]; cons: string[] };
    competitor: { pros: string[]; cons: string[] };
  };
  useCases: {
    seoindicator: UseCase[];
    competitor: UseCase[];
  };
  verdict: string;                   // Honest recommendation
  faqs: FAQ[];
  relatedComparisons: string[];      // Slugs of related pages
}
```

### Type Guard Implementation Pattern

```typescript
export function isPricingTier(value: unknown): value is PricingTier {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;

  const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof obj.name !== 'string') return false;

  const monthlyPrice = obj.monthlyPrice;
  if (typeof monthlyPrice !== 'number' && monthlyPrice !== 'Free') return false;

  // ... additional validation

  return true;
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| No `any` Types | All interfaces use strict typing |
| Runtime Validation | Type guards validate unknown data |
| Input Sanitization | Type guards reject invalid types |
| Constants | readonly tuples prevent mutation |

## OG Image Generation for Comparisons (TASK-32-17)

### Feature Description
Dynamic Open Graph image generation for comparison pages to improve social sharing appearance. Pre-generates static OG images at build time for all 13 comparison slugs, ensuring compatibility with Next.js static export (`output: 'export'`).

### Component Locations
- **OG Images:** `frontend/public/og/compare/{slug}.png` (13 images)
- **Generation Script:** `frontend/scripts/generate-og-images.mjs`
- **OG Utility:** `frontend/lib/compare/og-images.ts`
- **API Route (fallback):** `frontend/app/api/og/route.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/api/og/route.test.tsx`

### Implementation Strategy

The implementation uses **pre-generated static images** rather than runtime generation due to Next.js static export constraints. The `ImageResponse` class from `next/og` requires server-side rendering and is incompatible with `output: 'export'`.

| Approach | Status | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Pre-generated static images | ✅ Implemented | Build-time generation |
| Dynamic API route | ❌ Not used | Incompatible with static export |

### Build Script

**Command:** `npm run build:og` (integrated into `npm run build`)

**Technology Stack:**
| Library | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `satori` | JSX to SVG conversion |
| `@resvg/resvg-js` | SVG to PNG rendering |

**Generation Process:**
1. Read all comparison slugs from registry (`COMPARISON_SLUGS`)
2. Generate JSX template with competitor names
3. Convert JSX to SVG using satori
4. Render SVG to PNG using resvg-js
5. Save to `/public/og/compare/{slug}.png`

### OG Metadata Integration

Comparison pages include OG image metadata via `getComparisonOGMetadata()`:

```typescript
// In comparison page metadata
export async function generateMetadata({ params }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const comparison = getComparisonBySlug(params.slug);
  const ogImageUrl = `https://seoindicator.com/og/compare/${params.slug}.png`;

  return {
    openGraph: {
      images: [{ url: ogImageUrl, width: 1200, height: 630 }],
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      images: [ogImageUrl],
    },
  };
}
```

| `getComparisonOGImage(slug)` | Returns OG image URL for a comparison slug |
| `getAllOGImages()` | Returns all OG image URLs for sitemap |

### Security Implementation

| HTML Tag Stripping | Removes `<script>`, `<img>`, and other tags |
| JavaScript Removal | Strips `javascript:` and `on*=` handlers |
| Name Truncation | Limits competitor names to 50 characters |
| URL Encoding | Safe handling of encoded parameters |
| Unicode Support | Handles emoji and special characters |

| Billing Toggle | Switch between monthly and annual pricing |
| Feature Breakdown | Show features included in each tier |
| Annual Savings | Calculate and display savings percentage for annual plans |
| Mobile Responsive | Grid stacks to single column on mobile devices |
| Highlighted Tier | "Popular" badge with emerald accent styling |

### Sub-components

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `BillingToggle` | Monthly/Annual switch with accessible aria-pressed states |
| `PriceDisplay` | Formatted price with decimal rounding (2 places) |
| `FeatureList` | Feature list with check icons |
| `PricingCard` | Individual tier card with features and pricing |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface PricingComparisonProps {
  seoindicator: PricingTier[];      // SEOIndicator pricing tiers
  competitor: PricingTier[];        // Competitor pricing tiers
  showFreeTier?: boolean;           // Show free tier highlight (default: true)
}

interface PricingTier {
  name: string;                     // Tier name (Free, Pro, Enterprise)
  monthlyPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';  // Monthly price
  annualPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';   // Annual price (per month)
  features: string[];               // Features included in tier
  highlighted?: boolean;            // Highlight as "Popular" tier
}
```

### Price Formatting

| Price Type | Display Format |
|------------|----------------|
| `Free` | "Free Forever" badge |
| `Custom` | "Custom" text (no savings badge) |
| Integer (e.g., 29) | "$29" |
| Decimal (e.g., 19.99) | "$19.99" |

### Annual Savings Calculation

```typescript
// Formula: ((monthly * 12 - annual * 12) / (monthly * 12)) * 100
const savingsPercent = ((monthlyPrice * 12 - annualPrice * 12) / (monthlyPrice * 12)) * 100;
```

### Styling

- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling
- Mobile: `grid-cols-1` (stacked layout)
- Desktop: `grid-cols-2` (side-by-side)
- Highlighted tier: "Popular" badge with emerald accent
- Free tier: "Free Forever" badge with distinct styling
- Savings badge: Shows percentage saved with annual billing

## Audit Visibility Columns (TASK-33-1)

### Service Description
Database migration adding visibility control columns to the audits table. Enables public sharing of audit reports via unique URLs while maintaining privacy by default. Foundation for the Public Audit Sharing feature (FEAT-033).

### Database Schema Addition

**Migration:** `2026_03_05_201400_add_visibility_columns_to_audits_table.php`

**New Columns:**

| Column | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `visibility` | ENUM('private', 'public') | 'private' | Controls audit visibility |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | NULL | Unique hash for public URL (nullable) |
| `public_hash_created_at` | TIMESTAMP | NULL | When the public link was created |

**Full Audit Schema (with new columns):**
```sql
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN visibility ENUM('private', 'public') DEFAULT 'private';
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN public_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL;
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN public_hash_created_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- Index for fast public lookups
CREATE INDEX idx_audits_public_hash ON audits(public_hash);

-- Index for visibility filtering
CREATE INDEX idx_audits_visibility ON audits(visibility);
```

### Column Details

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `visibility` | ENUM | `private` (default) = only owner can view, `public` = accessible via public URL |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | SHA-256 hash for unique public URL, generated when audit is made public |
| `public_hash_created_at` | TIMESTAMP | Audit trail for when public link was created |

### Public URL Pattern

When an audit is made public, the accessible URL pattern is:
````
/public-audit/{public_hash}
````
Example:
````
/public-audit/a1b2c3d4e5f6...
````

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Privacy by Default | `visibility` defaults to `'private'` |
| Unique Hash | 64-character cryptographic hash (SHA-256) |
| No Enumeration | Hash is not guessable, prevents enumeration attacks |
| Audit Trail | `public_hash_created_at` tracks when link was created |
| Index Optimization | Indexed for O(1) lookup performance |

### Model Changes

**Audit Model Updates:**
```php
protected `` = [
    // ... existing fields
    'visibility',
    'public_hash',
    'public_hash_created_at',
];

protected `` = [
    'visibility' => 'string',
    'public_hash_created_at' => 'datetime',
];

// Scopes
public function scopePublic(``) {
    return ``->where('visibility', 'public');
}

public function scopePrivate(``) {
    return ``->where('visibility', 'private');
}

// Helper Methods
public function isPublic(): bool {
    return ``->visibility === 'public';
}

public function getPublicUrl(): ?string {
    return ``->public_hash
        ? url("/public-audit/{``->public_hash}")
        : null;
}
```

## TopIssues Component (TASK-33-11)

### Component Description
React component that displays a prioritized list of SEO issues found during the audit, with severity indicators and "View full report" prompt for anonymous users. Shows top 5 issues for anonymous users (isPartial=true) and the full issue list for logged-in owners (isPartial=false). Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/audit/TopIssues.tsx`
- **Exports:** `frontend/components/audit/index.ts` (TopIssues, TopIssuesProps, Issue)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/audit/TopIssues.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-11.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Limited View | Top 5 issues for anonymous users (isPartial=true) |
| Full View | All issues for logged-in owners (isPartial=false) |
| Severity Indicators | Critical (red), Warning (yellow), Info (blue) icons |
| Category Badges | Technical, On-Page, Content, Mobile category labels |
| Issue Expansion | Click to expand/collapse issue details |
| View Full Report | CTA prompt with remaining count for anonymous users |
| Empty State | Checkmark icon when no issues found |
| Accessibility | Full ARIA support with keyboard navigation |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface TopIssuesProps {
  issues: Issue[];          // Array of SEO issues to display
  isPartial: boolean;       // true = show only 5 issues (anonymous user)
  auditHash?: string;       // Optional hash for "View full report" link
}

interface Issue {
  id: string;               // Unique issue identifier
  title: string;            // Issue title/heading
  description: string;      // Detailed issue description
  severity: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'info';  // Severity level
  category: string;         // Issue category (Technical, On-Page, etc.)
  impact: string;           // Impact description
}
```

### Severity Indicators

| Severity | Icon | Color | Description |
|----------|------|-------|-------------|
| `critical` | AlertTriangle | Red (text-red-500) | Critical issues requiring immediate attention |
| `warning` | AlertCircle | Yellow (text-yellow-500) | Warnings that should be addressed |
| `info` | Info | Blue (text-blue-500) | Informational suggestions |

### Category Badges

| Category | Badge Style |
|----------|-------------|
| Technical | Default badge |
| On-Page | Default badge |
| Content | Default badge |
| Mobile | Default badge |

### Sorting Logic

Issues are sorted by:
1. **Severity** (Critical → Warning → Info)
2. **Category** (alphabetical within same severity)

### UI Behavior

**Anonymous User (isPartial=true):**
- Shows top 5 issues (sorted by severity)
- Displays "View full report" prompt with remaining issue count
- Links to `/audit/{auditHash}` for full access

**Logged-in Owner (isPartial=false):**
- Shows all issues
- No "View full report" prompt
- Full expandable details for each issue

**Empty State:**
- Displays checkmark icon with "No issues found" message

### Styling

- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling
- Card-based layout for issue items
- Lucide icons for severity indicators

## Meta Tags and OG Tags for Public Audits (TASK-33-25)

### Feature Description
Comprehensive meta tags and Open Graph tags implementation for public audit pages. Enables SEO optimization and social sharing for public audit URLs, driving organic traffic and improving click-through rates from search engines and social platforms. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **Implementation:** `frontend/app/audit/[hash]/AuditPageClient.tsx` - `updateMetadata()` function
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/audit/[hash]/metadata.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-33-25.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Dynamic Title Generation | `{truncatedUrl} SEO Audit Report \| SEOIndicator` |
| Meta Description | Score and URL inclusion with SEO-optimized length |
| Robots Meta | `index, follow` for public, `noindex` for errors |
| Canonical URL | HTTPS with trailing slash and hash |
| Open Graph Tags | og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type |
| Twitter Card Tags | twitter:card with summary_large_image |

### Meta Tag Structure

**Title Generation:**
```html
<title>{truncatedUrl} SEO Audit Report | SEOIndicator</title>
```
- URL truncated to 40 chars for display (title max 70 chars)
- Protocol stripping (https:// → removed)

**Meta Description:**
```html
<meta name="description" content="SEO audit for {url} - Score: {score}/100. View technical SEO analysis and recommendations.">
```
- SEO-optimized length (50-160 chars)

**Robots Meta:**
```html
<!-- Valid public audit -->
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">

<!-- Invalid/not found audit -->
<meta name="robots" content="noindex">
```

**Canonical URL:**
```html
<link rel="canonical" href="https://seoindicator.com/audit/{hash}/">
```

### Open Graph Tags

```html
<meta property="og:title" content="{url} SEO Score: {score}/100">
<meta property="og:description" content="SEO audit results for {url}">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://seoindicator.com/badge/{hash}/og.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://seoindicator.com/audit/{hash}/">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
```

**OG Image Dimensions:** 1200x630px (standard social sharing size)

### Twitter Card Tags

```html
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="{url} SEO Score: {score}/100">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="SEO audit results for {url}">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://seoindicator.com/badge/{hash}/og.png">
```

### Dynamic Generation

**Implementation via `updateMetadata()` function:**
```typescript
function updateMetadata(data: PublicAuditData | null) {
  if (!data) {
    // Set noindex for invalid audits
    document.querySelector('meta[name="robots"]')?.setAttribute('content', 'noindex');
    return;
  }

  // Generate dynamic title with truncation
  const displayUrl = truncateUrl(data.siteUrl, 40);
  const title = `${displayUrl} SEO Audit Report | SEOIndicator`;

  // Update document title
  document.title = title;

  // Update meta tags
  updateMetaTag('description', `SEO audit for ${data.siteUrl} - Score: ${data.overallScore}/100...`);
  updateMetaTag('robots', 'index, follow');
  updateLinkTag('canonical', `${siteUrl}/audit/${hash}/`);

  // Update OG tags
  updateMetaProperty('og:title', `${data.siteUrl} SEO Score: ${data.overallScore}/100`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:description', `SEO audit results for ${data.siteUrl}`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:image', `${siteUrl}/badge/${hash}/og.png`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:url', `${siteUrl}/audit/${hash}/`);

  // Update Twitter card tags
  updateMetaName('twitter:card', 'summary_large_image');
  // ... mirrors OG tags
}
```

### URL Truncation Logic

| Input | Output | Reason |
|-------|--------|--------|
| `https://example.com` | `example.com` | Protocol stripped |
| `https://very-long-domain-name-here.com` | `very-long-domain-name-here.com` | Full domain shown if < 40 chars |
| `https://extremely-long-domain-name-that-exceeds-limit.com` | `extremely-long-domain-name-that-...` | Truncated with ellipsis |

**Truncation Rules:**
- Maximum display length: 40 characters
- Protocol (https://) stripped before truncation
- Ellipsis (...) added if truncated
- Title max: 70 characters total

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| XSS Prevention | HTML escaping for all dynamic content |
| URL Sanitization | Protocol validation, special chars escaped |
| No Sensitive Data | Only public audit data exposed in meta tags |
| Injection Protection | All values sanitized before DOM update |

### SEO Benefits

| Benefit | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Search Indexing | `index, follow` allows Google to crawl and index |
| SERP CTR | Compelling title and description improve click rates |
| Social Sharing | OG tags control appearance on Facebook, LinkedIn, etc. |
| Twitter Sharing | Twitter card tags enable rich previews on X |
| Canonical URL | Prevents duplicate content issues |
| Unique Per Audit | Each hash generates unique metadata |

## Analytics API Endpoints (TASK-34-14)

### Service Description
REST API endpoints for retrieving AI Visibility analytics data. Provides aggregated metrics, competitor comparisons, trend analysis, and query history for AI Visibility tracking projects. Part of the AI Visibility Tracking (Generative Engine Optimization) feature (FEAT-034).

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Cache TTL |
|--------|----------|-------------|-----------|
| GET | `/api/v1/ai-visibility/projects/{id}/analytics` | Aggregated analytics | 5 minutes |

### Endpoint: GET /api/v1/ai-visibility/projects/{id}/analytics

```json
{
```

**Response Headers:**
