## BadgeService (TASK-33-6)

### Service Description
Core badge generation service for the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033) that creates SVG badges with score visualization, color coding, and branding. Generates badges in three sizes with light/dark theme support for embedding on third-party websites.

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/BadgeService.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/BadgeServiceTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-6.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `generate(int $score, string $size, ?string $theme = null)` | Generate SVG badge with score visualization |
| `getScoreColor(int $score)` | Get color hex code for score range |
| `getThemeColors(string $theme)` | Get theme color palette (background, text) |

### Badge Sizes

| Size | Dimensions | Use Case |
|------|------------|----------|
| `small` | 120x40px | Inline in blog posts, footer links |
| `medium` | 150x100px | Sidebar widgets, about pages |
| `large` | 300x150px | Footer widgets, partner pages |

### Theme Options

| Theme | Background | Text Color | Use Case |
|-------|------------|------------|----------|
| `light` | #ffffff | #000000 | Light-themed websites |
| `dark` | #1a1a1a | #ffffff | Dark-themed websites |

### Score Color Mapping

| Score Range | Color | Hex Code | Status |
|-------------|-------|----------|--------|
| 90-100 | Green | #22c55e | Excellent |
| 70-89 | Blue | #3b82f6 | Good |
| 50-69 | Yellow | #eab308 | Needs Work |
| 30-49 | Orange | #f97316 | Poor |
| 0-29 | Red | #ef4444 | Critical Issues |

### Badge Features

| Feature | Small | Medium | Large |
|---------|-------|--------|-------|
| Score display | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Score label | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| "SEOIndicator" branding | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Category breakdown | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |

### Category Breakdown (Large Badge Only)

| Category | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Technical | Technical SEO score |
| On-Page | On-page SEO score |
| Content | Content quality score |
| Mobile | Mobile & performance score |

### Cache Strategy

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| TTL | 1 hour (3600 seconds) |
| Cache Key | `badge:{hash}:{size}:{theme}` |
| Driver | Redis |
| Purpose | Reduce SVG generation overhead |

### Accessibility Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Role Attribute | `role="img"` |
| ARIA Label | `aria-label="SEO Score: {score}/100"` |
| Text Contrast | WCAG AA compliant |
| Screen Reader | Score announced via aria-label |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Type Validation | Score must be integer 0-100 |
| Size Validation | Throws `InvalidArgumentException` for invalid sizes |
| Theme Fallback | Invalid themes default to 'light' |
| No External Resources | SVG contains no external URLs |
| No Scripts | No `<script>` or event handlers |
| XSS Prevention | No user input directly rendered |

### Error Handling

| Error | Response |
|-------|----------|
| Invalid size | `InvalidArgumentException` |
| Score < 0 | Clamped to 0 |
| Score > 100 | Clamped to 100 |
| Invalid theme | Defaults to 'light' |

## Usage Aggregation Service (TASK-27-7)

### Service Description
Service for aggregating usage metrics as part of the Admin Dashboard feature (FEAT-027). Provides comprehensive usage statistics including request counts, token usage tracking, and analysis job counts with time-based filtering (today, this week, this month). Integrates with AdminStatsService for cached aggregation.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Admin/UsageAggregationService.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Admin/UsageAggregationServiceTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-27-7.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getStats()` | Get complete usage stats (requests, tokens, analyses) |
| `getRequestStats()` | Aggregate request counts by time period |
| `getTokenStats()` | Token usage with byModel breakdown (fallback to zeros if columns missing) |
| `getAnalysisStats()` | Analysis job counts with byStatus/byType breakdown |
| `getRequestsByEndpoint()` | Request counts grouped by AnalysisHistory.tool_name |
| `getTokenTrends()` | Token usage trends over time |

### Response Structure

```json
{
  "requests": {
    "total": 156789,
    "today": 2340,
    "thisWeek": 15680,
    "thisMonth": 48920
  },
  "tokens": {
    "total": 12500000,
    "today": 156000,
    "thisWeek": 890000,
    "thisMonth": 3200000,
    "byModel": {
      "gpt-4": 5000000,
      "gpt-3.5-turbo": 6000000,
      "claude-3": 1500000
    }
  },
  "analyses": {
    "total": 12340,
    "today": 156,
    "thisWeek": 890,
    "thisMonth": 3450
  }
}
```

### Data Sources

| Data | Source | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| Request counts | `AnalysisJob` table | Uses status counts as proxy |
| Endpoint breakdown | `AnalysisHistory.tool_name` | Grouped by tool name |
| Token stats | Future migration needed | Gracefully returns zeros if columns missing |
| Analysis counts | `AnalysisJob` table | With byStatus/byType breakdown |

### Performance Optimizations

| Optimization | Implementation |
|--------------|----------------|
| Efficient GROUP BY | Database-level aggregation |
| Index usage | Queries use indexed columns |
| Caching | Via AdminStatsService (5 min TTL) |
| Graceful degradation | Returns zeros for missing token columns |

## Admin Usage API Endpoints (TASK-27-8)

### Feature Description
REST API controller for admin usage metrics within the Admin Dashboard (FEAT-027). Provides four endpoints for aggregated usage statistics, request breakdowns by endpoint, token usage by model, and usage trends over time. All endpoints are protected by AdminAuthorizationMiddleware and rate-limited to 60 requests per minute.

### Component Locations
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/UsageController.php`
- **Service Dependency:** `backend/app/Services/Admin/UsageAggregationService.php` (TASK-27-7)
- **Middleware:** `backend/app/Http/Middleware/AdminAuthorizationMiddleware.php` (TASK-27-2)
- **Routes:** `backend/routes/api.php` (lines 258-263)
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/Admin/UsageControllerTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-27-8.md`

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Rate Limit |
|--------|----------|-------------|------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/usage/overview` | Aggregated usage statistics | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/usage/requests` | Request counts by endpoint | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/usage/tokens` | Token usage by model | 60/min |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/usage/trends` | Usage trends (time series) | 60/min |

### GET /api/v1/admin/usage/overview

Returns aggregated usage statistics including requests, tokens, and analyses.

**Authorization:** Admin role required (AdminAuthorizationMiddleware)

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `start_date` | date | Filter from date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date` | date | Filter to date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `granularity` | string | Time grouping: `day`, `week`, `month` |

**Success Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "requests": {
      "total": 156789,
      "today": 2340,
      "thisWeek": 15680,
      "thisMonth": 48920
    },
    "tokens": {
      "total": 12500000,
      "today": 156000,
      "thisWeek": 890000,
      "thisMonth": 3200000,
      "byModel": {
        "gpt-4": 5000000,
        "gpt-3.5-turbo": 6000000,
        "claude-3": 1500000
      }
    },
    "analyses": {
      "total": 12340,
      "today": 156,
      "thisWeek": 890,
      "thisMonth": 3450,
      "byStatus": {
        "completed": 11000,
        "pending": 500,
        "failed": 340
      },
      "byType": {
        "full": 8000,
        "quick": 4340
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /api/v1/admin/usage/requests

Returns request counts grouped by endpoint.

**Authorization:** Admin role required

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `start_date` | date | Filter from date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date` | date | Filter to date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `granularity` | string | Time grouping: `day`, `week`, `month` |

**Success Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "byEndpoint": [
      { "endpoint": "seo-analysis", "count": 45000 },
      { "endpoint": "keyword-research", "count": 32000 },
      { "endpoint": "backlink-check", "count": 28000 }
    ],
    "total": 156789,
    "trends": {
      "daily": [
        { "date": "2026-03-01", "count": 1200 },
        { "date": "2026-03-02", "count": 1350 }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /api/v1/admin/usage/tokens

Returns token usage statistics with breakdown by model.

**Authorization:** Admin role required

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `start_date` | date | Filter from date (YYYY-MM-DD) |

```json
      ]
```

### GET /api/v1/admin/usage/trends

Returns usage trends as time series data.

**Authorization:** Admin role required

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `days` | integer | 7 | Number of days to include (max 90, capped automatically) |

**Success Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "daily": [
      { "date": "2026-03-01", "requests": 1200, "tokens": 120000, "analyses": 45 },
      { "date": "2026-03-02", "requests": 1350, "tokens": 135000, "analyses": 52 },
      { "date": "2026-03-03", "requests": 1280, "tokens": 128000, "analyses": 48 }
    ],
    "weekly": [
      { "week": "2026-W09", "requests": 8500, "tokens": 850000, "analyses": 320 }
    ],
    "monthly": [
      { "month": "2026-02", "requests": 45000, "tokens": 4500000, "analyses": 1500 }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Error Responses

| Code | Condition | Response |
|------|-----------|----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated | `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"..."}}` |
| 403 | Not admin | `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"..."}}` |
| 422 | Validation error | `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"..."}}` |
| 500 | Server error | `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"SERVER_ERROR","message":"..."}}` |

### Authorization & Security

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Laravel Sanctum (Bearer token) |
| Authorization | AdminAuthorizationMiddleware checks `is_admin` flag |
| Rate Limiting | 60 requests per minute via `throttle:60,1` middleware |
| SQL Injection | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| No PII Exposure | Aggregated statistics only |

### Validation Rules

| Parameter | Rules |
|-----------|-------|
| `start_date` | Optional, date format (Y-m-d), before or equal to end_date |
| `end_date` | Optional, date format (Y-m-d), after or equal to start_date |
| `granularity` | Optional, in: `day`, `week`, `month` |
| `days` | Optional, integer, max 90 (capped automatically) |

### Middleware Stack

```php
Route::middleware(['auth:sanctum', 'admin', 'throttle:60,1'])
    ->prefix('api/v1/admin/usage')
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/overview', [UsageController::class, 'overview']);
        Route::get('/requests', [UsageController::class, 'requests']);
        Route::get('/tokens', [UsageController::class, 'tokens']);
        Route::get('/trends', [UsageController::class, 'trends']);
    });
```

## DomainValidator Service (TASK-3-3)

### Service Description
Security-focused domain validation service for the Competitor Management feature (FEAT-003). Provides comprehensive domain validation with SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) protection, DNS verification, and accessibility checks. Used by CompetitorController to validate competitor domains before adding them to the system.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/DomainValidator.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/DomainValidatorTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Services/DomainValidatorIntegrationTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/SPEC-003-3.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `validate(string $domain)` | Full validation pipeline: format, DNS, accessibility, SSRF check |
| `validateFormat(?string $domain)` | Validates domain format with regex and SSRF hostname blocking |
| `validateDns(string $domain)` | Checks DNS A/CNAME record exists |
| `validateIp(string $ip)` | SSRF protection: blocks private/internal IP ranges |
| `checkAccessibility(string $domain)` | HTTP/HTTPS request with timeout to verify domain is accessible |
| `validateWithRateLimit(string $domain, string $userId)` | Rate-limited validation (max 10/min per user) |

### Validation Pipeline

```
1. Format Validation
   ├── Regex validation for valid domain format
   ├── SSRF hostname blocking (localhost, local, internal)
   └── Encoding bypass detection (hex, decimal, octal)

2. DNS Resolution
   ├── checkdnsrr() for A/CNAME records
   └── Returns error if no DNS record exists

3. IP Validation (SSRF Protection)
   ├── Resolves domain to IP addresses
   ├── Blocks IPv4 private ranges:
   │   - 127.0.0.0/8 (loopback)
   │   - 10.0.0.0/8 (Class A private)
   │   - 172.16.0.0/12 (Class B private)
   │   - 192.168.0.0/16 (Class C private)
   │   - 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local)
   ├── Blocks IPv6 addresses:
   │   - ::1 (loopback)
   │   - fc00::/7 (unique local)
   │   - fe80::/10 (link-local)
   └── Returns error if IP is internal/private

4. Accessibility Check
   ├── HTTP/HTTPS request with 5-second timeout
   ├── Follows redirects (max 5)
   └── Validates redirect targets for SSRF

5. Rate Limiting
   └── Max 10 validations per minute per user
```

### SSRF Protection Coverage

| Attack Vector | Protection |
|---------------|------------|
| IPv4 loopback | 127.0.0.0/8 blocked |
| IPv4 Class A private | 10.0.0.0/8 blocked |
| IPv4 Class B private | 172.16.0.0/12 blocked |
| IPv4 Class C private | 192.168.0.0/16 blocked |
| IPv4 link-local | 169.254.0.0/16 blocked |
| IPv6 loopback | ::1 blocked |
| IPv6 unique local | fc00::/7 blocked |
| IPv6 link-local | fe80::/10 blocked |
| IPv6 mapped IPv4 | ::ffff: prefix blocked |
| Localhost keyword | "localhost" in domain blocked |
| Internal domain | ".local", ".internal" blocked |
| Decimal IP encoding | "2130706433" (127.0.0.1) blocked |
| Hex IP encoding | "0x7f.0x00.0x00.0x01" blocked |
| Octal IP encoding | "0177.0.0.01" blocked |
| URL encoding bypass | % encoded IPs decoded and checked |
| DNS rebinding | IP checked after resolution |
| Redirect to internal | Redirect targets validated |

### Return Structure

**Success Response:**
```php
[
    'valid' => true,
    'domain' => 'example.com',
    'ip' => '93.184.216.34',
    'accessible' => true,
    'http_status' => 200,
]
```

**Error Response:**
```php
[
    'valid' => false,
    'error' => 'Domain resolves to private IP address',
    'code' => 'SSRF_BLOCKED',
]
```

### Error Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `INVALID_FORMAT` | Domain format is invalid |
| `SSRF_BLOCKED` | Domain/IP blocked for SSRF protection |
| `DNS_LOOKUP_FAILED` | No DNS record found |
| `ACCESSIBILITY_CHECK_FAILED` | Domain not accessible |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many validation requests |

### Rate Limiting

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Max requests | 10 per minute |
| Scope | Per user ID |
| Implementation | In-memory rate limiter |
| Reset | 60-second window |

### Performance Characteristics

| Operation | Timeout |
|-----------|---------|
| DNS lookup | Default system timeout |
| HTTP accessibility | 5 seconds |
| Redirect limit | 5 redirects max |

## OpenRouter Client Service (TASK-31-6)

### Feature Description
OpenRouter API client service for the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031) that handles unified AI requests with proper authentication, error handling, timeouts, and response parsing. Extends the existing OpenRouter provider from TASK-21-2 to provide a dedicated client for the unified AI analysis pipeline.

### Component Locations
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/OpenRouterClient.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/openrouter.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/OpenRouterClientTest.php`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-31-6.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `generate(string $prompt, array $options = []): AIResponse` | Send unified prompt to OpenRouter |
| `stream(string $prompt, callable $onChunk): void` | Stream response chunks (MVP: fallback to non-streaming) |
| `getAvailableModels(): array` | Return list of available free-tier models |
| `getModelInfo(string $modelId): ?array` | Get model metadata by ID |

### Request Configuration

| Setting | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| Base URL | `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` | OpenRouter API endpoint |
| Default Timeout | 120 seconds | 2 minutes for large responses |
| Default Model | `google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free` | Free-tier default |
| Default Max Tokens | 4000 | Response token limit |
| Default Temperature | 0.3 | Deterministic responses |

### Request Headers

| Header | Value | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {api_key}` | API authentication |
| `HTTP-Referer` | `{app.url}` | Request attribution |
| `X-Title` | `SEOIndicator` | Application identification |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Request body format |

### AIResponse DTO

```php
class AIResponse
{
    public readonly bool $success;
    public readonly ?string $content;
    public readonly int $tokensUsed;
    public readonly int $latencyMs;
    public readonly ?string $errorMessage;
    public readonly ?string $model;
    public readonly int $promptTokens;
    public readonly int $responseTokens;
    
    public static function success(
        string $content,
        int $tokensUsed,
        int $latencyMs,
        string $model = null,
        int $promptTokens = 0,
        int $responseTokens = 0,
    ): self;
    
    public static function error(string $message, int $latencyMs): self;
}
```

### Error Handling

| HTTP Code | Error Type | Recovery |
|-----------|------------|----------|
| 400 | Bad Request | Log and throw `InvalidRequestException` |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Check API key configuration |
| 403 | Forbidden | Log and throw `AccessDeniedException` |
| 429 | Rate Limited | Return with retry-after header |
| 500-503 | Server Error | Retry with exponential backoff |
| Timeout | Timeout | Retry with smaller content |

| `mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free` | Mistral 7B | 32,768 tokens |
| `meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free` | Llama 3 8B | 8,192 tokens |

## Lead Capture Flow (TASK-33-23)

### Feature Description
Frontend implementation for the lead capture flow as part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033). Enables anonymous visitors to unlock full SEO audit reports by submitting their email address, providing a conversion path from anonymous visitor to qualified lead.

### Component Locations
- **Component:** `frontend/components/audit/PublicAuditCTA.tsx`
- **Utility Functions:** `frontend/lib/audit/public-audit.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/audit/PublicAuditCTA.test.tsx`
- **Integration Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/integration/lead-capture-flow.test.tsx`
- **Utility Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/lib/audit/public-audit.test.ts`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-33-23.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Email Capture Form | Form with email input, validation, and submit button |
| Email Validation | Regex validation, max length check, required field |
| Form State Management | Idle/submitting/success/error states |
| Success State | Score display with "View your full audit" link |
| Error Handling | User-friendly error messages with retry option |
| Skip Option | "View limited report" link for anonymous access |
| Social Sharing | Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook share buttons |
| Badge Embed | Embed code with copy functionality |
| Cookie Unlock | Session-based unlock state |
| Analytics Tracking | Event tracking for form submissions |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface PublicAuditCTAProps {
  auditHash: string;           // Required: 32-character public audit hash
  siteUrl: string;             // Required: Site URL for display
  score: number;               // Required: SEO score (0-100)
  onEmailSubmit?: (email: string) => Promise<void>;  // Optional: Email submission callback
  className?: string;          // Optional: Additional CSS classes
}
```

### Form States

| State | Description | UI Elements |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `idle` | Initial state | Email input, submit button |
| `submitting` | API call in progress | Disabled input, loading spinner |
| `success` | Email submitted successfully | Score display, view audit link, social share |
| `error` | API error occurred | Error message, retry button |

### User Flow

```
1. Anonymous visitor arrives at /audit/{hash}/
   └── Sees: Site URL, score summary, top 5 issues
   
2. Visitor wants full report
   └── Options:
       a. Enter email → Submit → Success state → Full audit access
       b. Click "View limited report" → See limited issues only
   
3. After successful submission
   └── Sees: Score display, "View your full audit" link
   └── Can: Share on social media, copy embed code
```

### Cookie Unlock Mechanism

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `setUnlockedAudit(auditHash)` | Sets cookie to mark audit as unlocked |
| `getUnlockedAudits()` | Returns array of unlocked audit hashes |
| `isAuditUnlocked(auditHash)` | Checks if audit is unlocked |

**Cookie Format:**
```
Name: seoindicator_unlocked_audits
Value: comma-separated list of audit hashes
TTL: Session (cleared on browser close)
```

### Utility Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `setUnlockedAudit(hash)` | Set cookie for unlocked audit |
| `storeEmailCaptured(hash, email)` | Session storage for deduplication |
| `generateSignupRedirectUrl(email)` | Create pre-filled signup URL |
| `hashEmail(email)` | SHA-256 hash for privacy |

### Social Sharing

| Platform | Share URL Format |
|----------|------------------|
| Twitter | `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=...&url=...` |
| LinkedIn | `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=...` |
| Facebook | `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=...` |

### Embed Code Generation

```html
<a href="https://seoindicator.com/audit/{hash}/">
  <img src="https://seoindicator.com/badge/{hash}/small.svg" alt="SEO Score: {score}/100" />
</a>
```

## Historical Comparison Charts (TASK-3-8)

### Feature Description
Interactive multi-line chart component for displaying ranking history over time, comparing user positions against competitors. Part of the Competitor Comparison feature (FEAT-3/SPEC-3). Enables visual trend analysis with interactive legend, tooltips, and filtering capabilities.

### Component Location
- **Main Component:** `frontend/components/charts/HistoricalComparisonChart.tsx`
- **API Hook:** `frontend/lib/api/comparison-history.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/charts/HistoricalComparisonChart.test.tsx`

### Component Architecture

**Props Interface:**
```typescript
interface HistoricalComparisonChartProps {
  keywords: Keyword[];           // List of keywords to select from
  competitors: Competitor[];     // List of competitors to compare
  initialKeywordId?: number;     // Initial keyword ID to display
  initialDateRange?: DateRangeOption; // Initial date range (default: "30d")
  className?: string;            // Optional className for styling
}
```

**Sub-components:**
| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `DateRangeSelector` | 7d/30d/90d preset buttons |
| `KeywordSelector` | Dropdown for keyword selection |
| `CompetitorFilter` | Checkboxes to toggle competitor visibility |
| `CustomTooltip` | Hover tooltip with full date and positions |
| `CustomLegend` | Interactive legend with toggle functionality |

### Visual Design

**Color Palette:**
| Element | Color | Hex |
|---------|-------|-----|
| User Line | Blue | `#2563eb` |
| Competitor 1 | Red | `#ef4444` |
| Competitor 2 | Green | `#22c55e` |
| Competitor 3 | Amber | `#f59e0b` |
| Competitor 4 | Violet | `#8b5cf6` |
| Competitor 5 | Pink | `#ec4899` |

**Chart Features:**
- Y-axis inverted (position 1 at top, lower = better)
- X-axis shows dates with angled labels
- Trend indicator showing position change over period
- Responsive container (scales to container width)
- Loading spinner with accessible label
- Error state with retry button
- Empty state with helpful message

### API Integration

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/rankings/comparison/history`

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `keywordId` | number | Keyword ID to fetch history for |
| `days` | number | Number of days (7, 30, or 90) |
| `competitorId` | number | Optional: filter to specific competitor |

**Response Type:**
```typescript
interface ComparisonHistoryData {
  keyword: { id: number; keyword: string; } | null;
  history: {
    user: ComparisonHistoryPoint[];
    competitors: CompetitorHistoryPoint[];
  };
}
```

**SWR Hook:**
```typescript
const { data, isLoading, error, mutate } = useComparisonHistory({
  keywordId: selectedKeywordId,
  days: 30,
  competitorId: optionalCompetitorId,
});
```

### Interactive Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Keyword Selector | Dropdown to switch between keywords |
| Date Range Selector | 7d/30d/90d preset buttons |
| Competitor Filter | Checkboxes to show/hide competitor lines |
| Legend Toggle | Click legend items to toggle line visibility |
| Hover Tooltip | Shows exact position for all lines at date |
| Trend Indicator | Shows position change (improved/dropped/no change) |

### Accessibility

- `role="status"` on loading spinner
- `aria-label` on loading container
- Screen reader text (`sr-only`) for loading state
- Keyboard accessible dropdowns and checkboxes
- Visible focus indicators on interactive elements

### Usage Example

```tsx
import HistoricalComparisonChart from "@/components/charts/HistoricalComparisonChart";

function ComparisonPage() {
  const { keywords } = useKeywords();
  const { competitors } = useCompetitors();

  return (
    <HistoricalComparisonChart
      keywords={keywords}
      competitors={competitors}
      initialKeywordId={keywords[0]?.id}
      initialDateRange="30d"
    />
  );
}
```
